tei:div.tei:p: ༄༅/ /dpal ldan bla ma dkon mchog bzang po'i rnam par thar pa dad pa'i ljon shing rgyas byed ces bya ba bzhugs so// oṃ gu ru bud+dha bo dhi satwa bh+yo na mo na maḥ khyab bdag rdo rje 'chang dang dbyer ma mchis pa 'jam pa'i dbyangs dkon mchog bzang po pa'i rnam par thar pa dad pa'i ljon shing rgyas byed ces bya ba/ rje btsun 'jam pa'i dbyangs dang dbyer ma mchis pa/ dpal ldan bla ma dam pa'i zhabs la gus pas phyag 'tshal lo/ /gang sku mtshan dang dpe byad kyis spras tshul khrims phung pos rab brgyan zhing / /gang gsung tshangs ba'i dbyangs ltar snyan pas 'gro la chos kyi sgra dbyangs sgrog /gang thugs ji lta ji snyed mkhyen pa byams dang snying rje'i brlan gyis brlan/ /gang mdzad 'gro rnams lam gyi rten dang lam dang lam 'bras dag la 'god/ /srid gsum bla ma 'jam dbyangs chos rje gus pas mchod do bdag gi spyi bo'i rgyan du bzhugs/ /skye rga na 'chi'i sdug bsngal spangs kyang skye rga na 'chi'i rnam pa ston/ /shes bya ma lus ji bzhin gzigs kyang bdag gi dngos po cung ma gzigs/ /'gro kun byams pas bu bzhin skyong kyang gdug pa'i skye bo tshar gcod phyir/ /tha mal yul las shin tu 'das pa 'jam dbyangs chos rje gus phyag 'tshal/ /khyod ni sangs rgyas kun gyi rnam 'phrul phyir/ /yon tan ma lus brjod par su yis nus/ /'on kyang khyod kyi rnam thar rgya mtsho las/ /chu thigs tsam zhig dad pa'i dbang gis brjod/ /sdebs sbyor mkhas pa bdag la yod min zhing / /lung rig man ngag rnams la sbyangs stobs zhan/ /de phyir gzhan la phan pa rgya chen dka'/ /skal ldan bla ma'i rnal 'byor gso phyir tsam/ /dad pa'i ljon shing rgyas byed ni/ /don tshan bcu gnyis dag gis bshad/ /spyir ni bla ma sangs rgyas nyid/ /khyad par dam pa 'di nyid ni/ /dang por chos skur sangs rgyas nas/ /'dir ni sprul pa'i tshul bstan pa/ /lung bstan lhums su zhugs tshul dang /

/bltams nas gzhon nu'i mdzad pa dang / /bshes gnyen bsten nas thos pa btsal/ /bshad pas mkhas pa'i dbus su bstod/ /bla ma lha dang bsrung ma yis/ /lung bstan gdan sa mdzad tshul dang / /chos 'khor rim par bskor nas ni/ /smin grol lam la bkod tshul dang / /yon tan dgu sogs ldan tshul dang / /khyad par zab mo'i bstan pa ni/ /nyin mo ltar du mdzad tshul dang / /brgyad bcu'i dus su 'da' tshul bstan/ /dge ba byang chub chen por bsngo/ /'di nyid kyi ni spyi sdom yin/ /de la spyir dpal ldan bla ma dam pa rnams ni/ sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa' rnams kyi rnam 'phrul yin te/ rgyud kyi rgyal po dus kyi 'khor lor/ slob dpon dag ni sangs rgyas nyid de rab mchog sa'i gzhi la chos ni de yis bstan pa'o/ /dge 'dun gang zhig der gnas rab tu dga' ba'i thugs ldan sems can kun la rjes su brtse ba ste/ /zhes dang / gang zhig mi yi 'jig rten dag na dpal ldan bla ma rdo rje 'dzin pa sdig bral de bdag ste/ /de la gnod pa byas pas srog chags rnams ni nges par dmyal bar 'gro ste 'di la ngo mtshar med/ /de mnyes pa yis bdag ni mgu ste de la khro ba'i me ni khros pa zhes bya chen po'o/ /de nyid sems can rnams la thar pa bde snyam 'bras gter bu rnams dag gis phyag 'os mchod 'os so/ /zhes dang / sdom pa 'byung ba'i rgyud du yang / bla ma sangs rgyas bla ma chos/ /de bzhin bla ma dge 'dun te/ /sangs rgyas kun dang mnyam sbyor ba'i/ /mkha' 'gro ma yi dra ba sdom/ /de phyir sangs rgyas go 'phang ni/ /'dod pas bla ma mnyes par bya/ /zhes dang / rdo rje phreng ba'i rgyud du yang / bla ma dang ni rdo rje 'chang / /tha dad par ni mi rtog go /zhes dang / ye shes thig le'i rgyud du yang / bla ma mtho ris thar pa'i bu/ /bla ma ye shes bla ma bde/ /bla ma ston pa bla ma mgon/ /bla ma rdo rje 'dzin pa nyid/

/ces dang / mkha' 'gro ma rdo rje gur du yang / bla ma sangs rgyas kun dang mnyam/ /zhes dang / rdo rje sems dpa' ji lta bur/ /de ltar slob dpon gzugs 'dzin te/ /sems can rjes su gzung dmigs nas/ /phal pa'i gzugs su gnas pa'o/ /zhes dang / yang rdo rje gur las/ nga nyid rdo rje sems dpa' ste/ /de nyid slob dpon gzugs su 'dzin/ /sems can phan gdags dmigs nas ni/ /byang chub lam mchog dngos su ston/ /yon tan ma lus bskyed pa dang / /nyes pa spong bar byed pa la/ /bla ma ma yin su zhig yod/ /des na bla ma sangs rgyas ni/ /kun las lhag par shes par bya/ /bskal pa stong gi sangs rgyas kyang / /bla ma dag la brten te byung / /zhes dang / dgongs 'dus las/ bskal pa stong gis sangs rgyas pas/ /slob dpon mnyan par shes par bya/ /zhes dang / bla ma'i yon tan yongs bzung las/ /bla ma med pa'i 'og rol nas/ /sangs rgyas bya ba'i ming yang med/ /bskal pa stong gi sangs rgyas kyang / /bla ma dag la brten te 'byung / /zhes so/ /sgyu 'phrul dra ba'i rgyud las/ rdo rje slob dpon ji lta blta zhes na/ /bla ma sangs rgyas kun dang mnyam/ /de nyid rtag tu rdo rje 'chang / /de bzhin gshegs pa rin chen tog /de ni ye shes rgya mtsho che/ /yid bzhin nor bu rin chen bzhin/ /zhes dang / dpal gsang ba 'dus pa las/ /rdo rje slob dpon lus 'di la/ /rgyal ba'i sku ni rim bzhin gnas/ /'di yi gzugs kyi phung po ni/ /sangs rgyas rnam par snang mdzad yin/ /tshor ba rdo rje nyi ma ste/ /'du shes pad+ma gar dbang phyug /'du byed rdo rje rgyal po ste/ /rnam par shes pa mi skyod pa/ /sa ni spyan zhes bya bas te/ /chu yi khams ni ma mā ki /gos dkar sgrol ma zhes bya ba/ /me dang rlung du rab tu grags/ /nam mkha' chos dbyings dbang phyug la/ /rdo rje'i skye mched nyid dag kyang / /byang chub sems dpa'i dkyil 'khor mchog

/yan lag khro bo'i rgyal po rnams/ /zhes so/ /bla ma lnga bcu pa las/ dbang bskur mchog thob rdo rje yi/ /slob dpon la ni de bzhin gshegs/ /phyogs bcu'i 'jig rten khams bzhugs pas/ /dus gsum du ni mngon phyag 'tshal/ /zhes bla ma dang sangs rgyas dbyer med du gsungs so/ ༈ /gnyis pa/ dam pa 'di nyid dang por sangs rgyas nas/ /zhing 'dir sprul pa'i tshul bzung nas/ /lung bstan tshul ni/ khyad par du bdag cag gi bla ma sa gsum na 'gran zla ma mchis pa'i rdo rje 'chang chen po 'jam pa'i dbyangs dkon mchog bzang po zhes mtshan yongs su grags pa ni/ dang por chos kyi skur mngon par rdzogs par sangs rgyas pa yin pas/ sems can gyi don du/ 'jig rten gyi khams la lar ni/ dga' ldan nas 'pho ba'i tshul ston/ la lar ni/ lhums su 'jug pa dang / la lar ni skye ba dang / la lar ni chos kyi 'khor lo bskor ba dang / la lar ni mya ngan las 'da' ba'i tshul dang / la lar ni/ gzings dang / zam pa dang / gter dang rin po che la sogs pa sna tshogs su sprul nas/ gang la gang 'tsham kyis gzhan don bsam gyis mi khyab pa mdzad pa yin te/ mdo sde rgyan las/ bzo dang skye dang byang chub che/ /mya ngan 'das par rtag ston pas/ /sangs rgyas sprul pa'i sku 'di ni/ /rnam par grol ba'i thabs chen po/ /zhes gsungs pa ltar ro/ /de'i phyir dam pa 'di'i yon tan ma lus pa/ sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa' rnams kyis kyang brjod par mi nus mod/ 'on kyang mi mjed 'jig rten gyi khams 'dir sprul pa'i tshul bzung nas/ sku lus 'di la brten nas/ gzhan don mdzad tshul gyi yon tan drag dril gcig tha mal gyi skye bo rnams la thun mong du snang ba cung zad brjod pa/ ༈ rje btsun 'di nyid bla ma sa chen gyi sku skye yin te/ bla ma sa chen dgung lo bcu gcig bzhes pa'i dus/ ba ri lo tsa ba la dpal ldan sa skya'i gdan sa bskos nas/ rong ngur mig tu brang ti dar ma snying po la/

byams chos lnga dang / mngon pa gong 'og gsan pa la byon nas/ lo gsum song dus/ yar 'brog khob le ba'i grwa pa gcig la/ 'brum bu sme ba nag po byung ba la/ nad g.yog med pa thugs kyis ma bzod nas de'i grogs mdzad pas/ nad de bla ma la 'gos nas snyung / de tsa na/ sa skya na a po phag ston bya ba/ mig mthong yod pa gcig snga dro nyi ma la thon nas bsdad pa na/ shar phyogs brag chung kha na yar/ rta bra'o zhon/ zha thang zha chal thabs can/ phod kha chen po can zhig lcag g.yob kyin sa skya'i thad kar rta kha rgyugs nas/ kun dga' snying po na yi yod/ khyed sa skya pa tsho ci mno ba yin zer ba gcig byung ste/ de'i lo rgyus bsnyad pas/ a pho zer ba bzhin yong ba gcig yod/ phal cher bden las che zer/ de'i dgong mo bang chen pa'ang sleb/ ma gcig gi dgongs pa la/ nga yi bu de ma shi na rung ste/ khong shi na nga la sa skya'i bla brang 'dir bsdad rgyu mi yong snyam nas/ bla brang gi phyag rdzas phyed tsam la gser sogs nyer mkho bsgrubs nas/ rong phyogs la byon pas/ rong ngur mig tu phebs/ sras kyi sar byon pas/ sras sku na phra ba'i stobs kyis cung zad yus nas bshums pas/ yum gyis sras kyi thugs dbyung ba'i phyir du/ pha jo sras bya ba snying rus che ba yong rgyu yin pa la sdug sran re chung ngus nas ci la phan pa yin/ dge 'dun tshogs pa rgya mtsho lta bu 'di'i dbus su shi na'ang / don che mod ces gsungs so/ /de nas sku rim dang / sku drin gsab phyir sogs la dgongs nas/ bla ma'i drung du 'bul ba gya nom pa dang / dge 'dun rnams la'ang bsnyen bkur gral 'gyed sogs mdzad pas/ myur du sdangs te/ tshad ma gsan par bzhed pa na/ sa skya pa'i gzhis bas 'phrin bkur te/ tshad ma phyis gsan pas chog bla ma ba ri ba bgres pas/ chos bka' gsan long mi yong bar gda' bas/ yar 'byon par zhu zhus pas/ yar 'byon par bzhed de/ g.yog po'i la la byon/

de'i tshe nyang stod lcang ra'i sa nas/ sa chen gyis/ dpal 'khor sde chen gyis phyogs la gzigs nas/ sa dkar logs pha gir/ ma 'ongs pa na nga dge slong gi gzugs su sprul nas sems can gyi don rgya chen po byed par 'gyur zhes zhal gyis bzhes nas lung bstan/ 'di'i shes byed rgyu mtshan 'og tu/ chos skyong gis lung bstan pa las kyang yang dag par grub bo/ /bka' gdams glegs bam gyi ma 'ongs lung bstan gyi skabs na/ 'brom ston pa'i zhal nas/ 'khor lo'i rtsibs la gras pa'i chos sde ru/ /'jam pa'i dbyangs zhes kun la grags pa 'byung / /khyad par gza' yi nad rnams 'joms par byed/ /skyes chen des ni 'gro ba ma lus 'dul/ /zhes dang / slob dpon pad ma 'byung gnas kyi zhal nas/ yul ni rtag stod sum mdo ru/ /yab ni byang chub sems dpa'i rigs/ /yum ni rlung chen mkha' 'gro ste/ /sras ni skyes chen stag lo pa/ /lte 'og sme ba can zhig 'byung / /rab kyis longs spyod rdzogs skur mthong / /bar pas 'ja' 'od 'khyil par mthong / /tha mas sha ldog 'gyur bar mthong / /zhes gsungs pa ltar ro// ༈ //gsum pa lhums su 'jug tshul ni/ 'khrungs yul thub pas bdud kyi dkyil 'khor chen po brtul zhing / ye shes kyi dkyil 'khor chen po rgyas par mdzad pa'i ma ga dha rdo rje'i gdan las byang shar gyi rgyud/ thub pa'i bstan pa dar ba'i bod gangs can gyi khrod/ khyad par du/ mdo sngags kyi chos dar ba'i la stod zhwa pa gzhung zhes bya ba'i sa cha/ sangs rgyas byang chub tshul khrims zhes bya ba'i grub thob khyad par can zhig gis sgom pa brag dmar zhes bya bar 'khrungs/ yab ni mtshan dge bshes rgyal mtshan bzang po zhes bya ba/ byams chos lnga la lan thebs shing / byams snying rje byang chub kyis sems dang ldan pa'i byang chub sems dpa' de'o/ /yum ni mtshan brtson 'grus sgron zhes bya ba mkha' 'gro ma'i rigs te/

de yang yum gyi mngal du zhugs pa'i dus su/ yum gyi rnal lam du/ seng ge dkar mo la chibs te gling bzhi bskor ba dang / nub phyogs u rgyan gyi yul du byon pa dang / mkha' la sprin chen 'khrigs shing / sa la lo thog rgyas pa la sogs pa'i ngo mtshar ba'i ltas khyad par can byung ste/ yum rnal sad nas/ thugs bde stong gi ting nge 'dzin la 'byams nas 'gro ba dang / sku lus la yang bde ba'i rnam pa rgyas pa dang / ngag nas kyang / sngar mi mkhyen pa'i tshigs su bcad pa du ma thol byung du thon pa byung gsungs/ rgya gar ba 'bru mangs zhes bya ba sa pho stag la/ dam pa 'di sku bltams nas/ shin tu mdzes shing mtshan dang dpe byad kyis spras pa/ tshes pa'i zla ba ltar skyed shin tu che bar gyur ste/ byis pa chung ngu'i dus su cung zad spyan chab 'don par brtsams pa'i tshe/ dpe cha dang / shog bu'i dum bu phyag tu bltas pas/ 'phro bcad de/ klog pa dang / slob gnyer gyi rnam pa mdzad/ cung zad smra mkhyen pa'i dus/ rang nyid sa mtho sar bzhugs/ byis pa gzhan rnams sa dma' sar bzhag nas/ chos ston pa la sogs pa'i rnam pa mdzad cing / gzhan yang zhi ba dang / dul ba dang / des pa dang / yid gzhungs pa dang / dbang po mi rgod pa dang / rgan rabs la gus pa dang / snying rje che ba'i ngang tshul can zhig byung ngo / /dgung lo bdun bzhes pa'i dus su/ skyes rabs las/ rab tu byung ba'i phyogs dag ni/ /yon tan tshad med rnams dang ldan/ /zhes dang / mnga' ba'i mdo las/ khyim na gnas pa ni/ khang pa me 'bar ba na gnas pa lta bu'o/ /rab tu byung ba ni/ bsil khang na gnas pa lta bu'o/ /zhes gsungs pa ltar/ rab tu 'byung bar bzhed nas mkhan po mkhas pa dang brtan pa'i yon tan gnyis dang ldan pa'i/ bod gangs can gyi rnal 'byor gyi dbang phyug chen po/ chos kyi rje rin po che shes rab bzang po ba'i zhal snga nas dang / slob dpon ni byang chub sems dpa' chen po/

dkon mchog byang chub pa gnyis kyis gtso mdzad/ dge slong gi dge 'dun grangs tshang pa'i dbus su/ rab tu byung ste/ mtshan yang mkhan slob kyi mtshan gyi mtha' can/ dkon mchog bzang por btags so/ /de nas klog yig la sogs pa tshegs med par mkhyen no/ ༈ /bzhi pa bshes gnyen bsten nas thos pa mdzad tshul ni/ spyod 'jug las/ rgyal ba'i sras kyi de lta bur/ /byang chub sems rab brtan bzung nas/ /g.yel ba med pa rtag tu yang / /bslab las mi 'da' 'bad par bya/ /zhes gsungs pa ltar/ bslab pa la slob dgos shing / bslab par bya ba dang / bslab par bya ba ma yin par shes pa yang / thos pa la rag las te/ mdo sde brgyan las/ rig pa'i gnas lnga dag la brtson par ma byas na/ /'phags mchog gis kyang thams cad mkhyen nyid thob mi 'gyur/ /de lta bas na gzhan dag tshar gcad rjes bzung dang / bdag nyid kun shes bya phyir de la de brtson byed/ /ces dang / rgyud bla ma las/ gang zhig byang chub don du gnyer bas gser zhing nor bus spras pa ni/ /sangs rgyas zhing rdul mnyam pa nyin re chos rgyal rnams la rtag 'bul la/ /gzhan gang 'di las tshig tsam thos zhing thos nas kyang ni mos na 'di/ /sbyin pa las byung dge ba de las bsod nams ches mang thob par 'gyur/ /blo ldan gang zhig bla med byang chub 'dod pas bskal pa du mar yang / /lus ngag yid kyi 'bad pa med par tshul khrims dri med bsrung byed la/ /gzhan gang 'di las tshig tsam thos shing thos nas kyang ni mos na 'di/ /tshul khrims las byung dge ba de las bsod nams ches mang thob par 'gyur/ /gang zhig 'di na srid pa gsum gyi nyon mongs me 'jil bsam gtan ni/ /lha dang tshangs gnas mthar son rdzogs pa'i byang chub 'pho med thabs bsgoms la/ /gzhan gang 'di las tshig tsam thos shing thos nas kyang ni mos na 'di/ /bsam gtan las byung dge ba de las bsod nams ches mang thob par 'gyur/ /gang zhig sbyin pas longs spyod dag ni bsgrub byed cing /

/khrims kyis mtho ris sgom pas nyon mongs spongs byed la/ /shes rab nyon mongs shes bya kun spong de yi phyir/ /'di mchog nyid de de yi rgyu ni 'di thos yin/ /ces dang / 'khor gsum rnam par rtog pa gang / /de ni shes bya'i sgrib par 'dod/ /ser sna la sogs rnam rtog gang / /de ni nyon mongs sgrib par 'dod/ /shes rab las gzhan 'di dag ni/ /spong rgyu gzhan med de yis phyir/ /shes rab mchog yin de bzhi ni/ /thos pa de phyir thos pa mchog /ces dang / rgyal sras zhi ba lha'i zhal snga nas/ rgyal sras rnams kyis mi bslab pa'i/ /de ni gang na'ang yod min te/ /zhes dang / skyes rabs las/ thos pa gti mug mun sel sgron me yin/ /rkun po sogs kyi mi khyer nor gyi mchog /kun du rmongs pa'i dgra 'joms mtshon cha yin/ /thabs tshul man ngag ston pa'i grogs kyi mchog /phongs par gyur kyang mi 'gyur mdza' bo yin/ /gnod pa med pa'i mya ngan nad kyi sman/ /zhes bya ba la sogs pa gsungs pa ltar/ thos pa byas pa'i phan yon dpag tu med pa mkhyen te/ sems dpa' chen po dkon mchog byang chub pa'i drung du/ dka' chen bzhis thog drangs pa'i mtshan nyid kyi po ti bco lnga tsam gyi gzhung thugs la byang bar mdzad/ slob dpon pas/ 'dul ba mdo rtsa'i gzhung gi rgyugs gnon pa'i skabs su/ cung zad ma byang ba gcig gi dus/ phyag 'bebs mang po mdzad/ khyad par du dbu la glegs shing phog rma chen po byung / dus phyis kyang / dbu nad du song ba ltar bstan nas/ chos khri'i steng nas/ gsung chos gnang ba'i 'phro la/ dbu phyag gis tshir mdzad nas/ 'o skol gyi slob dpon pa des/ rgyag nyes cung zad byas pa'i skyon du gda'/ 'on kyang gzhung byang po 'di rnams khong gi sku drin yin/ der ma zad/ zas gos sogs kyi sgo nas/ slob gnyer gyi bdag rkyen mdzad pa la yang bsam gyi mi khyab pa zhig mdzad pas/ khong pa 'o skol la sku drin shin tu che ba lags pas/

dus phyis dge sbyor re tsam bgyis pa'i dge rtsa yang / khong gi dgongs pa rdzogs thabs su bsngo ba re byed kyi yod gsungs so/ /skye bo phal cher phan lan gnod pas 'jal/ /la la phan btags skye bo yal bar 'dor/ /dam pa khyod ni gnod lan phan pas sgrub/ /phan btags slob dpon spyi bor cis mi 'khur/ /zhes bya'o/ /de nas dgung lo bcu gcig lon pa'i dus/ dpal ldan sa skyar phar tshad gnyis kyi grwa bskor mdzad/ der rjes bzang ldan chos sder phebs dus/ dam pa 'di yi snyan grags/ byang pa'i bdag po 'jam dbyangs pas gsan nas/ dpon slob gnyis la/ ngam rings su byon gsungs pa'i bka' gnang phebs nas/ sku mdun du byon pas/ bdag po'i drung gis/ btsun chung khyod shes rab che ba'i grags pa shin tu che bar 'dug pas/ nged kyis kyang gzhung dkyur cig bgyid gsung nas/ rnam 'grel gyi don dam don byed nus pa gang zhes pa la/ bshad pa gyis gsungs/ sa bcad dang 'phros/ slob dpon rgyan chos mchog ya ma ri sogs kyi 'grel pa dang sbyar ba'i bshad pa mdzad/ phar phyin nas/ sems bskyed pa ni gzhan don phyir/ /zhes pa la bshad pa gyis gsungs/ sa bcad dang 'phros/ sems bskyed kyi bshad pa dang / khyad par du dbu sems gnyis kyi sems bskyed len tshul gyi khyad par sogs/ mkhas pa yid 'phrog pa'i bshad pa mdzad pas/ bdag po'i zhal nas/ lo legs kyi sa bon thebs tsam cig yod pa yin snyam pa byung ste/ lo legs kyi ljang pa phug ron nub tsam du sleb 'dug pa shin tu legs/ lo legs kyi 'bras bus bstan pa dang sems can la phan thogs pa gcig yong bar 'dug pas/ bar du le lo dang / btang snyoms sogs kyis sad ser ma byung ba gyis la/ 'bad pa thon gsungs nas/ dpon slob gnyis la nas zho do dang / sha khog drug gi gnang sbyin mdzad nas/ bzang ldan du brdzangs so/ /skye ba du mar legs par sbyangs pa'i mthus/ /tshe 'dir gzhon nu'i dus su yon tan rdzogs/

/snyan pa'i grags pas sa steng kun khyab pas/ /chos kyi rgyal pos lung bstan mnga' gsol mdzad/ /ces bya'o/ /de nas dgung lo bcu drug bzhes kyi bar/ bzang ldan chos sder/ gnyid dang rmugs pa dang / le lo thams cad khyad du bsad nas/ thos bsam la rtse gcig du 'bad par gda' zhing / de nas/ mtshungs med mkhas pa'i dbus na mkhas par grags/ /chos kyi rig pa chos min g.yul las rgyal/ /blo gros nam mkha'i khyon ltar rab yangs pa'i/ /yongs 'dzin mkhas pa'i dbang po chos kyi rje/ /mtshungs med chos kyi blo gros pa/ shar sku 'bum pa'i 'chad nyan gyi mthil len la bzhugs nas/ 'chad rtsod rtsom gsum gyi sgo nas/ sangs rgyas kyi bstan pa nyin mo ltar gsal bar mdzad pa'i snyan grags kyis/ thugs yid phrogs nas/ the tshom thams cad spangs/ dka' spyad kyi sdug bsngal thams cad khyad du bsad nas/ mkhas pa de'i drung du/ 'byon par bzhed pa dang / khyad par du yang / mdo sdud pa las/ bla ma mkhas pa rnams la rtag tu bsten par bya/ /ci phyir zhes na mkhas pa'i yon tan de las 'byung / /de dag shes rab pha rol phyin pa rjes su ston/ /sangs rgyas chos rnams dge ba'i bshes la bsten to zhes/ yon tan kun gyi mchog mnga' rgyal ba de skad gsungs/ /zhes dang / bsam pa drag ldan mkhas pas nga rgyal nges bcom ste/ /nad pa'i tshogs kyis gso phyir sman pa brten pa ltar/ /g.yel ba med par dge ba'i bshes gnyen bsten par bya/ /zhes gsungs pa dang / mdo sde rgyan las/ bshes gnyen dul ba zhi ba nyer zhi ba/ /yon tan lhag par brtson byas lung gis phyug /de nyid rab tu rtogs la smra mkhas ldan/ /brtse ba'i bdag nyid skyo ngal spangs la brten/ /zhes dang / spyod 'jug las/ rtag par dge ba'i bshes gnyen ni/ /theg chen don la mkhas pa dang / /byang chub sems dpa'i brtul zhugs mchog /srog gi phyir yang mi gtang ngo / /ces gsungs pa dang / dge ba'i bshes gnyen ji ltar bsten pa'i tshul yang /

mdo sde rgyan las/ bkur bsti rnyed pa dag dang rim gro dang / /sgrub pa'i sgo nas bshes gnyen bsten par bya/ /brten gzhi de bzhin blo ldan chos la ni/ /shes bsam dus su 'dud pas bshes gnyen sgrod/ /ces dang / spyod 'jug las/ dpal 'byung ba'i rnam thar las/ bla ma brten pa'i tshul ltar bslab/ /ces gsungs pa ltar/ mtshan nyid dang ldan pa'i dge ba'i bshes gnyen thams cad/ mnyes pa'i rgyu thams cad kyis mnyes par byed dgos dgongs nas/ thog mar mtshungs med chos blo'i drung du/ sde snod phyogs kyi gsung rab rab 'byams la gsan sbyongs mdzad pa'i skabs su/ grogs mched blo nye ba dag na re/ khyed kyi thugs rab khyad 'phags 'di la/ re zhig la po ti gnyis gsum la/ brtsal du ston pa'i slob gnyer byas na/ bskyed che bar 'dug ste zer ba byung yang / gzhung mang po sngar nas byang po byas yod pa'i gnad kyis/ chos gsung tshad gsan pas/ gzhan shes rab che che rnams kyis/ po ti re re gnyis gnyis la brtsal du ston pa'i blo bskyed las/ 'o skol gyis gsung rab mang po nyan pa/ tha dad nas tshig don gnyis kha byang bar byung gsungs so/ /snyan bskul 'debs mkhan dag la 'di ltar bya ste/ dam pa 'di yis chos kun mkhyen mod kyis/ /'jig rten mthun 'jug slad du slob tshul ston/ /rang rgyab bkab nas snyan bskul byed pa 'di/ /nam mkha' la ni 'dom gyis 'jal ba 'dra/ /zhes brjod do/ /de bas na mtshungs med chos blo ba de/ sde snod kyi phyogs la sku drin shin tu che bas/ sku gshegs pa nas bzung ste/ deng sang gi bar la tshe gsum mchod pa'i gzhi brten/ khang gsar ba'i grwa tshang du btsugs nas/ tshe gsum mchod pa zla ba byung ngo cog la ma chag pa byed kyi yod pa lags so/ /de nas mkhan chen dpal rgyal ba/ lho pa thugs rje dpal ba/ mkhan chen chos dpal mgon po sogs/ gtsang phyogs na bzhugs pa'i dge ba'i bshes gnyen chen po rnams la/

nges don phyogs kyi bshad pa phugs thag chod pa gsan no// ༈ //lnga pa bshad pas mkhas pa'i dbus su bstod pa ni/ sangs rgyas kyi bstan pa bshad pa'i sgo nas rgyas par bya ba'i phyir du/ bod kyi rdo rje gdan dpal ldan sa skyar/ phar tshad gnyis ma gtogs pa'i po ti bcu gsum gyi grwa bskor mdzad de/ bshad pa nyi ma'i 'od zer gyis/ mkhas mang blo gsal rnams kyi blo gros kyi pad tshal rgyas par mdzad do/ /de nas lung bstan brnyes pa'i gdan sa/ dpal ldan sna thang du byams chos lnga/ tshad ma mdo rnam 'grel/ rig gter/ mngon pa gong 'og gnyis/ 'dul ba mdo rtsa/ dbu ma rtsa 'jug bzhi gsum/ spyod 'jug rnams kyi grwa bskor mdzad/ khyad par du sangs rgyas kyi bstan pa'i rtsa ba/ 'dul ba mdo rtsa ba/ rgya gar gyi bshes gnyen rnam pa bzhi'i 'grel pa dang sbyar ba'i bshad pa phu thag chod pa mdzad cing / gnas de bka' gdams pa'i grwa sar 'dug pas/ spyod 'jug la/ jo bo'i lam sgron dang bstun pa'i lam rim bsgrigs pa'i bshad pa mdzad pas/ drung mkhan chen pas thog drangs/ dge ba'i bshes gnyen rnams thugs dges nas/ tshogs su bzhugs gdan spar te/ za 'og gnyis rtsegs byas shing / tshogs kyi dbus su bstod do/ /der gzim khang gong 'og nas/ na bza' re'i gnang sbyin dang / zur chos pa rnams kyis kyang ja 'dren/ dpe cha/ lha rten/ ras yug ske rags sogs kyi 'bul ba gya nom pa mdzad nas/ khong rnams na re/ bla ma bka' bcu pa khyed kyi bshad pa de rnams khyad par 'phags shing / khyad par du/ jo bo'i zhal nas mi gzhan rnams 'dul ba 'di theg dman gyi chos su 'dod pa 'dug ste/ kho bo'i lugs la/ theg pa kun gyi gzhi yin zhes gsungs pa ltar/ theg pa kun gzhi dam chos 'dul ba'i bshad pa de dang / nged kyi grwa pa dang bstun pa'i spyod 'jug gi bshad pa de la/ lhag par yang rjes su yi rang ces bstod do/ /drung mkhan chen pa'i zhal nas da rang res 'dir grwa bskor ni legs par grub byung /

'di nas gang la phebs rgyu yin gsungs/ bdag nyid chen po'i zhal nas/ bdag dbus phyogs la 'gro 'dod pa lags na'ang / /mgo nad thu mo rang gcig yod pa 'di bcos pa la/ /rtogs ldan nam mkha'i rnal 'byor bya ba gcig /rta nag phyogs na bzhugs kyi yod gda' bas/ /re zhing nad 'di bcos pa la/ khong gi spyan sngar phyin na bsam pa yod lags zhus pas/ drung mkhan chen pa na re/ bdag chen ta yi si tu la/ a tsa ra gcig gis phul/ bdag chen gyis nged la phal ba'i mgo nad bcos pa'i man ngag zab mo yod pas nged kyis bcos kyi gsungs nas/ zhag lnga drug gcig drung du bsdad pas/ mgo nad rtsa ba nas thon snyam pa byung gsungs so /de nas dbus phyogs kyi chos sde rnams su bshad pa'i dga' ston 'gyed pa dang / chos rje rong chen pa/ bzang pa blo rgyal pa sogs la mjal bar bzhed nas/ dpal gyi rtse thang / gsang bde gung gsum rnams su grwa bskor mdzad pa'i tshe/ bshad pa'i nyes pa thams cad dang bral zhing / yon tan thams cad dang ldan pa'i sgo nas bshad pa mdzad pa yin la/ de la bshad pa'i nyes pa ni/ ngag bul ba dang / gzhan gyi mi go ba dang / skabs su ma bab pa'i ngag rjod pa dang / ma nges pa brjod pa dang / the tshom mi gcod pa dang / ma rtogs log rtog gi nyon mongs dang bral bar mi byed pa dang / bshad pa la yid skyo ba dang / bshad pa la ser sna byed pa rnams so/ /bshad pa'i yon tan ni/ ngag gsal ba/ myur ba/ gzhan gyi rnar snyan pa/ gzhan gyis go ba/ skabs su bab pa'i don brjod pa/ rang gzhan gyis nges pa'i don brjod pa/ the tshom gcod pa dang / ma rtogs log rtog gi dri ma dang bral bar byed pa dang / bshad pa la skyo ngal med pa dang / bshad pa la ser sna med pa'i sgo nas/ bshad pa mdzad pas/ chu 'dzin dang bral ba'i mkha' la nyi ma shar ba bzhin du/ mkhas pa rnams kyi dbus na lham me lhan ne lhang nger gyur pa yin te/ mdo sde rgyan las/ le lo dang ni mi go dang /

/skabs mi 'byed dang ma nges dang / /the tshom dag ni mi gcod dang / /de dang bral bas bstan mi byed/ /skyo ba dang ni ser sna nyid/ /'di dag gtam gyi nyes par 'dod/ /de dag med phyir sangs rgyas kyi/ /bshad pa bla na med par 'gyur/ /zhes dang / de ltar blo bzang skyo ba med ldan brtse ba can/ /snyan par rab grags cho ga bzang zhes ldan pa ni/ /byang chub sems dpa' legs par smras pa yin pa ste/ /bshad pas skye bo'i dbus na nyi ma bzhin du lham/ /zhes gsungs pa dang mthun no/ /khyad par du rtse thang pa'i chen po dag po 'od zer seng ge bas/ khong dge ba'i bshes gnyen chen po yin pa dang / dregs pa che ba'i stobs kyis/ grwa bskor ba gzhan rnams la bzhugs nas lan 'debs mdzad kyi 'dug kyang / dam pa 'di la bzhengs nas lan 'debs mdzad de/ kho bo dang gangs pa she'u longs pas rgyal ba yin pas/ rang re grwa bskor ba dge bshes shin tu bzang ba 'dug pa 'di la/ bkur bsti yin/ tshogs 'di grol 'phral la/ gsol ja drangs nas rnyed pa gcig yang 'bul/ de ltar byas pas/ 'gro ba'i sdug bsngal sman gcig po/ /bde ba thams cad 'byung ba'i gnas/ /bstan pa rnyed dang bkur bsti dang / /bcas te yun rings gnas gyur cig /ces pa'i don tshang yong ba yin zer/ de nas/ tshad ma'i rkyen gsum gyi skabs su bgro gleng byas pas/ dag po 'od zer seng ge ba chos mthun gyi sgo nas pham par byas so/ /tshogs gyes 'phral du ja 'dren dang / khams dar ser po yug gcig gi gnang sbyin yang mdzad nas/ nged kyi grwa pa rtse thang 'dir thugs 'gro bar gda' ye/ nga yi dgos kyis grwa tshang 'dir/ khyed 'chad nyan la bzhugs dgos zer ba byung yang / khas ma blangs gsungs so/ /gsang phur/ gling stod smad bsre ba dang / tshogs bsog pa mdzad de/ rtsod pa seng ge'i nga ros/ phas rgol gyi wa tshogs mtha' dag skrag par mdzad do/ /de nas/ mkhas pa rat+na shrī la/

tshad ma mkhas nyan mdzad/ chos rje rong chen pa la/ phar phyin mkhas nyan mdzad/ chos rje bzod pa'i drung du/ mngon pa gong 'og dang / theg bsdus la mkhas nyan mdzad/ chos rje'i zhal nas/ kho bo la mngon pa'i chos bskor 'di rnams/ chos rje chos dpal mgon pos thugs dges bzhin du gnang nas/ khyod la mngon pa'i skor la 'phrin las che ba yong bar 'dug gsungs pa'i lung bstan gcig byung / de ltar du kho bos kyang chos mngon pa bdag po'i lag du 'phrod pas/ 'chad nyan gyi sgo nas spel zhig gsungs pa la brten nas/ dam pa 'di yang / mngon pa'i 'chad nyan la thugs legs par 'gro ba dang / theg bsdus dang / mngon pa mdzod la ṭi ka yang mdzad do/ /mkhan chen pad ma bzang po la/ dus 'khor rgyud 'grel gyi bshad pa gsan/ mtshal min chos rje la/ 'jam dbyangs dkar po dang / rdo rje phag mo'i rjes gnang gsan no/ /de nas jo bo'i drung du byon nas/ mchog gi sprul sku dngos su gzigs te/ yan lag bdun pa phul nas smon lam btab pas/ jo bo'i thugs kha nas 'od zer sna lnga byung nas/ dam pa 'di'i thugs khar thim pas/ rnam rtog thams cad rang 'gags la song nas/ bde stong gi ting nge 'dzin la yun ring po'i bar du 'byams so/ /de nas ting nge 'dzin de las bzhengs te/ da lan nas dkon mchog gi byin rlabs kyis thub pa'i dbang po dang thugs rgyud gcig tu 'dres pa'i nyams gcig byung / des na dus gsum gyi sangs rgyas thams cad kyi rnam par mi rtog pa'i ting nge 'dzin thams cad gcig yin par/ mdo sde rgyan las gsungs pa la nges shes skyes nas/ mdo sde rgyan las/ rlung dag sa'i 'og tu ma song la/ /gnas rnams tha dad chu yang tha dad la/ /chu yang chung zhing bya ba tha dad byed/ /chu gnas srog chags phra mo'i nyer spyad 'gyur/ /rgya mtshor song bar gyur na thams cad kyang / /gnas rnams gcig cing chu yang che la gcig /bya ba gcig cing chu la gnas pa yi/

/srog chags mang po'i rtag tu nyer spyad che/ /sangs rgyas nyid du ma zhugs brtan pa rnams/ /rten kyang tha dad blo gros tha dad cing / rtogs chung rang gi bya ba tha dad la/ sems can nyung don rtag tu nyer spyad 'gyur/ /sangs rgyas nyid du zhugs na de dag kun/ /rten yang gcig cing rtogs pa che la gcig /mdzad pa gcig tu 'dres shing rtag par yang / /sems can tshogs che'i nye bar spyad pa che/ /zhes gsungs pa de wal gyis dran gsungs so /de la 'di ltar bstod de/ mchog gi sprul pa shākya mu ne yi/ /thugs kha'i 'od zer rang gi lus la thim/ /dus gsum sangs rgyas dgongs pa thugs la 'khrungs/ /'jam dbyangs dus gsum sangs rgyas de la 'dud/ /ces so/ /de nas/ 'phags pa 'jig rten dbang phyug rigs ldan pad ma dkar po'i sprul pa/ chos rje kun mkhyen chen po'i sku lder gyi drung du byon pas/ kun mkhyen chen po'i sku lder de'i thugs ka nas/ rang 'dra'i bla ma dpag tu med pa 'phros te/ lha sa sde bzhi'i gnas thams cad khengs/ slar tshur 'dus nas/ de nyid kyi thugs kar thim zhing / spyan gtsug tor 'khor los bsgyur ba'i lta stangs mdzad nas/ yi ge med pa'i brda/ chos du ma ston pa gzigs dus/ smra ru med pa'i nyams rtogs dpag tu med pa 'khrungs nas/ lus nyams dang / ngag nyams/ sems nyams sogs rang dbang med par byung dus/ chos rgyus med pa'i gang zag la la na re/ dge bshes 'di smyo ba yin pa 'dra zer/ 'ga' zhig na re/ gza' skyon byung ba yin pa 'dra zer/ de'i tshe/ bar snang la sgra gcig grags pa ni/ kun rdzob chos kun snang grags tsam du zad/ /don dam 'od gsal 'gyur med brtan gyis skyabs/ /lus sems gnad du bsnun na mngon sum gsal/ bu khyod go bar gyis la nyams su longs/ ces grags so/ /de 'dra'i chos ston tshul ni/ lus can kun gyi bya dang ni/ /shing dang 'od zer thams cad dang / /nam mkha' las kyang chos kyi sgra/

/rgyun mi 'chad par thos par shog /ces pa'i smon lam sngon du song bas/ mdo sde rgyan las/ sems dpa' mchog gi ston pa ni/ /lung dang rtogs dang dbang 'byor dang / /kha dang gzugs ni thams cad dang / /nam mkha' las kyang 'byung ba yin/ /zhes gsungs pa ltar ro/ /'o skol gyi nyams rtogs de nas 'go tshugs byung zhing / kun mkhyen jo nang pa'i lta grub khyad par can 'di la'ang nges pa gting tshugs rnyed do/ /gsungs so/ /kun mkhyen dus gsum sangs rgyas mkha' la byon/ /yi ge med pa'i brda chos du ma bstan/ /brjod du med pa'i nyams rtogs dpag med 'khrungs/ /'jam dbyangs bla mas rjes bzung de la 'du/ /de nas sde sdong du/ tshogs sde bzhi'i sar grwa bskor la byon te/ dka' chen bzhi la bshad pa mdzad pas/ sku yi dkyil 'khor mi 'dar zhing / bzhin 'dzum bag dang ldan pa dang / lta bas chog mi shes shing / gser mdog ltar sdug pas/ 'gro ba kun gyi lta ba'i 'os su gyur pa/ gsung tshangs pa'i dbyangs ltar snyan zhing / tshig gi zur phyin pa dang / mi thab cing myur ba gsal ba dang / thugs bdag dang gzhan gyi gzhung lugs mthar phyin pa mkhyen pas/ 'jigs pa dang / bag tsha ba med cing / rnam dpyod kyi spobs pa brnyes pas tshogs sde bzhi'i rgya mtsho'i dbus na/ gser gyi lhun po ltar mngon par mtho bar gyur to/ /de'i tshe tshogs sde bzhi re res kyang / bla ma dka' bcu pa khyed re zhig nged kyi tshogs kyi phyag phyir gshegs/ de nas ring por mi thogs par mkhan po'i 'os su 'dug ces zhus kyang / tshogs gseb du 'gro bar khas ma blangs gsungs so /de dus rdzong nga la/ mkhan po bzhi pos gser zho re re/ zur chos pa rnams kyis/ snam bu/ ras kha/ dar kha/ phreng ba/ phor pa/ thur ma la sogs pa'i 'bul ba mang po mdzad gsungs so /sku yi spyod lam zhi zhing dul/ /legs bshad gtam gyis gzhan yid 'phrog /rnam dpyod spobs pa thog med mnga'/

/mdzad pa sangs rgyas bstan la dgongs/ /zhes so/ /de nas yar 'brog mngon dgar byon nas/ po ti bco lnga'i grwa skor mdzad pas/ gnang sbyin dang 'bul ba la/ snam bu khal rgyab non pa byung ba rnams kyang / phyogs kyi bla ma rnams la 'bul ba dang / ngan long ma nus pa rnams la ltos pa med par sbyin pa sogs mdzad do/ /gzhan yang de dag gi skabs su/ skyes bu dam pa'i spyod pa 'dod pa chung zhing chog shes pa dang / sems can sdug bsngal gyis gzir ba gzigs pa'i tshe/ sku lus kyi ba spu g.yo zhing / spyan chab bsil ba sogs mi bzod pa'i snying rje skye ba dang / sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa' rnams dang / sngon gyi grub thob gong ma rnams kyi rnam par thar pa la lhag par mos pa dang / dka' spyad la bzod pa dang / lus ngag yid gsum dge ba la yang dag par spyod pa sogs/ rigs sad pa'i rtags dang ldan te/ mdo sde rgyan las/ sbyor ba'i sngon du snying rje dang / /mos pa dang ni bzod pa dang / /dge la yang dag spyod pa ni/ /rigs kyi rtags su nges par bshad/ /ces gsungs pa ltar ro/ /'od gsal stong pa'i nam mkha' la/ /byams pa'i chu 'dzin rab 'khrigs shing / /snying rje'i char rgyun babs pa las/ /dge ba'i lo thog rgyas la 'dud/ /ces so/ /de nas jo bo'i phyag nas bzhugs pa'i gnas/ dpal ldan gna' rnying / legs bshad sgrog pa'i skyed tshal/ dpal 'khor sde chen gnyis su grwa skor mdzad do/ /de'i tshe na/ thos pa dang bsam pa bsgom pa gsum/ 'chad pa dang rtsod pa rtsom pa gsum/ mkhas pa dang btsun pa bzang ba gsum ste/ chos dgu tshan de'i khyad par gyi yon tan dang ldan par tshogs pa kun gyis mthun snang du grub dus/ chos kyi rgyal po rab brtan kun bzang 'phags pa'i zhal snga nas dang / bdag cag gi bla ma dam pa 'di nyid/ sngon bsam yas su mkhan po bo dhi satwa chos 'khor bskor ba'i dus su'ang yon mchod du gyur te/

gcig gis bdag ma 'ongs pa na nyang zhes bya ba'i lung pa ru sangs rgyas kyi bstan pa la bya ba byed par gyur cig ces smon lam btab bo/ /gcig gis bdag de'i dus dge 'dun gyi sde chen po btsugs te/ de'i bdag rkyen byed pa'i sbyin bdag chen por gyur cig ces pa'i sngon gyi smon lam gyi mthu dang / bdag nyid chen po 'di yi yon tan dang / 'phral gyi kun spyod sogs kyis thugs yid 'phrogs nas chos kyi rgyal po chen pos bdag nyid chen po la gsol ba/ khyed nged kyi chos sde 'dir 'chad nyan la cis kyang bzhugs dgos gsungs pa dang / zhal snga nas/ dus 'khor rtsa rgyud du/ gsum las dge slong mchog yin te/ ces dge slong rdo rje 'dzin pa slob dpon gyi mchog du bshad pa dang / dpal ldan a ti shas/ so sor thar pa rigs bdun du/ /de bzhin gshegs pas gsungs pa la/ /tshangs spyod dpal ni mchog yin te/ /dge slong sdom pa dag tu bzhed/ /ces dge slong gi sdom pa so thar gyi sdom pa'i mchog tu gsungs pa dang / bsnyen rdzogs ma thob par bstan pa rdzogs pa la 'jug tu mi rung bar dgongs nas/ bdag nyid chen pos/ chos rgyal chen po la/ bdag chos lung tshogs pa'i khrod du bsnyen rdzogs gcig byed pa dang / chos rje 'jam dbyangs rin chen rgyal mtshan pa'i drung du/ sdom gsum rab dbye gcig nyan pa la 'gro/ /der rjes bka' gnang dang du len par zhu ces zhus pas/ chos kyi rgyal po de nyid dges nas/ 'o na nged kyis/ chos rje rin po che'i drung du zhu yig dang / de bar gyi dgos pa'i chas kha'i bdag rkyen byed gsungs nas/ zhu yig rten bcas gsol ja 'bul dgos rnams la/ 'bul rgyu'i snam bu/ ras sogs mang po dang / bdag nyid chen po rang gi sku chas la dmigs pa'i gnang sbyin yang mdzad nas/ spos khang la 'byon par bzhed dus/ 'jam dbyangs rin chen rgyal mtshan pa'i rnal lam du/ lha'i bu du mas rol mo'i sgra dang /

gdugs dang rgyal mtshan sogs mchod pa'i bye brag bsam gyis mi khyab dang bcas te/ shar lho'i phyogs nas dge ba'i bshes gnyen paṇ+ḍi ta'i tshul du bzhugs pa gcig bar snang la spyan drangs nas/ spos khang du phebs/ bla brang du mjal kha zhu zer ba rmis bas/ snga dro nye gnas rnams la/ de ring rang re'i 'dir mjal kha dgos zer ba su byung yang / ma 'gor ba gtong rgyu yin no ces bka' sgos/ gung tshigs kyi dus/ bdag nyid chen po 'di skyel mkhan 'u lag dang bcas te/ bla brang gi sgo mdun du phebs/ nye gnas rnams kyis kyang gsung ba bzhin 'gor med du gdan drangs so/ /der 'jam pa'i dbyangs rin chen rgyal mtshan pas mkhan po mdzad/ mkhan chen byang chub sems dpa' chen po zla ba blo gros pas las kyi slob dpon mdzad/ mkhan chen rgyal ba phyag na bas/ gsang ste ston pa mdzad nas dge slong gi dge 'dun grangs tshang ba'i dbus su/ dgung lo sum cu pa'i dus bsnyen par rdzogs pa'i sdom pa nos so/ /dus de nas bzung ste/ 'dul ba lung sde bzhi'i tshig don ma lus pa thugs su chud pa'i sgo nas/ bcas pa dang rang bzhin gyi kha na ma tho ba'i nyes pa phra zhing phra ba rnams kyis kyang ma gos pa'i 'phags pa nye ba 'khor gnyis pa lta bur gyur to/ /zhugs la rdzogs pa dge slong sdom pa yi/ /phan yon mdo rgyud bstan bcos rnams las bshad/ /mthong nas 'jam pa'i dbyangs sogs mkhan slob ni/ /grangs tshang dbus su bsnyen rdzogs bslab pa nos/ /'dul ba lung gi tshig don ma lus pa/ /thugs su chud nas bcas rang nyes pa ni/ /phra zhing phra bas ma gos nye ba 'khor/ /gnyis pa lta bur gyur la gus phyag 'tshal/ /de nas 'jam dbyangs rin chen rgyal mtshan pa'i drung du sdom gsum rab dbye la sogs pa'i dpal ldan sa skya pa'i chos skor mang po gsan no/ /der zla ba gsum bzhugs nas/ chos rgyal chen po'i bka' gnang bzhin dpal 'khor sde chen du phebs dus khang gsar ba'i 'chad nyan gzhung las dang bcas pa'i khur lo bzhi bsnams so/

/de'i lo dang po la/ mtshungs med chos kyi blo gros pa 'chad nyan gyi 'phrin las shin tu che ba'i stobs kyis/ bu slob dka' bcu smra ba la'ang brgya phrag rgal ba yod kyang / phyogs thams cad las rnam par rgyal ba bdag nyid chen po 'di las lhag pa med pas/ sa skya'i shar sku 'bum pa'i gzhung las dang / dpal 'khor sde chen gyi 'chad nyan gzhi mthun mdzad dgos ces/ shar pa dpon slob sbyin bdag phyogs gtogs dang bcas pa rnams kyis bka' gnang dang / gsol ba rtse gcig tu btab pa la brten nas dpal ldan sa skya'i dbyar chos dus/ gzhung las la phebs/ de'i ston chos la/ chos rje chos blo ba dpon slob rnams dang phyogs mthun du bsing shong du chos 'khor sgang du bzhugs so/ /dgun chos la dpal 'khor sde chen du phebs/ der rjes dpyid chos lo gnyis bsam gling du mdzad/ lo gcig srad phyogs su mdzad do// ༈ //drug pa gdan sa mdzad tshul ni/ der rjes sngon gyi smon lam gyi mthu dang / bla ma dam pa 'jam pa'i dbyangs rin chen rgyal mtshan pas/ bdag chen chos kyi rgyal po la/ chos sde chen po'i chos dpon la/ bdag nyid chen po 'di 'os/ de'i rgyu mtshan yang / rang re shar kha pa 'khyag khrom chu las skyes pa bzhin/ dpal ldan sa skya pa'i bka' drin las skyes pa yin pas/ 'dir gdan sa la bkod dgos kyang / sa skya pa'i dge bshes gcig dgos pa de'ang / 'di la tshang bar 'dug ces sogs du ma zhal ta gnang ba dang / yi dam gyi lha mo rje btsun sgrol mas kyang yang yang du bskul ba dang / bstan srung chen po mahā ka la 'khor bcas kyis kyang / mthun rkyen bsgrubs nas/ dgung lo sum cu so bzhi bzhes pa'i/ chu pho byi ba shar pa'i dus/ khyab bdag rdo rje 'chang dang dbyer ma mchis pa chos rje dpal ldan legs pa'i zhal snga nas/ rdo rje slob dpon bdag po chen po'i dbang bskur/ bdag chen chos kyi rgyal pos/ rje btsun sa skya paṇ+ḍi ta'i chos dung dang /

sku gsung thugs kyi rten/ ber thul gyis thog drangs pa'i na bza'i 'bul ba/ ja sigs dang kar ltang gis thog drangs pa'i dos dang / ras snam bu la sogs pa'i 'bul ba'i tshogs dpag tu med pa phul lo/ /brtan gcig pa'i brtul zhugs 'dzin pa'i byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po mkhan chen zla ba blo gros pa'i zhal snga nas gtso bo mdzad/ dpal ldan chos lung tshogs pas rab gnas dang bkra shis kyi mnga' gsol mdzad/ chos grwa dpal 'khor sde chen gyi gdan sa chen por phyag phebs so/ /smon lam dag pa'i ser bus bskyod/ /lung bstan rta bdun gyis drangs nas/ /'jam dbyangs bstan pa'i nyi ma de/ /dpal 'khor sde chen gling du shar/ /zhes so/ /bdun pa chos 'khor bskor nas gzhan don mdzad tshul gnyis las/ phar phyin theg pa'i sgo nas rjes su bzung tshul ni/ yon tan kun gyi gzhi rten tshul khrims yin te/ legs par gsungs pa'i chos 'dul ba las/ khrims ni rgyu dang mi rgyu'i sa bzhin du/ /yon tan kun gyi gzhi rten legs par gsungs/ /zhes dang / brtsam par bya zhing dbyung bar bya/ /sangs rgyas bstan la 'jug par bya/ /'dam bu'i khyim na glang chen bzhin/ /'chi bdag sde ni gzhom par bya/ /gang zhig rab tu bag yod pas/ /chos 'dul 'di la dpyad byas na/ /skye ba'i 'khor lo rab spangs nas/ /sdug bsngal tha ma byed par 'gyur/ /zhes gsungs pa ltar/ grwa tshang so so nas/ rgya mtsho tha dad kyi grwa pa bskul te/ 'khor ba'i sdug bsngal mtha' dag dang bral nas/ mya ngan las 'das pa'i bde ba chen po thob pa'i phyir du/ dang por dam pa'i chos 'dul ba la 'jug par mdzad de/ rab byung dang bsnyen rdzogs zhu mkhan dpag tu med pas nyin mtshan dus 'da' ba yun ring po'i bar du byung ngo / /bdag nyid chen po 'di/ mkhan slob gang mdzad kyang / chos rje bu'i las chog chen po tshig phyed kyang ma 'khrul ba thugs la mnga' bas/ tshig don legs par brda sprad pa'i sgo nas sdom pa phog ste/

thos pa mi nyams par bsrungs tshul yang / sdom pa'i mi mthun phyogs ngo shes pas bsrung ba dang / rang gi bsam pa'i sgo nas bsrung ba dang / gnas la gnas pa'i sgo nas bsrung ba dang / bslab pa yongs su sbyang pa'i sgo nas bsrung ba dang / bde ba'i rkyen rten pa'i sgo nas bsrung ba dang lnga'o/ /dang po ni/ rtsa ba dang yan lag gi bsrung bya'i mi mthun phyogs mtha' dag ngo shes par byed pa'o/ /gnyis pa ni/ dran shes bzhin bag yod dang ldan pa'i sgo nas/ 'khor ba'i nyes dmigs bsam pa/ myang 'das kyi yon tan bsam pa/ tshul khrims rnam par dag pa'i phan yon bsam pa/ tshul khrims ma dag pa'i skyon bsam pa/ dge sbyong gi 'du shes dran pa la sogs pa'i sgo nas bsrung ba'o/ /gsum pa ni/ de la gnas mtshan nyid dang ldan pa ni/ sum brgya pa las/ tshul khrims ldan zhing 'dul ba'i cho ga shes/ /nad pa snying brtse 'khor ni dag pa dang / /chos dang zang zing phan 'dogs la brtson pa/ /dus su 'doms pa de nyid bla mar bsngags/ /zhes so/ /gnas pa slob ma'i mtshan nyid ni/ bla ma la gus tshul khrims yong dag cing / bsam brtan dang ni 'don la rab tu brtson/ /grims zhing dul la bzod dang ldan pa ste/ /sdom brtson gnas pa'i chos ldan shes par bya/ /zhes gsungs pas/ gnas mtshan nyid dang ldan pa'i drung du/ gnas pa mtshan nyid dang ldan pas/ bya ba mtshan nyid dang ldan pa zhus nas bsgrubs na/ ljon shing chen po'i yal 'dab ltar/ yon tan gong nas gong du 'phel zhing rgyas par 'gyur ba yin pas/ de bzhin du gyis gsungs/ bzhi pa ni/ gso sbyong / dbyar gnas/ dgag dbye'o/ /gso sbyong la/ dbye ba/ ngo bo/ grangs nges/ dgos pa/ gnas dang / dus dang / cho ga dang / byin rlabs/ nges tshig la sogs pa'i rnam bzhag mang du gsungs kyang mdor bsdus na/ sbyang bya bslab pa rin po che gsum la/ sbyong byed gso sbyong gnyis su nges te/ 'dul ba las/ dge ba dag ni yongs su gso byed cing /

/sdig pa dag ni yongs su sbyong byed pa/ /dge gso sdig pa yongs su sbyong byed pas/ /mkhas pas gso sbyong zhes ni nges par bshad/ /ces bshad do/ /dbyar gnas ni/ gnas phun sum tshogs par/ dus dbyar zla 'bring po'am/ tha chung nas/ yun zla ba gsum gyi bar du/ sbyor dngos rjes gsum gyi cho ga phun sum tshogs pas blangs nas/ dgos pa/ gzhan ma dad pa spang pa dang / don bya ba mang po spang pa dang / rang gzhan gyi srog la gnod pa spang ba dang / klog pa thos bsam dang / spong ba bsam gtan 'phel ba la sogs pa'i dgos pa du ma yod do gsung ngo / /dgag dbye ni/ ston tha 'bring po 'am/ tha chung gi nya la/ sbyor dngos rjes gsum tshang ba'i cho ga rnam dag byas pas/ dgos pa tshul khrims kyi yon tan gong nas gong du 'phel zhing / chos tshugs bzang por 'gyur ba la sogs pa'i dgos pa khyad par can yod do gsungs so/ /lnga pa bde bar gnas pa'i rkyen rten pa ni/ gos las gyur pa dang / zas las gyur pa dang / snod spyad las gyur pa dang / yo byad las gyur pa dang / rung khang las gyur pa'o/ /gos las gyur pa la'ang / 'tsho ba'i yo byad bcang tshul dang / mkho ba'i yo byad bcang tshul/ lhag pa'i yo byad la ji ltar bya ba'i tshul lo/ /dang po ni/ snam sbyar/ bla gos/ thang gos la sogs pa bcu gsum/ rgyu kha dog dbyibs sogs kyi sgo nas rung tshad ldan/ sbyor dngos rjes gsum gyi cho gas byin gyis brlabs pa'o/ /mkho ba'i yo byad kyang / zhwa dang / ska rags dang / gtor bu la sogs pa yid kyis byin gyis brlab pa'o/ /lhag pa'i yo byad/ bcu gsum po lhag po yod pa kun gzhan la dmigs nas byin gyis brlabs pa'o/ /zas las gyur pa'i bde ba'i rkyen rten pa'ang / zas la sred pa'i 'du shes spangs nas/ sbyin bdag gi tshogs rdzogs par bya ba'i phyir dang / tshangs par spyod pa yun ring du gnas par bya ba'i phyir la sogs par/ byin len tshul bzhin du byas/

za lugs tshul bzhin du longs spyad nas/ der rjes kha don dang / bsam gtan la sogs pa tshul bzhin du gyis gsungs so/ /snod spyad rten pa ni/ 'jig rten pa las thun mong ma yin pa'i snod/ rgyu dbyibs kha dog gsum gyi sgo nas rung tshad ldan gyi lhung bzed/ 'jig rten gyi chags zhen spangs nas 'tsho ba bsod snyoms la longs spyod pa'i snod dang / lhung bzed zas kyis bkang nas longs spyod pa bzhin du/ rang gi shes rgyud kyang yon tan gyis bkang nas longs spyod dgos zhes pa'i brdar 'chang dgos pa yin gyis/ mi tshe rang par lhung bzed med par/ thang phogs la longs spyod pa'i rab byung 'di rnams kyis thub pa'i bstan pa bshig bsam pa yod gsungs so/ /bde bar gnas pa'i rkyen nor bcang ba ni/ sbyin bdag dad pa can gyis phul ba'i nor/ dge 'dun gyis longs spyod pa'i don du byin gyis brlabs nas/ zhal ta pa mtshan nyid dang ldan pas bcang bar bya yi/ dge slong phyug po la la dag la mig ltos byas nas/ rang don du nor mang po 'tshags byed pa'i rab byung de bdud kyi dbang du song nyen yod gsungs so/ /bde bar gnas pa'i rkyen rung mang brten pa ni/ gzhi rtsod pa can la sogs pa ma yin pa'i gnas thams cad grub pa'am/ bgyis pa'am/ lag pa la sogs par sbyor dngos rjes gsum gyis byin gyis brlabs nas longs spyod par gyis shig mdor na spong byed gnyen po bdun gyis bsdus pa'i spang bya nyis brgya lnga bcu rtsa gnyis la sogs pa'i bslab bya rnams legs par shes nas/ blang dor gyi mig phyed par gyis shig dge slong dag zhes gsungs so/ dam pa rang nyid kyang tshul khrims rnam par dag pas 'phags pa nye ba 'khor lta bur mdzad do/ /rnam dag tshul khrims dri ngad phun tshogs kyis/ /nyon mongs dug gsum nad rnams zhi mdzad cing / /dge 'dun 'dus pa rgya mtsho'i gtsug gi rgyan/ /'jam dbyangs 'dul ba 'dzin la gus phyag 'tshal/

/zhes so/ /chos 'khor dang po bskor ba'i skabs 'dir/ skyes bu chung ngu dang / 'bring gnyis kyi lam la khrid par mdzad de/ de yang tshe 'di 'ba' zhig don du gnyer ba la/ dal 'byor rnyed dka' bsam pa dang / 'chi ba mi rtag pa bsam pa nyid kyis skyo bar byed la/ dal ba brgyad dang 'byor ba bcu dang ldan pa ni/ dal 'byor gyi chos bco brgyad do/ dal ba brgyad pa'i/ mi khom pa brgyad dang bral ba'o/ /mi khom pa brgyad ni/ ngan song gsum dang lha tshe ring po ni rang rgyud kyis bsdus pa'i mi khom pa bzhi yin la/ yul mtha' 'khob dang kla klor skye ba/ sangs rgyas mi bzhugs pa'i zhing khams stong par skye ba/ dbang po ma tshang ba/ lta bar log par 'dzin pa can ni/ gzhan rgyud gyis bsdus pa'i mi khom pa bzhi'o/ /'byor ba bcu ni/ rang 'byor lnga dang / gzhan 'byor lnga'o/ dang po ni/ mi lus thob pa/ yul dbus su skyes pa/ dbang po sgo lnga tshangs pa/ gnas la dad pa/ las kyi mtha' ma log pa'o/ /gzhan 'byor lnga ni/ sangs rgyas 'jig rten du byon pa/ des chos gsung ba/ bstan pa gnas pa/ bstan pa la zhugs pa/ snying brtse ba'i bshes gnyen gyis zin pa'am/ sbyin bdag gi bdag rkyen byed pa'o/ /de lta bu'i dal 'byor de rnyed par dka' ba'i rgyu mtshan ni/ dpe'i sgo nas rnyed par dka'/ ngo bo'i sgo nas snyed par dka'/ rgyu'i sgo nas rnyed par dka'/ grangs kyi sgo nas rnyed par dka' ba la sogs pa'i rgyu mtshan du ma gsungs zhing / dka' ba'i dal 'byor de yang rtag gam bsam na/ mi rtag ste/ tshe 'dus byas yin pa'i phyir na mi rtag tshe la gnon mkhan med cing 'bri mkhan yod pa'i phyir na mi rtag tshe ri gzar gyi chu'am/ rtsa rtse'i zil pa'am/ bar snang gi klog dang mtshungs pa'i dar tsam yud tsam 'di la/ don med tshe 'di'i bya ba bsgrub tu mi khom ste/ spyod 'jug las/ tshe 'di skad cig slu ba ste/ /lus 'di thang gcig brnyan po bzhin/

/zhes bshad do/ /de bas na/ da nang snga dro 'chi ba mi rtag pa yud tsam gcig bsgom pa ma byung na/ de ring nyin gang tshe 'di'i sar 'gro ba gcig 'dug pas/ dge sbyor gyi bskul ma la/ 'chi ba mi rtag pa bsgoms pa 'di rang 'chun che ba yin gsungs so /dal 'byor rnyed dka' 'chi ba mi rtag pa/ /bsam nas ngan song g.yang las sgrol ba'i lam/ /mi dge bcu spong dge bcu'i lam la 'god/ /'jam dbyangs chung ngu'i lam ston de la 'dud/ /ces so/ /shi nas ci med du mi 'gro ste/ dge mi dge'i las kyi dbang gis/ ngan song dang bde 'gro gang rung du skye dgos/ rigs drug gang du skyes kyang / sdug bsngal gyi rang bzhin las ma 'das so/ /'khor ba'i phun tshogs la zhen nas/ dam pa'i chos mi dran pa'i gnyen por/ las rgyu 'bras/ 'khor ba'i nyes dmigs sgom dgos la/ las rgyu 'bras kyi dbang du bgyis na/ las la ngo bo'i sgo nas sems pa'i las dang / bsam pa'i las gnyis/ las la 'byung ba'i sgo nas/ lus ngag yid gsum gyi las gsum mo/ /de re re la yang / dge mi dge lung ma bstan gyi las gsum gsum du phye bas dgu'o/ /las la sa'i sgo nas dbye na/ bsod nams dang bsod nams ma yin pa dang mi g.yo ba'i las gsum/ las la rnam grangs kyi sgo nas dbye na/ dkar la rnam par smin pa dkar ba'i las/ gnag la rnam par smin pa gnag pa'i las/ las dkar la rnam par smin pa gnag pa'i las/ las gnag la rnam par smin pa dkar ba'i las so/ /las la 'phen rdzogs kyi sgo nas dbye na/ 'phen byed dge bas 'phangs pa la rdzogs byed dge bas rdzogs pa dang / 'phen byed sdig pas 'phangs pa la rdzogs byed sdig pas rdzogs pa dang / 'phen byed dge bas 'phangs pa la rdzogs byed sdig pas rdzogs pa dang / 'phen byed sdig pas 'phangs pa la rdzogs byed dge bas rdzogs pa'o/ /las la 'bras bu 'byin tshul gyi sgo nas dbye na/ mthong chos la myong 'gyur/

skyes nas myong 'gyur/ lan grangs gzhan la myong 'gyur gyi las gsum mo/ /mdor na las mi dge ba chung ngu 'bring chen po gsum gyi dbang gis rim pa bzhin du/ dud 'gro yi dwags dmyal ba rnams su skye/ las dge ba chung ngu 'bring chen po gsum gyi dbang gi rim pa bzhin du/ lha ma yin mi dang lha rnams su skye ba yin pas/ sdig pa chung ngu la'ang 'dzem/ dge ba chung ngu nas kyang gsog dgos te/ mdo sde las brgya las/ lus can dag gi las rnams ni/ /bskal pa brgyar yang chud mi za/ /tshogs shing dus la bab pa na/ /'bras bu nyid du smin par 'gyur/ /zhes dang / byams pa chen po'i mdo las/ rnam rtog ma zad bar du las yod pas/ las kyi rnam par smin la yid ches bya/ zhes gsungs pa ltar/ 'o skol rnams kyis kyang las rgyu 'bras kyi blang dor la brtson par byed dgos gsungs/ jo bo rjes kyang mnga' ris su phebs dus/ las rgyu 'bras kyi rnam bzhag zhib tu bshad pas/ paṇ+ḍi ta las rgyu 'bras pa zhes grags pas/ jo bo rjes nas/ kho bo'i ming tsam gyis kyang bstan pa la phan pa 'dug gsungs pa de'i lung khungs su mdzad do/ /'khor ba'i nyes dmigs bsam pa la/ zag bcas kyi las ma zad kyi bar du/ srid rtse nas mnar med kyi bar rang dbang med par yang dang yang du 'khor ba ni/ 'khor ba spyi yi nyes dmigs yin la/ mdo dran pa nyer bzhag las/ sems can dmyal ba dmyal mes nyams/ /yi dwags bkres shing skom pas nyams/ /dud 'gro gcig la gcig zas nyams/ /mi rnams 'tsho ba thung bas nyams/ /lha dag bag med pa yis nyams/ /'khor ba khab kyi rtse mo la/ /bde ba nam yang yod ma yin/ /zhes gsungs pa ni/ 'khor ba bye brag gi nyes dmigs yin pas/ 'di rnams kyi gnas lugs legs par go na/ 'khor ba la nges par 'byung ba'i nges 'byung skyes nas/ 'khor ba'i sdug bsngal las grol ba'i thar pa la thob 'dod kyi blo rang dbang med par skye ba yin/

thar pa la gsum yod pa'i chung ngu nyan thos dang / 'bring rang rgyal gyi thar pa tsam don du gnyer zhing / de'i ched du lam bdag med rtogs pa'i shes rab nyams su len pa ni/ skyes bu 'bring gi lam rim yin no gsungs so/ /las 'bras 'khor ba'i nyes dmigs bsam byas nas/ /bdag 'dzin nyon mongs dgra las rnam rgyal ba'i/ /thar lam sgom pa skyes bu 'bring gi lam/ /ston mdzad 'jam dbyangs nges 'byung can la 'dud/ /ces so/ /de nas sngar grwa tshang so so'i slob dpon rnams kyi/ rab byung bsgrub pa'i srol yod na'ang / deng phyin chad bdag nyid chen po'i drung du ma gtugs pa'i rab byung sogs byed sa med pa'i bca' yig kyang mdzad do/ /skyes bu chen po'i lam ston tshul ni/ de'ang skyes bu 'bring gi lam man chad tsam gyis/ rang gzhan gyi don rdzogs par mi 'gyur zhing / 'bras bu mthar phyin pa yang mi thob pas/ de thob pa la theg pa chen po'i lam la 'jug dgos/ theg pa chen po'i lam gyi rtsa ba yang byang chub kyi mchog tu sems bskyed pa 'di yin la/ byang sems kyi sdom rgyud kyang chu rtsa gangs la thug pa gcig byung na dgongs nas/ chos rgyal chen po dang yon mchod bka' sgros su bstun nas/ 'bring mtshams kyi zar byang phug na/ sems dpa' chen po rgyal sras chos rdzong pa'i dngos slob/ sems dpa' chen po chos kyi rin chen pas rjes su bzung ba'i/ sems dpa' chen po rin chen 'bum pa zhes mtshan yongs su grags pa'i drung du byon nas/ sems tsam lugs dang / dbu ma lugs kyi sems bskyed/ byang sems gyi sdom pa/ theg pa chen po'i blo sbyong sogs gsan nas thugs su chud par mdzad de/ zla ba lnga tsam bzhugs pas/ byang chub kyi sems la nges shes brtan po rnyed nas/ mkha' mnyam sems can thams cad drin chen gyi pha ma sha stag yin par thag chod cing / 'di thams cad 'khor ba'i sdug bsngal las cis kyang sgrol dgos snyam pa'i thugs rje chen po thugs rgyud la 'khrungs te/

de nas slar yang chos sde chen mor phebs so/ /byang chub sems gnyis mthar phyin pas/ /nyid yum brtson 'grus sgrol ma dang / /'gro rnams tha dad mi rtog pa'i/ /sems dpa' chen po de la 'dud/ /mkha' mnyam sems can pha ma rnams/ /'khor ba'i sdug bsngal rgya mtsho las/ /bdag gis bsgral bya theg chen lam/ /sgom mdzad skyes bu chen po'i lam/ /skal ldan 'gro la dus su ni/ /ma dor ji bzhin 'doms pa la/ /da lta 'gran zla ma mchis pa'i/ /byams mgon gnyis pa de la 'dud/ /lta ba spangs kyang rnam dag lta bas rgyan/ /spyod pa spangs kyang rnam dag spyod pas mdzes/ /bdag med rtogs kyang bdag gzhan mnyam rjes 'byongs/ /'jam dbyangs lta spyod rnam dag de la 'dud/ /ces so/ /theg chen chos kyi 'khor lo bskor tshul rgyas par 'og tu rim bzhin brjod do/ /gnyis pa gsang sngags theg pa'i sgo nas smin grol mdzad tshul ni/ rnal 'byor bla med kyi rgyud la gsum yod pa'i/ gnyis med kyi rgyud/ dus kyi 'khor lo'i bskor ni/ ma 'ongs pa na sangs rgyas bdun pa rab gsal du 'gyur bar lung bstan pa'i/ grub chen kun dga' blo gros/ rgyal mtshan dpal bzang po/ zhal snga nas kyi drung du/ dpal dus kyi 'khor lo'i dbang bzhi yongs su rdzogs pa/ rdo rje slob dpon bdag po chen po'i dbang / dbang gong ma/ sbyor ba yan lag drug dang bcas pa gsan zhing nyams su blangs/ dus 'khor bsdus rgyud/ dbang mdor bstan/ chos rje bu'i ṭika dang bcas pa/ rdo rje snying 'grel/ bde mchog bstod 'grel/ 'grel chen dri med 'od/ kun mkhyen chen po yab sras kyi mchan dang bcas pa'i bshad bka' gsan zhing thugs su chud par mdzad do/ /sbyor drug gi man ngag u rgyan bsnyen sgrub kyi chos bskor la/ khrid ngo bo/ rdo rje rnal 'byor mas gsungs pa'i rtsa tshig rtogs ldan zla ba seng ges mdzad pa'i grub thob u rgyan pa'i rnam thar chung ba/

tshig rkang 'grel pa/ gegs sel rin chen phreng ba/ khrid yig dbyug chos/ 'pho ba gser srang ma/ lung sbyor bcu bdun ma/ sgrub chen gyi man ngag yi ge med pa'i snyan rgyud gser chos ma rnams kyi yig cha'i lung rnams kyang rje grub chen drung du gsan/ 'di rnams kyi sgo nas gdul bya skal ldan rjes su 'dzin tshul ni/ 'og tu go rim bzhin du rgyas par ston to/ /ma rgyud pha rgyud kyi skor la/ dpal kyai rdo rje'i dbang / gur rigs bsdus kyi dbang / rje btsun bdag med ma'i dbang / yab bka'i lus dkyil/ rtsa rgyud dpal brtag pa gnyis pa/ bshad rgyud rdo rje gur/ sam bu ṭi gsum gyi 'grel pa cha lag bcu gsum/ thun mong gi chos 'khor bcu bzhi/ bshad rgyud phyag rgya chen po thig le/ ye shes thig le/ snying po rnal 'byor ma/ de kho na nyid kyi sgrol ma/ rgyud bzhi dang bcas pa'ang / rje grub chen drung du gsan/ khyad par kyai rdo rje'i dbang gsan pa'i dus/ bla ma kyai rdo rje dngos su gzigs pa dang / gsung ngag rin po che gsan dus/ dmigs pa spod res kyi/ me tog gi char rgyun du babs pas/ bdag gi bla ma rdo rje 'chang chen po de gzhan dang mi 'dra bas yin ces gsungs kyang / chos gsan mkhan gyi slob ma rdo rje 'chang chen po 'di yang gzhan dang mi 'dra bas yin no/ /byin rlabs kyi skor la/ lam dus kyi dbang / bla ma'i rnal 'byor gyi byin rlabs/ yig brgya'i bzlas lung / aṣ+ṭa'i bzlas lung / bha ya na'i bzlas lung / bir bsrungs/ mkha' spyod ma/ brda don gsal ba/ dbang bzhi'i ngo sprod rnams kyang / rje grub chen drung du gsan no/ /phyag rgya chen po yi ge med pa'i byin rlabs dang khrid/ nag po pa'i gtum mo lam rdzogs dang yon po srong ba/ na ro mkha' spyod/ mai tri mkha' spyod/ ku ru kul+le'i rjes gnang sogs/ dpal ldan sa skya pa'i dmar po bskor gsum gyi rjes gnang sogs kyang rje grub chen drung du gsan/

gzhan dpal gsang ba 'dus pa'i skor la/ gsang 'dus mi bskyod rdo rje/ 'jam pa'i rdo rje/ gsang 'dus spyan ras gzigs la sogs pa'i dbang bka'/ gsang 'dus rim lnga la sogs pa'i 'khrid bka'/ gsang 'dus kyi rgyud/ 'grel pa sgron gsal/ 'jam dbyangs zhabs lung dgongs pa lung bstan la sogs pa'i bshad bka' ma lus pa yang rje grub chen drung du gsan no/ /ma rgyud kyi skor la/ bde mchog lo nag dril gsum/ mkha' 'gro rgya mtsho/ bde mchog lha lnga/ bde mchog dkar po/ bde mchog lhan skyes sogs kyi dbang bka' na ro chos drug ni gu chos drug la sogs pa'i khrid bka' sogs yang grub chen drung du gsan/ phyis ni gu chos drug sogs shangs pa bka' brgyud kyi chos skor tshang ma/ bsam sding rin po che'i drung du gsan zhing nyams su blangs gsungs so/ /rdo rje phag mo mngon 'byung / phag mo shes rab gsal byed ma/ phag mo khros ma nag mo la sogs pa'i phag mo'i skor gyi dbang rjes gnang byin rlabs la sogs pa ma lus pa dang / sgrol ma lha mangs/ sgrol ma nyer gcig ma/ sgrol ma lha bcu bdun ma/ sgrol ma dkar mo/ sgrol ma 'jigs pa brgyad skyob la sogs pa'i dbang rjes gnang la sogs pa ma lus pa dang / mahā mā yā/ sangs rgyas thod pa la sogs pa'i ma rgyud kyi skor yang ma lus pa/ rje grub chen drung du gsan/ rnal 'byor rgyud kyi sgor la/ sbyong rgyud dkyil 'khor bcu gnyis kyi bka'/ rnal 'byor dbyings rtse mo la sogs pa'i dbang / lung bka' bshad bka' phal che ba rnams rje grub chen drung du gsan/ chos skyong che chung la sogs pa'i skor gyi dbang / rjes gnang / byin brlabs/ man ngag dang bcas pa ma lus pa/ rje grub chen drung du gsan/ bya spyod kyi skor yang / phal che ba rje grub chen drung du gsan pa sogs rags bsdus bkod pa yin gyis/ rgyas par ni rje grub chen gyi gsan yig chen mo'i nang bzhin/

bum pa gang byo'i tshul gyis thob gsungs pas/ de'i nang bzhin du rgyud rigs dang bcas nas dgongs dgos kyi/ 'dir ni thams cad yi ger bris ma nus so/ /khyab bdag rdo rje 'chang dang dbyer ma mchis pa rtsa ba'i bla ma dpal ldan legs pa'i drung du/ rgyud 'bum gyi lung / gzungs 'dus kyi lung / rdo rje 'phreng ba'i bka'/ sgrub thabs rgya mtsho la sogs pa/ rgyud bzhis bsdus pa'i dbang bka'/ bshad bka'/ lung bka' lnga po zhig rje nyid kyi gsan yig nang bzhin/ bdag gis kyang thob zhes gsungs pas/ de dag gi brgyud pa la sogs pa de bzhin du shes par mdzad dgos so/ /gnyis pa/ da ni rdo rje theg pa'i sgo nas gdul bya smin tshul ni/ rgyud sde bzhi yang / phyi nang gi rgyud gnyis su 'dus pas/ phyi bya spyod rnal 'byor gyi rgyud gsum gyi sgo nas/ 'gro don mdzad tshul ni/ gdul bya dad pa dang snying rje che zhing / bla ma dang sngags la mos pa/ mchod pa la dga' zhing / khrus dang gtsang sbra la gtso bor 'dzin pa rnams la/ bya spyod rnal 'byor rnams bstan te/ dang po bya ba'i rgyud la mos pa'i gang zag rnams la/ bum pa chu'i dbang rjes gnang / rigs gtad rnams mdzad nas/ rigs gsum spyi dang bye brag gi rgyud/ gzungs/ rtog pa rnams bstan nas/ dam tshig la 'bad pas/ skye ba bdun nas rigs gsum gyi go 'phang thob pa la bkod do/ /spyod pa'i rgyud la mos pa'i gang zag rnams la/ rig pa'i dbang lnga/ sgrub thabs dam tshig spyod sdom rnams dang / rgyud rnam snang / sgyu 'phrul dra ba la sogs pa mang du bstan nas/ de dag gi spyod sdom dang / dam tshig sogs la 'bad pas/ skye ba lnga nas rigs bzhi'i go 'phang thob pa la bkod do/ /rnal 'byor gyi rgyud la mos pa'i gang zag rnams la/ rdor dbyings/ kun rig tshe dpag med/ gtsug dgu la sogs pa'i dbang bskur zhing / de dag gi dam tshig dang / spyod sdom rnams phyin ci ma log par ston pa/

de nyid 'dus pa la sogs pa'i rgyud rnams dang / sgrub thabs kyi cho ga gzhan rnams bstan nas/ dam tshig dang spyod sdom la 'bad pas/ skye ba gsum nas rigs lnga'i go 'phang thob pa la bkod do/ /sgo gsum spyod pa khrus dang gtsang sbra la/ /dga' ba'i gang zag rjes su bzung ba'i phyir/ /rjes gnang dbang lnga dam tshig spyod sdom bstan/ /'jam dbyangs rigs lnga'i thab tshul bstan la 'dud/ /ces so/ /gsum pa nang bla med ma rgyud pha rgyud gnyis med kyi rgyud gsum gyis 'gro don mdzad tshul ni/ gdul bya dad pa dang / snying rje dang / brtson 'grus dang / shes rab che ba/ gtong ba la dga' zhing / rnam rtog shas chung ba/ bla ma la sangs rgyas las lhag pa'i 'du shes yod pa rnams la/ ma rgyud lo nag dril gsum la sogs pa'i dbang bka'/ man ngag nag po'i chos drug dril bu skor gsum/ phyag rgya chen po'i skor/ na ro chos drug ni gu chos drug la sogs pa'i khrid dang / bde mchog rtsa rgyud/ bshad rgyud dang bcas pa/ bde mchog bstod 'grel dang bcas pa gsungs nas/ de dag gi dam tshig gi rnam bzhag rtsa ba'i ltung ba bcu bzhi/ yan lag gi ltung ba brgyad/ dbang bzhi so so'i rnam bzhag gi dam tshig rjes spyod kyi dam tshig bza' ba'i dam tshig bsrung ba'i dam tshig mi 'bral ba'i dam tshig la sogs pa'i bsrungs tshul/ bsrungs pa'i phan yon/ ma bsrungs pa'i nyes dmigs/ nyams na phyir bcos pa la sogs pa'i rnam bzhag kyang zhib la rgyas pa gsungs so/ /gzhan yang kyai rdo rje'i dbang dang / rdo rje bdag med ma'i dbang bskur nas/ de dag gi man ngag lam 'bras cha lag dang bcas pa/ rtsa rgyud brtag pa gnyis pa/ bshad rgyud rdo rje gur/ saṃ bu ṭi rnams gsungs nas/ mdor na sbyang gzhi bde gshegs snying po'i steng du sbyang bya zag bcas nyer len phung po rnams/ sbyong byed smin byed kyi dbang bzhi dang / rim gnyis zab mo'i lam gyis sbyangs pa las/

sbyangs 'bras 'od gsal chos sku rdzogs par mngon du gyur nas/ tshe 'di nyid la drug pa rdo rje 'chang chen po'i go 'phang thob pa la bkod do/ /de yang / lus dag pa sprul pa'i sku/ ngag dag pa longs sku/ yid dag pa chos sku/ khams byang sems dag pa ngo bo nyid skur ngo sprod par mdzad do/ /gang zhig bskal pa lhag pa'i gdul bya'i rgyud/ /sbyang gzhi chos nyid sbyang bya dri ma'i tshogs/ /dbang dang rim gnyis zab mo'i chu yis 'khrud/ /'jam dbyangs khrus legs mdzad la gus pas 'dud/ /pha rgyud kyis 'gro don mdzad tshul ni/ pha rgyud kyis 'dul ba'i gdul bya rnams la/ dpal gsang ba 'dus pa'i dbang bskur nas/ de'i man ngag sgyu lus 'od gsal rtsa rlung gtso bor ston par byed pa'i mgon po klu sgrub kyi rim lnga/ de'i don 'grel pa/ ār+ya de wa'i spyod bsdus sgron ma/ bdag byin rlabs/ mngon par byang chub pa'i rim pa/ sems kyi sgrib sbyong la sogs pa rdzogs rim kyi man ngag mang po dang / klu sgrub kyi dbang chog nyi shu pa/ klu'i byang chub kyi cho ga nyi shu pa/ sgra gcan 'dzin bzang po'i dbang chog bskyed rim/ mdo byas/ mdo bsre/ rnam bzhag rim pa la sogs pa bskyed rim kyi gzhung mang po dang / rmi lam la brten nas sgyu ma nyams su myong bas sku gsum ngo sprad pa dang / 'pho ba grong 'jug la brten nas le lo can 'chi khar sangs rgya ba dang / srog rtsol la brten nas gtum mo sgom pa rim lnga dang sbyar ba dang / 'khor ba'i 'jug ldog la brten nas ma rig pa ngos bzung ba dang / chags can 'og sgo la brten nas/ bde ba nyams su blang ba dang / de dag gi man ngag phyin ci ma log pa ston par byed pa/ rtsa rgyud le'u bcu bdun pa/ rgyud phyi ma/ bshad rgyud dgongs pa lung ston/ rdo rje phreng ba/ lha mo bzhis zhus/ ye shes rdo rje kun las btus/ gnyis med rnam rgyal/ 'grel pa sgron gsal la sogs pa rgya cher gsungs so/

/mdor na dpal gsang ba 'dus pa skor gyi/ dbang rgyud 'grel pa man ngag dang bcas pas/ skal ldan gyi gdul bya dpag tu med pa/ sgyu lus 'od gsal zung 'jug gi lam la bkod do/ /dben gsum gyis ni gdul bya'i sgo gsum sbyangs/ /sgyu lus 'od gsal zung 'jug lam bsgom ste/ /tshe 'dir rdo rje 'chang gi sar skyel ba'i/ /'jam dbyangs gsang 'dus mnga' bdag de la 'dud/ /ces so/ /gnyis med kyi rgyud dpal dus kyi 'khor lo'i sgo nas 'gro don mdzad tshul ni/ gdul bya zab cing rgya che ba la mos shing / bla ma'i nges pa la dga' ba la sogs pa'i yon tan bcu dang ldan pa du ma la/ dpal dus kyi 'khor lo'i dbang yongs rdzogs dang / phal cher la dbang gong ma nyid gnang nas/ de'i dam tshig gi rnam bzhag kyang / spang bar bya ba'i dam tshig spyad par bya ba'i dam tshig bza' ba'i dam tshig sbyin pa'i dam tshig go /de la spang bar bya ba'i dam tshig ni/ rtsa ba'i ltung ba bcu bzhi/ yan lag gi nyes pa sum cu/ brtul zhugs nyi shu rtsa lnga la sogs pa'o/ /spyod par bya ba'i dam tshig la/ drang don nges don gyi phyag rgya drug dang / drang don nges don gyi rgyal ba rigs drug gi dam tshig dang / drang don nges don gyi bla ma dang / dkon mchog brten zhing bsnyen bkur ba'i dam tshig dang / phyi nang gsang ba mthar thug gi phyag rgya drug gi dam tshig go /bza' btung gi dam tshig la/ drang don nges don gyi bza' ba dang btung ba'o/ /sbyin pa'i dam tshig la/ thun mtshams su bza' btung gi mchod pa sbyin pa/ dbang dang bshad rgyud dus su/ tshogs mchod sbyin pa/ ltung ba dag pa'i bzlas pa byas pa'i mthar tshogs 'khor sbyin pa/ de las gzhan du tshogs sam dpa' bo'i ston mo sbyin pa/ de dus khro rgyal rdo rje shugs la sogs pa bsrung ma drug cu rnams la gtor ma sbyin pa'i dam tshig la sogs te/ mdor na dbang gi bslab bya dam tshig gi rnam bzhag gsungs nas/

gdul bya dpag tu med pa smin par mdzad do/ /dus 'khor ba'i dbang bcu gnyis po de yang / tshogs gsum du 'dus te/ byis pa 'jug pa'i dbang bdun po bsod nams kyi tshogs te/ sa bdun gyi dbang phyug tu lung bstan no/ /de nas dbang gsum po tshul khrims kyi tshogs te/ phyir mi ldog pa'i sa la lung bstan no/ /dbang bzhi pa ye shes kyi tshogs te/ sa bcu gcig gi dbang phyug tu lung bstan no/ bcu gnyis pa bdag po chen po'i dbang bskur nas/ rgyud 'chad pa dbang bskur ba/ rab gnas rjes gnang sogs byed pa'i slob dpon gyi bya ba mtha' dag la dbang bar lung bstan no/ /zab lam rdo rje'i rnal 'byor gyis 'gro don mdzad tshul ni/ 'og tu rim bzhin ston no/ /gzhan yang sa skya bka' 'bum gyi lung / kun mkhyen chen po'i bka' 'bum gyi lung / chos rje bu'i chos 'byung gi lung / jo bo'i chos 'byung gi lung / bka' gdams glegs bam gyi lung / bka' gdams gzhung drug gi lung / rgyal sras bka' 'bum gyi lung / khro phu ba'i man ngag brgya rtsa'i lung / yang dgon pa'i ro chos skor gsum gyi lung po to ba'i dpe chos rin chen dpung pa'i lung / 'ba' ra ba'i mgur 'bum gyi lung la sogs pa/ rtsa ba'i bla ma rnams gnyis kyi drung du thob cing / gdul bya rnams la'ang phan 'dogs rgya cher mdzad do/ /phyag rgya chen po'i khrid/ tshe khrid/ dmar khrid/ spros med zhi byed/ sangs rgyas mnyam sbyor/ ma gcig gi skor/ blo sbyong / 'khor chen gyi rdzogs rim la sogs pa'i sgo nas/ gdul bya dpag tu med pa'i mya ngan dang / sdug bsngal ba dang / yid mi bde ba dang / rgud pa la sogs pa sel ba dang / nga rgyal dang / rgyags pa dang / dregs pa'i tshogs rnams 'joms pa/ yan lag dang nying lag na ba dang / nad rims gdon bgegs/ dus ma yin par 'chi ba la sogs pa las bskyabs nas/ tshe 'di la phan pa rgya cher mdzad nas/ tshe phyi ma 'khor ba dang ngan song gi g.yang sa las bsgral nas/

thar pa dang / thams cad mkhyen pa'i go 'phang la 'god par mdzad do/ /rgyud sde rgya mtsho'i pha rol mthar son nas/ rjes gnang dbang dang rim gnyis lam gyis ni/ /'gro rnams rdo rje 'dzin pa'i sa la 'god/ /'jam dbyangs rdo rje 'dzin la gus pas 'dud/ /ces so/ /de'i tshe nag phyogs la dga' ba 'ga' zhig tshul bzhin min pa'i rlung gis bskyod nas/ zhes sdang gi me sbar te/ phan bde'i nags tshal chen po sreg pa'i bsam pas kun nas bslangs te/ gtor ma bsdebs pa sogs mthu gtad drag po byas dus/ mkha' spyod kyi gzim khang na bzhugs pa'i tshe/ thog 'tsheg pa dang / 'ur sgra dang / ding sgra chen po dang / spen bad la me 'bar ba sogs kyi rnam pa/ drung na yod pa'i 'khor rnams kyi mngon sum du mthong thos byung ngo / /zhal snga nas kyi rnal lam du/ mi nag po gcig gi lag tu gri gug khyer/ ngag tu/ oṃ hri ṭi wi ṭi tā na na hūm̐ phaṭa/ ces 'don cing / brdas pas/ zhal snga nas gtsang po nang gi phyogs la bros pa/ 'phrang ring gi thad du zin nas/ thugs kar gri gug btsugs nas/ thub dbang gi gser sku mtho gang ba gcig bton pa rmis/ mnal sad nas thugs mi bde ba'i rnam pa byung ba/ yon mchod bka' bgros nas/ gnas spos pa'i dge sbyor rtse gcig byed pa la thugs rtse gtad/ glang pa dgon gsar du chu skyel mkhan gyi nye gnas gcig las med pa mdzad/ gzim khang la bug sgo mdzad nas/ mnyam bzhag tu sor bsam gyi ting nge 'dzin la mnyam par 'jog pa dang / srog rtsol gyi rdor bzlas la rtsal du 'don pa dang / rjes thob tu byams snying rje byang chub kyi sems bsgom pa la 'bad pas/ zla ba gsum song ba'i dus/ sngar gyi gser sku de thugs kar bcug pa rmis/ zla ba bzhi tsam song ba'i nub gcig rnal lam du/ dbus phyogs nas 'ongs pa yin zer ba'i btsun pa'i gzugs can gnyis na re/ nged gnyis la mjal kha zhu/ zhu yig rten bcas kyang 'bul rgyu yod zer/

nged mtshams dam par yod pas 'phrad stabs mi bde/ yi ge rten bcas bsrings pas chog gsungs pas/ yi ge rgya ma khrab bzang po gcig ral gri dang bcas pa bskur byung bas/ yi ge de klog pa'i nang na/ bla ma dkon mchog bzang po dgongs su gsol/ sngon chad bag med pa'i dbang gis lus ngag yid gsum gyi sgo nas/ bgyi bar mi 'os pa'i las byas pa mthol lo bshags/ slan chad rjes su bzung du gsol/ khrab bzang po 'di dang ral gri ngar ma 'di yang khyed rang la mkho bar 'dug pas 'bul ba lags zer ba 'dug chos nyid bsgom pa dang / byams snying rje bsgom pa ma gtogs pa'i mthu gtad bzlog pa'i thabs gzhan ci yang ma byas te/ de nas ring por ma lon par khong rang gshegs dus/ mthu de phar log pa yin pa 'dra snyam pa byung gsungs so/ /don de yang mdo sdud pa las/ gang gā'i klung mnyam zhing na sems can ji snyed ma lus pa/ /de kun yongs su brtags pa bzung ste bdud gyur la/ /ba spu nyag re las ni de snyed sprul byas kyang / /de dag kun gyis mkhas la bar chad bya mi nus/ /rgyu rnams bzhi yis byang chub sems dpa' mkhas stobs ldan/ /bdud bzhis thub par dka' zhing skyod par mi nus te/ /stong par gnas dang sems can yongs su mi stong dang / /ji skad smras bzhin byed dang bde gshegs byin rlabs can/ /zhes bshad pa ltar ro/ /thabs shes zung 'brel go mtshon gyis/ /bdud dmag bye ba'i g.yul las rgyal/ /slar yang brtse bas rjes su bzung / /'jam dbyangs dpa' bo de la 'dud/ /ces so/ /dus phyis gdul bya rnams la'ang / srung 'khor gyi gtso bo byams snying rje byang chub kyi sems bsgom pa 'di yin pas/ 'di la 'bad dgos gsungs/ tshe bsgrub kyi gtso bo yang rdor bzlas zab mo 'di yin te/ kho bo yang de dus rlung ltas log nas 'chi ltas shar ba'i tshe/ rdor bzlas bgyis pas deng sang bar/ mgo ril le lus pa 'di lags gsungs so/

/don de yang dus zhabs snyan rgyud las/ sgrub pos sgra dang bral ba yis/ /'bum bzlas tshar ba'i rjes su ni/ /tshe zad pa yang lo lnga ru/ /'tsho ba 'di la the tshom med/ /ces gsungs so/ /de dag gi gnas skabs su/ sde pa chen po nas sku chas gnang dus/ sha khog rkam rlon mang po gnang gi 'dug pa dang / gzhan gang zag so sos gdan gnon zhu ba'i dus su'ang sha la longs spyod pa la thugs 'byung ba dang / theg dman gyi sde snod du/ stod 'dul gsung dus/ dge slong gyi khrims nyis brgya lnga bcu rtsa gnyis gsungs nas/ smad 'dul la dge slong gi sha zos na ltung ba 'byung ba'i ltung byed cig bsnan nas/ khrims nyis brgya lnga bcu rtsa gsum gsungs 'dug pa dang / theg dman gyi dbang du byas na/ sha ni khu khrag la sogs pa'i rdzas sum cu rtsa gnyis las byung bas/ bdag nyid gtsang bar 'dod pas sha bzar mi rung / theg pa chen po'i dbang du bgyis na/ mkha' mnyam sems can thams cad drin can gyi pha ma sha stag tu bshad pas/ bdag nyid snying rje sgom par 'dod pas/ pha ma'i sha bzar mi rung / gsang sngags bla med du/ sems can thams cad yi dam gyi lhar gsungs pas/ bdag nyid yi dam gyi sha bzar mi rung / khyad par du rang nyid theg pa chen po bar khas blangs nas sha bag yangs su za ba 'di ches shin tu mi 'thad de/ lang kar gshegs pa'i mdor/ sha yi phyir du sems can gsod/ /bza' ba'i phyir du mchod sbyin byed/ /de dag gnyis ka sdig 'dun can/ /ngu 'bod byed la sogs par 'tshed/ /ces dang / myang 'das chen mo dang / sor 'phreng can gyi mdo dang / sprin chen snying po'i mdo sogs las legs par bkag 'dug pa dang / gsang sngags kyi rgyud sde rnams su yang / sha la sogs pa bza' mi bya/ /zhes sogs bkag 'dug pa/ ji skad bshad pa'i don/ sdom gsum rab dbyer/ theg pa che la sha rnams bkag /zos na ngan 'gro'i rgyu ru gsungs/ /zhes sogs dpang du byas nas/

sha mi gsol ba'i dam bca' brtan po mdzad do/ /lo gnyis gsum gyi bar dgongs pa bzhin byung dus/ chos rje phyogs las rnam rgyal ba nyang stod du phebs/ gsang sngags kyi dbang bskur mang po gsan dus/ chos rje'i zhal nas/ rang re gsang sngags pa bya ba sha sogs bdud rtsir bsgyur nas lus gsos nas/ sems can gyi don byas na tshogs che bas/ da phyin chad sha gsol dgos gsung na'ang / bdag nyid chen pos/ sbyin bdag chen po yang sha gsol ba la thugs mi dges pa gcig bdog lags pas/ re shig sha gang chod cig gyis lags zhus pas/ chos rje'i zhal nas/ sde pa la nged kyi dogs 'grol gsungs nas/ sde par zhal ta gnang ngo / /sang nyin sde pa nas sha gsol dgos gsungs nas sha khog skam rlon drug gi gnang sbyin dang bcas pa byung bas/ phyis sha bza' dgos pa byung ba 'di legs so bsam pa ni mi bdog gsungs so/ /yang dam chos 'dul ba nas/ rtsa ba bzhi ma gtogs/ bslab pa'i gzhi phal cher nad pa la gnang na'ang chang ni gnang ba'i skabs med de/ mdor rtsar/ nad pas chang ni rtsa mchog gis kyang mi btung ngo / /zhes dang / de'i rgya cher 'grel du/ dge bsnyen yan chad thams cad kyis mi btung mi blug go /zhes/ rang gi 'thung ba lta smos ci dgos te/ gzhan la'ang mi blug par bshad pas so/ /rin chen phreng bar/ chang 'thung bas ni blo 'khrul zhing / /don yal nor yang mdzad par 'gyur/ /zhes dang / gzhan yang theg chen gyi mdo dang rgyud sde rnams su ni shin tu yang bkag pas chang la bcas pa shin tu dam par mdzad cing / gsang sngags zab mo'i nang mchod kyi skabs su/ ljags thog tu cung zad myang ba ma gtogs/ hub tu long ba gsol mi srid do/ /des na sha chang bud med gsum nyes pa shin tu che bas/ bdag gi rjes 'jug rnams kyis kyang 'bad pas spangs dgos ces pa'i brdar/ nyes gsum spong ba'i bstan bcos kyang mdzad do/ /nyes pa kun gyi rtsa ba chang dang ni/

/snying rje gtsang sbra la gnod pha ma'i sha/ /thar pa'i srog rtsa gcod pa'i bud med gsum/ /'di gsum chos pa kun gyis spongs shig gsungs/ /bstan bcos mdzad pa de la gus phyag 'tshal/ /zhes sogs/ gzhan yang de'i skabs su/ rkang bzhi spong bar yang mdzad de/ /thog med dus nas phan btags pas/ /drin lan bcal bas mi khyer ba'i/ /pha ma bran du mi bskul bar/ /rang gis rkang pas 'gro zhes gsungs/ /'on kyang / sde bdag chen po gnyis kyi bla mar gyur pas/ zhabs thang du phebs pa 'di mi mdzes dgongs nas/ phyogs phyogs gnyis nas zhu ba nan gyis phul ba la brten nas/ lo gsum ma gtogs/ rta la 'dzeg dgos pa 'di yang legs bsam pa med gsungs so/ /yang klu sgrub snying po'i zhal snga nas/ dge slong gnas la dbang byed bdag po dang / /dge bskos tsam sbyor ba dang dam bzhag pa/ /gang zag las byed rnams su bdag ma skye/ /zhes dang / dge ba'i bshes gnyen phu chung ba'i zhal nas/ bdag gis mkhan po ma byas te/ /ngan song du mi skye la re/ /dbang ma bskur te ngan song du mi skye la re/ sgrub thabs ma bshad de ngan song du mi skye la re/ gnyer ma bzung ste ngan song du mi skye la re/ zhes gsungs 'dug pa la/ bdag la ni de thams cad cha mthun te byed dgos par 'dug sangs rgyas kyi bstan pa bshad sgrub gnyis kyi sgo nas 'dzin dgos pa la/ gzhan dbang du song nas 'chad nyan phu thag pa gcig yang mi yong par 'dug cing / sgrub pa rtse gcig pa yang dka' bar 'dug pas/ bla brang gi khur 'di bzhag la/ de gnyis gang rung gcig byed dgos dgongs nas zhu ba rim can du phul ba lags na'ang ma bzhes gsungs so/ /la la dag ni nan gyis mtshang / /kha cig smon pa'i gnas su byed/ /dam pa khyod la zhen pa med/ /gser dang bong pa mnyam la 'dud/ /ces so/ /yang de'i tshe/ bdag chen chos rgyal chen pos/ lhag bsam rnam dag gi kun nas bslangs te/ dpal ldan sa skya/

gsang phu ne'u thog rnams kyis thog drangs pa'i dbus gtsang gi chos sde chen po rnams su/ grwa skor chen mo la/ bka' bcu pa brgya phrag gcig rdzong bar bzhed nas/ chos sde'i grwa tshang so so nas/ dge bshes blo gsal ba rnams btus nas/ bdag rkyen sbyar/ grwa skor ba rnams kyi po ti sbrel ba'i gsung chos kyang zhal snga nas gnang ba dgos pa'i zhal ta zhus te/ dben gnas chen po ri khrod dga' ldan du/ mdo lang kar gshegs pa dang / dka' chen bzhis thog drangs pa'i po ti mang po'i 'chad nyan mdzad pa'i dus/ lha'i bu rnams kyis me tog gi char phab te/ bar snang la tshigs bcad gsungs pa ni/ chos mngon shes bya'i rgya mtsho'i pha rol son/ /'dul ba bdud rtsi'i snying pos shes rab rgyas/ /mdo sde za ma tog gi rgyan gyis mdzes/ /a la la'o deng sang 'di na gda'/ /zhes zer ro/ /mkhyen rab shes bya'i bya lam yangs par ni/ /thugs rje'i chu 'dzin dpag med 'khrigs pa las/ /lung dang rig pa'i 'brug sgra zab mo yis/ /legs bshad char chen bsil bsil 'bebs pa'i tshe/ /bstan pa'i sbyin bdag chen pos bdag rkyen sbyar/ /bstan la dga' ba'i lha rnams me tog 'thor/ /bstan pa pad mo'i tshal rab rgyas par mdzad/ /bstan 'dzin bung ba'i tshogs rnams dar dir sgrog /bstan pa'i bdag po de la gus phyag 'tshal/ /tshul khrims rgya mtsho la gnas yon tan gyi/ /rin chen rgyan spras bden gnyis ro 'dzin gyis/ /legs bshad phud sgra'i sgra dbyangs sgrog mdzad pa'i/ /'jam dbyangs klu'i dbang po de la 'dud/ /dal 'byor grub chen yon tan nor gyis gtams/ /'phrin las rnam bzhi'i skya ba rab bskyod de/ /'gro rnams srid pa'i mtsho las sgrol mdzad pa'i/ /'jam dbyangs ded dpon dbang po de la 'dud/ /ces so/ /yang bstan bsrung chen po dpal ldan zhal bzhi pa la sogs pa'i chos skyong bsrung ma bran bzhin du 'khol bar mdzad pa'i bla ma yang rtse bar grags pa'i thugs dam pa chen po de/

ri khrod dga' ldan du thugs dam la bzhugs pa'i nub cig gi tshe/ bram ze chen po gcig sgrub pa kun dga' chos bzang bya ba/ khong pa rang gi slob ma gcig yod pa'i khang pa la khyel byas/ bla ma pa rang gi gzim khang la mi rkang gi gling bu'i btegs bcol te/ de'i nang na mar/ bla ma mkhan chen dkon mchog bzang po 'di/ rje btsun sa chen kun dga' snying po'i rnam sprul yin/ da ring por mi thogs par/ rtse chen chos sde'i mkhan thog tu phebs par 'gyur zhes lung bstan pa/ khong pas kun tu bsgrags/ de dus/ chos sde/ dpal 'khor sde chen gyi chos dpon mdzad pa ma gtogs rtse chen du phebs pa'i bgros pa yang med pas/ thams cad bden par mi 'dzin/ dus phyis de ltar du gyur pas/ yid ches par gyur to/ /bstan srung chen po mahā ka la yis/ /rje btsun 'di nyid bla ma sa chen zhes/ /deng sang shar dga' ba yi nyi ma shar/ /'jam dbyangs kun dga' snying po de la 'dud/ /ces so/ /yang dam pa 'di nyid ri khrod chen po jo nang du gdan sar phebs dus/ snga nyin nas chos skyong che chung sogs chos skyong mang po dpal 'khor sde chen nas/ stod phyogs 'di la 'byon gyi 'dug pa bla ma yang rtse ba'i rnal lam du byung bas/ nye gnas la de ring dpal 'khor sde chen la phyin pa la skad cha bshad rgyu ci yod gsungs pas/ gzhan cher mi gda'/ chos rje rin po che jo nang bzhes su phebs pa'i grabs yul 'dug zer/ zhus pas/ de tsam ka yin la thang gsungs/ jo nang nas phebs dus/ chos skyong rnams zhag gcig gi sngon la byon byung ba rmis ba dang / gzhan yang dkyil mkhar/ snang phu sogs la chos bar la gang phebs pa'i gnas der chos skyong rnams snga phar la phebs kyi 'dug pa'i rnal lam rgyun du yong ba 'di/ rang re'i bla ma 'di nyid chos skyong la lhag par mnga' brnyes pa gcig yin par 'dug dper na mi la ras pa bzhin zhes gsungs so/ /zhal snga nas kyi rnal lam du yang /
