chos sde gong 'og gnyis la 'byon bzhud mdzad dus/ dpal ldan zhal bzhi pa 'dis bsu ba dang / ser 'phreng gi rnam pa rgyun du byed pa gcig 'dug gsungs so/ /yang lan gcig drung yang rtse bas/ dpal 'khor sde chen gyi bla brang dkar po na/ zhal snga nas kyi sku rim gyi dgu gtor gcig mdzad dus/ rnam sras gling nas kyi gtor kha bso ba'i chas rnams khyer byung bas/ drung yang rtse ba na re/ khong sde pa chen po'i blon chen gzhan dang mi 'dra ba yin pas/ bzab yang dag cig sos shig ces nye gnas la bskul zhing / nye gnas kyis kyang de bzhin du bgyis pas/ sa sros mtshams su/ nye gnas kyi ming nas bos nas nyeng gyis zer/ nye gnas kyis sgo phye nas ltar phyin pas/ mi nag po am gtsigs bsdams pa gcig gis/ 'gram pa la lcag zer ba gcig brgyab nas/ tshogs 'dres pa dang spyod yul gcig tu gyur pa ma thos sam zer/ de rjes 'gram pa tsha lcug lcug skrangs byung dus/ bred thabs su bla ma'i sku mdun du phyin nas rgyu mtshan bsnyad pas/ bla ma'i zhal nas/ rnam sras gling pa 'di/ zhal snga nas la mi mos zer ba bden tshod du 'dug pa/ da chos skyong la bshags pa 'bul ba las thabs gzhan med gsungs nas/ de 'phral du bshags pa phul lo/ /sang snga dro gzigs pa'i dus/ kha sang gi gtor kha gsos pa'i 'theb skyu/ 'dzugs kyi dmar rgyan dang bcas pa/ sa la phab bzhag 'dug pa'i steng na la 'bu shig shig 'dug pa/ skyi g.ya' ba byung gsungs so/ /nag phyogs bdud rigs rtsad nas 'joms/ /dkar phyogs brtse bas rjes 'dzin pa'i/ /chos skyong srung ma lus dang ni/ /grib ma bzhin du 'grogs la 'dud/ /ces so/ /yang / drung yang rtse ba bla brang dkar po na gtor sgrub la bzhugs dus/ thugs dam kyi skabs su nyin mo rnal bzi ba gcig gi rnal lam du/ rtse yar mar gyi brag 'dir/ paṇa zhwa rtse ring gyon pa/ btsun pa'i gzugs can mdog skya ba bong ge shin tu che ba gcig gis/

mchan khung 'og nas rkyal pa gcig gi nang nas thal ba snyim pa gang bstod phyogs la gtor nas/ thal mo gcig bsdabs pas/ stod phyogs kyi sa sros so/ /smad phyogs la gtor nas thal mo bsdabs pas/ smad phyogs kyi sa nag thum ste song nas/ 'grul pa rnams kyis lam ma rnyed pa 'thoms 'dug pa'i skabs su/ rje btsun 'di nyid sa der phebs byung nas/ stod phyogs la sdigs mdzub mdzad de sku chos g.yab pas/ stod phyogs la nyi ma shar nas mun pa rnams bsal/ smad phyogs la'ang de bzhin mdzad pas/ smad phyogs kyi mun pa bsal te nyi ma shar dus/ 'grul pa rnams skyabs su 'gro ba'i sgra skad dir ri ri lam la zhugs byung ba rmis pa'i rgyu mtshan/ de 'phral du sku drung du phul lo/ /bdud rigs bar chad 'byung po'i tshogs/ /mi shes mun nag sprin dum 'thibs/ /mkhyen brtse 'phrin las 'od stong can/ /bar chad mun sel khyod la 'dud/ /'grul pa rnams kyi skyabs gzhan dag /spangs nas khyod nyid gcig po la/ /skyabs 'gro'i sgra skad dir ri ri/ /thar pa'i lam mchog gsal la la/ /phan bde'i skyid tshal rab tu rgyas/ /dam chos sbrang rtsi 'dod pa yi/ gdul bya'i bung ba sgo ro ro/ /nyams dbyangs glu skad tsher re re/ /zhes dang / tshogs gnyis shar ri'i rtse nas legs 'ongs shing / /legs bshad 'od zer 'bum phrag rab 'phros pas/ /sangs rgyas bstan pa nyin mor byed pa'i dpal/ /'jam dbyangs smra ba'i nyi ma de la 'dud/ /ces so/ /yang de'i tshe las stod byang pas shar dga' ba'i phyogs la gtor ma la sogs drag las byas kyang / 'dir gnod pa'i mtshan ma tsam yang ma byung dus/ bdag po rnam rgyal grags pa'i slob ma rnams kyis bdag chen la zhus pa/ rang re'i gtor ma 'di gzhan gang la'ang nus pa che ba gcig 'dug pa la/ shar dga' ba la nus pa ci yang mi 'phrod pa 'di ji btsug lags/ bdag po'i zhal nas/ ngas rmi lam gyi brtag pa byas dus/

chos rje dkon mchog bzang po yin zer ba'i bla ma gcig gi chos gos kyi 'og na/ nyang stod kyi ru ba yin zer ba'i lung pa phu gangs ri rong nge ba byas pa gcig bcug pa rmis pas/ khong sku khams bzang ring bar de phyogs la nus pa 'phrod pa dka' ba 'dra gsungs so/ /srid gsum 'gro ba ma lus rnams/ /khyod kyis sdug bsngal las bskyabs na/ /bdag sogs dngos kyi gdul bya rnams/ /nye bar 'tshe las cis mi skyob/ /ces so/ /mdo sde rgyan las/ nye bar 'tshe ba thams cad dang / /ngan song dang ni 'thab min dang / /'jigs tshogs theg pa dman pa las/ /skyob phyir skyabs kyi dam pa'o/ /zhes gsungs pa ltar ro/ /de dus su bdag gi yongs 'dzin dam pa sems dpa' chen po dpal ldan mgon po bas/ dkon mchog gsum khyod khyod nyid dkon mchog gsum/ /bzang po'i las mdzad mdzad pa bzang po can/ /ma lus lus can kun gyi skyabs gcig po/ /kun mkhyen mkhyen rab dbang phyug zhabs la 'dud/ /ces bstod do/ /de dag gi gnas skabs su/ brtson 'grus can gyi mi la bar chad sdug /ces gsungs pa ltar/ thugs rtsol che ba rab kyi mthar son pas/ ja sogs 'dod yon gyi dbang du yang mi 'gro/ rang phyogs la chags zhing gzhan phyogs la sdang ba sogs nyon mongs kyi dbang du mi 'gro/ /'khor gyi log sgrub sogs la thugs skyo ba med cing / go 'phang thob pa sogs mchog 'dzin med par nyin phyed yan la chos gsung ba/ dbang bskur ba/ rab gnas mdzad pa sogs kyi dus 'da' ba yin zhing / phyi ma red dgongs mtshams bcad nas thugs dam la rtse gcig tu bzhugs pa 'di yang / dam pa 'di'i rnam thar bzang po gcig lags te/ rje btsun byams pas/ brtson 'grus ldan pa longs spyod kyis pham pa med/ /brtson 'grus ldan pa nyon mongs kyis pham pa med/ /brtson 'grus ldan pa skyo bas pham pa med/ /brtson 'grus ldan pa thob pas pham pa med/ /ces dang /

mdo sdud par/ brtson 'grus kyis ni dkar po'i yon tan 'grib mi 'gyur/ /ye shes mtha' yas rgyal ba'i bang mdzod rnyed par 'gyur/ zhes gsungs pa ltar ro/ /rtse chen chos sde'i gdan sa mdzad tshul ni/ lam 'bras kyi gsung chos grol rjes su/ rje grub chen gyi zhal nas/ rang re pa nged kyi gdan sa 'di yi yang 'os su yod pa yin te/ jo nang / dpal 'khor sde chen bsam gling sogs kyi gdan sa'i thugs brel gyis/ 'di mi lcogs gsung lags sam/ zhes gsungs pa dang / dam pa 'di nyid kyi zhal nas bla ma'i gdan sa yin pas/ bgyis pas chog lags ces zhus so/ /rje grub chen gyi zhal nas/ 'o na ja gral 'di na/ dpon mo ba dpang po la bzhugs pas/ nged de lugs byed do gsungs nas/ chos sde 'di yi gdan sa bkod pa dang / mdzad pa gnyis ka yang de dus zhal gyis bzhes so/ /de dang mthun par phyis sgrol ma lha khang pa dang / drung chen lha pas bka' bgros su bstun nas/ gsol ba btab pa dang / yi dam gyi lha rje btsun sgrol ma dang / mkha' 'gro ma seng ge'i gdong pa can dang / dpal mgon zhal bzhi pa rnams kyis mgrin gcig tu/ khyod 'di nas nub phyogs ri bo rtse dgur song la/ sgrub pa gyis dang / tshe 'di la mchog gi dngos grub thob par 'gyur ro zhes lung bstan pas rkyen byas te/ dgung lo bzhi bcu zhe brgyad pa/ shing mo glang gi lo la/ hor gyi 'ja' pas bcad pa'i chos sde chen po/ thub bstan rab rgyas gling gi gdan sa chen por phyags phebs so/ /yi dam mkha' 'gro'i tshogs kyis mgrin gcig tu/ /'di nas nub phyogs ri bo rtse dgur song / /khyod kyis mchog gi dngos grub thob 'gyur zhes/ /'jam dbyangs mkha' 'gros lung bstan de la 'dud/ /ces so/ /de'i tshe/ rtse nub pa'i dpon blon rnams dang / chen po dga' ldan pas thog drangs/ chos sde'i che bgres rnams la 'di ltar gsungs te/ kho bos gsung rab du ma la legs par sbyangs pa'i stobs kyis/

dbus gtsang 'dir grwa pa brgyad brgya tsam re la/ bya bral 'chad nyan rnam dag gcig byung na snyam pa bdog na'ang / sde pa yar mar gyi bka' lung nan che ba ma theg pa'i shugs kyis/ gdan sa rnams ni khas blangs mod/ 'on kyang sde pa gong 'og gnyis po 'di/ rgya zhang mtshungs pa yin pas/ dpal 'khor sde chen dang 'dra bar/ 'dir yang bstan pa dar rgyas spel ba'i slad du/ sngags mtshan nyid kyi slob dpon so so'i bsko bzhag de rnams la rten so tha dad dang / brgya tsho so so'i 'bogs tshul/ de rnams la grwa khral bskul tshul dang / zhabs tog sgrub tshul/ dge 'dun tshogs pa stong phrag gcig la/ dbyar chos dgun chos zla ba re re la/ rtsom tshul zla ba re re'i gzhi rten/ mtshan nyid pa rnams la/ dge bshes yan chad/ lung rigs kyi rgal brtag byed pa rnams la/ rtsis bkur gyi gzhi rten/ gsang sngags pa rnams la/ sa ga zla ba'i bsgrub mchod chen mo la gzhi rten/ sngar bas 'bur dod dang bcas pa dang / shar phyogs 'dir chos sde gsar pa dang / dge 'dun stong phrag shong ba'i 'du khang gsar pa/ de'i nang du brten gsum bzhengs pa/ de'i skong tshangs/ dkon gnyer gyi gzhi rten dang bcas pa 'dzugs pa sogs/ mdor na rgyal srid kyi phyed tsam/ dge phyogs su gtong ba'i ngos nas/ dad pa sgom pa ma gtogs dge 'dun gyi skyon la mi rtogs pa ni/ sbyin bdag chen po rnams kyi mdzad 'phrin lags pas/ thugs yul du 'jog 'tshal ba lags/ 'dir 'tshogs pa'i dge 'dun rnams kyis kyang / gzhi dang tshugs la brten nas 'chad nyan/ thos bsam bsgom gsum/ sbyin bdag chen po'i sku rim sogs la mi g.yel ba'i ngos nas/ thar pa don du gnyer dgos pa ma gtogs sbyin bdag la 'khang ra dang / skyon la mi rtog pa ni rab byung rnams kyi mdzad 'phrin lags/ de ltar byas na/ bdag gis bla ma'i gdan sa byas pa don yod kyi/ gzhan du na/ bdag kyang blo gros gsal zhing blo sna thung ba dang /

dben pa la spro zhing / thar pa don du gnyer ba lags pas/ dad pa chung zhing / ser sna che ba'i sbyin bdag la dgos pa med cing / 'dod yon don du gnyer zhing / grong yul 'grim pa'i rab byung la yang dgos pa med gsungs so/ /de ltar sbyin bdag rnams kyis kyang bka' bzhin sgrub par khas blangs nas/ deng sang gi bar du chos sde chen po gong 'og gnyis po 'di yar 'phel du song ba yin no/ /brgyad pa sems can smin par mdzad tshul ni/ lan gcig dkyil mkhar du/ chos bar chen mo mdzad pa'i tshe/ a smi 'jugs kyi smu bdud de/ sngar chos la zhe gnag par yod na'ang / rje 'di nyid la shin tu dad nas/ tshogs chos chen mo 'chad pa'i dus/ spyang kir sprul nas/ chos ra la chos bskor byas nas/ thag nye sar khyi tsog byas/ chos nyan gyi 'dug pa/ chos nyan pa kun gyis mthong bar byung / de dus drung chen lha pa'i rnal lam du/ kho khye'u gcig tu sprul nas/ ngas kyang sngon chad las ngan bsags pa'i dbang gi 'khor ba mtha' med du 'khyams nas/ sdug bsngal dpag med myong dgos byung / deng sang bla ma'i chos nyan pas/ las 'bras kyi rnam bzhag cung zad go bas/ sems can la gnod 'tshe'i bsam pa yang chung du gtong / da nas bzung nas nga la btsugs pa'i gtor skud 'di yang nag po ma byed par/ dkar po re mdzod ces zer/ de rjes gtor skud nag po'i logs la/ gtor sku dkar po re byed kyin yod pa 'di yin/ de bzhin du bsam gling du chos 'khor bskor ba'i tshe/ lha chen bzang ra 'di/ mi dkar po g.yu rna btags pa gcig tu sprul nas/ ral pa'i thor cog bshig rje la phyag btsal skor ba byas nas/ deng sang bla mas gdul bya rnams la gang la gang 'tshams kyi chos gsung ba'i dus 'dir/ bdag kyang chos nyan la 'ong bas/ chos gdan re btings pa zhu zer nas/ mi snang bar gyur to/ /bka' lung la/ sang nyin nas gzhi bdag pa khong yang chos nyan du 'ong zer bar 'dug pas/

'o skol gyi mdun thad der/ gdan re things shig gsungs nas/ de dus grum tse re btings pa phyag srol du yod/ de'i tshe bsam gling pa'i slob dpon rdor tshul gyis/ 'phags pa spyan ras gzigs kyi sku (med par )rkang gang ma gcig la/ zhal snga nas kyi drung du rab gnas zhu dus/ me tog gtor ba'i dus/ nas rdog gcig phyag dang po gnyis thal mo sbyar ba'i rtser chags pa ya mtshan du gyur nas phyis mi kun la ston par byed do/ /de bzhin du ri khrod dga' ldan du/ khrid chen gcig gsungs pa'i dus/ mig pa spun bdun gyi nang nas/ spun gsum gyi sku drung du 'ongs nas/ mi skya'i gzugs can gnyis kyis phyag btsal byin rlabs zhus nas/ khrab re re'i 'bul ba byas/ bla ma da dung yang gnas 'dir re zhig bzhugs dgos zer/ btsun gzugs 'dzin pa gcig 'dug pa de/ sgo'i phag na brkyangs pa'i tshul gyis/ nyug nyug 'dzum 'dzum byed kyi 'dug pas/ gnas 'dir dge sbyor la bsdad na/ gzhi bdag 'di dga' tshod du 'dug gsungs so/ /de dag gi skabs su yang / dkar phyogs la dga' ba'i lha rnams kyis/ dri bzang 'thul ba dang / me tog gi char 'bebs pa dang / 'ja' 'od kyi gur phub pa dang / rigs can gsum gyi gang zag smin grol la bkod pa ni bsam gyis mi khyab bo/ /'di ni tshul khrims rnam dag gi mdo las/ ji ltar sbrul gdug klu chen nag po yang / /tshul khrims ldan la gnod med gzhan ci smos/ /zhes dang / mdo sdud pa las/ de ltar spyod mkhas dag la lha tshogs mang po dag /thal mo sbyar bar btud nas phyag kyang 'tshal bar byed/ /phyogs bcu'i 'jig rten khams kyi sangs rgyas ji snyed pa'ang / /yon tan sngags pa'i phreng ba yongs su brjod par mdzad/ /ces gsungs pa ltar ro/ /de la 'di ltar bstod de/ rigs can gsum la chos 'khor bskor ba'i tshe/ /lha'i tshogs kyi me tog char chen phab/ /lha min bdud kyi tshogs rnams dbang du 'dus/

/'jam dbyangs kun gyi bsngags pa de la 'dud/ /ces so/ /yang lan gcig bla ma yang rtse ba'i mdun du/ dpal ldan zhal bzhi pa ni/ bram ze'i gzugs su sprul nas/ rnam sras mdung dmar can dang lhan cig du byung ste/ nged rnams bla ma sa skya pa snang phur chos bar la phebs pa'i yo byad dang gnas khang sogs kyi mthun rkyen bsgrub pa la 'gro dgos pa yod gsungs so/ /de dus snang phur dpyid chos snga ma la/ rtse chen chos sde ba'i sngags mtshan nyid kyi grwa tshang rnams dang / dpal 'khor sde chen nas/ khang gsar pa sogs grwa tshang bzhi tsam phebs/ mdor na dge 'dun tshogs pa stong phrag gcig la/ bdag rkyen drung chen nas mdzad/ zhal snga nas/ dka' chen bzhis thog drangs pa'i/ gang la gang 'tshams kyis chos 'khor bskor/ khyad par du dpon mo mtsho mo'i sgrib sbyong du dmigs nas/ bzhengs pa'i sku gsung thugs kyi brten la rab gnas mdzad pa'i tshe/ me tog sna lnga'i char babs so/ /dpyid chos rjes ma/ rtse chen rdzong shod kyi khang gsar chen mor mdzad pa'i tshe/ bla ma yang rtse ba'i rnal lam du/ khang gsar chen mo'i nub kyi lcang ra'i chos khri kha byang la bstan pa'i steng na/ ston pa sangs rgyas 'khor brgya stong du ma la chos gsung gi 'dug pa rmis/ sang nyin mtshams 'thon nas/ gzigs su byon pas/ lcang ra'i chos khri kha byang bstan ma na/ zhal snga nas 'dul ba'i gleng gzhi gsung gi 'dug me tog sna lnga'i char babs pa dang / btsun chung rnams dang / mi nag pa rnams kyis 'thu yi 'dug de dus drung chen lha sa lha dbang dpal 'byor na bzhugs pa la yang / me tog gi char babs pa 'di yang / yon mchod gnyis ka thugs bsam rnam par dag pa'i stobs kyis yin te/ sngon thub pa'i dbang po dang / khyim bdag mgon med zas sbyin bzhin/ bar du jo bo chen po rje lha gcig dang / yon bdag shāka mgon bzhin no/ /sku yi kun spyod lta bas chog mi shes/

/tshang dbyangs gsung gi legs bshad sgra dbyangs sgrog /tshul khrims dri yis nyon mongs tsha gdung sel/ /'jam dbyangs thub pa'i dbang po de la 'dud/ /ces so/ /yang lug lo la/ khro phur chos bar chen mo mdzad pa'i tshe/ bdag rkyen seng ge rtse nas mdzad/ dpal ldan sa skya/ jo nang / bzang ldan/ 'dzims chos lung / dpal 'khor sde chen/ rtse chen chos sde nas 'dus pa'i shar sku 'bum pa'i char rtogs kyi chos bar ba stong phrag phyed dang gnyis la/ gang la gang 'tshams kyi gsung chos/ skye bo mi nag pa'i tshogs rnams la yang / sbyor ba yan lag drug blo sbyong / snying po don gsum/ zhen pa bzhi bral/ skyid sdug lam khyer/ tshe 'khrid/ ma ṇi'i lung / dbang rab gnas/ rab byung gnas rdzogs la sogs pa/ bstan pa'i bya ba rgya chen mdzad pa'i tshe/ jo nang na sgrub pa mo bzang mo dpal zhes bya ba'i nyams rtogs bzang du re ba gcig yod pa'i nyams kyi snang ba la/ deng sang khro phu na rje btsun byams pas/ nges don gyi chos kyi char pa 'bebs kyi 'dug jo nang pa rnams btang snyoms su sdod par rigs sam zhes pa nyams kyi snang ba la shar nas/ khar sang du mi 'gro ba ci ma rung snyam nas mtshams la hag 'thon byas nas/ sku drung du 'ongs/ nyams la shar tshul zhus te/ gsung chos nyan to/ /'on kyang grwa pa kha cig spyod lam rtsing pa la brten nas/ gzhi bdag khros te/ chos bar ba rnams la rims chung cung zad byung ba'i tshe/ zhal snga nas/ srod la chos skyong srung ma rnams la gtor ma phul nas/ bstan pa'i gnyer gtad bcol/ tho rangs gis dus/ thugs 'byung nas/ rje btsun la gsol ba rtse gcig tu btab ste/ byams pa'i ting nge 'dzin la mnyam par bzhag pa'i tshe/ rje btsun mdun gyi nam mkhar byon nas/ rje btsun gyi zhal nas/ rin chen rin thang med pa rnyed gyur gang dag yin/ /de dag dkon la dus rnams rtag tu 'tshe ba'ang mang / /theg pa gsar du zhugs pa'i sems can blo chung pa/

/gang gis dkon pa'i rin chen de ni ma rnyed pas/ /de la bar chad bya phyir bdud ni spro bar 'gyur/ /phyogs bcu'i sangs rgyas de dag yongs su 'dzin la sbyor/ /ma zhig na bar gyur la bu ni mang yod la/ /de kun yid mi bde zhing de la rim gro byed/ /de bzhin phyogs bcu'i 'jig rten khams kyi sangs rgyas kyang / /yum gyur shes rab dam pa 'di la dgongs pa mdzad/ /ces dang / chos bzhin byed la chos kyi bar chad 'byung / /chos med mi la chos kyi bar chad med/ /phrin las rnam bzhi dam can bsrung mas sgrub/ /skyo bar ma sems dam bca'i rgyun de bsrings/ /ces thugs gso bar mdzad pas/ grwa tshang re re tsam chos bar gzhan du thegs kyang / dpon slob byin gyis gzhi mnan nas bzhugs pas/ chos thog gnyis kyi bar la/ gsung chos 'phel bar byung ngo / /khro phur byams pa'i chos lnga gsungs pa'i tshe/ /rje btsun mdun gyi nam mkhar byon nas ni/ /sbyor ba'i skyon dang yon tan phye ste gsungs/ /'jam dbyangs byams pas rjes bzung de la 'dud/ /khyod ni byams pa'i chos lnga gsung ba'i tshe/ /rje btsun nyid dang tha dad ma mchis pas/ /dag pa'i gdul bya rnams kyi snang ba la'ang / byams mgon nyid du snang la gus phyag 'tshal/ /yang / rje grub chen gyis lung bstan zhing byin gyis brlabs te rjes su bzung ba'i chos kyi rgyal po chen po 'phags rgod khyung ram dpal bzang po'i zhal snga nas/ dgung lo bcu gsum bzhes pa'i tshe/ yum gyis rang la ltos pa'i 'khor dang / nye du dam pa'i chos la sbyor ba phan btags pa'i mchog du legs par dgongs nas/ bdag nyid chen po'i drung du/ sras la lam zab kyi khrid gsan par bskul zhing / gsol ba btab nas/ sras kyis kyang gsan no/ /de nas dgung lo bcu drug bzhes pa'i byi lo'i dus su/ yum gyi zhal nas/ sngar yang / bla ma'i byin brlabs gyi dbang gis/ 'od gsal gyi 'char sgo mi 'dra ba 'ga' re byung 'dug na'ang /

sku na phra ba'i stobs kyis/ bogs chen rang byung ba dka' bas/ da lo zab lam bskyar ma gcig cis kyang gsan dgos zhes gsungs nas/ gsan pas thugs dam bzang po 'khrungs te/ yid ches gsum ldan du gyur to/ /ngo sprod kyi dus su/ sgom chen pa gzhan mang po yang yod pa'i stobs kyis/ lus nyams/ ngag nyams sogs kyis/ lung pa 'ur dir la 'gro ba dang / gzim khang mer mer shig shig la 'gro ba byung ngo / /de'i tshe/ bka' bcu pa bkra shis rgyal ba zhes bya ba/ nyams rtogs bzang po can gcig yod pa de/ bla ma'i sku skye ba snga ma gcig dran/ khong rang gi skye ba gsum dran/ bdag chen 'phags rgod pa'i sku skye ba sngon ma dran zhes zer ro/ /de dus bka' bcu pa bkra shis rgyal bas/ bla ma rdo rje 'chang sku mdog sngon por dngos su bzhugs pa la/ rnal 'byor dbang phyug bir+wa pa dang / ḍoṃ bhi he ru ka gnyis kyis chos nyan pa gcig dngos su mthong ngo zhes grag go /dus gsum rgyal ba kun dngos rdo rje 'chang / /rgya gar grub chen rnams kyis yongs bskor nas/ /yid ches gsum ldan gdul bya'i tshogs rnams la/ /'jam dbyangs zab lam ston la gus phyag 'tshal/ /zhes so/ /bla ma 'di yi mkhas btsun bzang gsum/ 'chad rtsod rtsom gsum/ thos bsam bsgom gsum gyi yon tan gyi snyan pa'i grags pas/ sa steng ma lus pa khyab pas/ dbus gtsang khams gsum nas 'dus pa'i gsung chos don gnyer ba'i tshogs dpag tu med pa rnams la/ chos dang zang zing gi sgo nas phan 'dogs mdzad pa bsam gyis mi khyab bo/ /yang khyi lo la/ tshul khrims smon lam dag pas dal ba'i rten/ /rigs rus dang ldan dad mos nor gyis phyug /sangs rgyas bstan dang bla ma dam pa la/ /mi phyed dad pa dang ldan byang sems che/ /sgrol ma lha khang pa dpal ldan bde ba bzang mo bas/ zhal snga nas kyi drung du/ dngul spyad/ gos yug na bza'/ gsol chas sogs phul te/ chos 'khor bskor bar gsol ba btab nas/

chos sde yar mar gyi chos bar ba brgyad brgya tsam la chos zhag bzhi bcu'i bar gyi phogs/ bzhes chags kyis mang ja/ sogs kyi bdag rkyen sbyar nas/ rtse chen chos sder chos 'khor bskor ba'i tshe/ snga dro'i dus/ 'dul ba mdo rtsa/ lung sde bzhi'i gleng gzhi dang sbyar nas gsungs/ de yang bshad pa mdzad pa'i tshe/ 'byam klas nas 'gro zhing chos kyi mtshams drung na yod pa'i grwa pa rnams kyis 'dzin dgos pa yod/ bsdu na tshigs su bcad pa re re la'ang nyams len tshang bar bsdus nas 'chad pa yin/ gsung rab gang 'chad kyang / skye ba kun tu 'di kho na'i tshig don la sbyangs pa yin pa 'dra snyam pa 'byung / mdo rgyud bstan bcos ci bshad kyang rtsom pa po rang rang dang gnyis su ma mchis zhing / tshigs su bcad pa re re yang / grub mtha' smra ba bzhi dang sbyar na 'di ltar 'chad/ bshad thabs kyi man ngag lnga'i sgo nas 'di ltar 'chad/ dgos sogs chos bzhi yi sgo nas 'di ltar 'chad/ gzhi lam 'bras gsum gyi sgo nas 'di ltar 'chad/ lta sgom spyod 'bras kyi sgo nas 'di ltar 'chad/ ngo bo nyid gsum gyi sgo nas bshad na 'di ltar yin/ bden pa gnyis kyi sgo nas bshad na 'di bzhin yin/ 'di yi thad kyi rgya 'grel na 'di yod/ bla ma gong ma dag gi gsung bsgros la 'di skad gsungs/ rang re'i go tshod la 'di yin/ zhes bya ba la sogs pa gsungs te/ mdor na chos gcig lan du mar nyan na'ang / dub pa mi 'ong ba dang / sku mdun nye mor nyan pas rna ba gzer ba med cing / 'gyangs pas mi gsal ba med par shin tu gsal ba/ dag pa/ tshig gi zur phyin pa/ snyan la nges shes skye ba/ gsung rab kyi don rnams/ lag mthil du gtad pa lta bu 'ong ba ni tshangs pa'i dbyangs zhes bya ba dang / sangs rgyas kyi gsung dbyangs dang mthun pa yin te/ mdo sde rgyan las/ rgya che the tshom spong ba dang / /bzung 'os de nyid gnyis ston pa/ /de ni byang chub sems dpa' yi/

/ston pa phun tshogs yin zhes bya/ /zhes gsungs pa ltar ro/ /phyi dro'i dus/ chos rje dga' ldan pa sogs rdo rje 'dzin pa'i slob dpon mang dag la/ rgyud 'bum gyi lung / dbang rjes gnang sogs mdzad dus/ gung tshigs grol rjes su/ slob dpon kun dga' bas/ gsol ja gcig zhu yin yod tsa na/ gsung chos tshugs yod/ /chos nyan la byon zer ba'i brda byung / ci yin nam/ zhal snga nas/ da lta 'di na bzhugs yod/ 'on kyang / dred thabs su phyin pas/ zhal snga nas/ tshogs khang na rgyud 'bum gyi lung tshugs 'dug the tshom zos nas bltas pas kyang / de bzhin du 'dug pa dang / khong gi bsam pa la/ bdag gi bla ma dam pa 'di/ grub chen khyung po rnal 'byor bzhin du/ sku lus sprul bsgyur la dbang thob pa yin pa 'dug snyam pa byung gsungs so/ /lus brgyar sprul pa la sogs pa'i yon tan brgya phrag bcu gnyis la mnga' brnyes pa/ sa dang po thob pa nas 'byung bar bshad la/ bdag nyid chen po 'di/ rdo rje 'chang chen po'i ngo bor bzhugs pa yin pas/ de tsam la ngo mtshar du ci zhig bdog 'on kyang gdul bya las dag pa la/ de ltar du snang ba yin te/ dam pa 'di nyid gdul bya la la dag la/ rdo rje 'chang sku mdog sngon por byas par snang / la la dag la rdo rje 'chang sku mdog ser por snang / la la dag la thub pa'i dbang por snang / /la la dag la phyag na rdo rjer snang / /la la dag la spyan ras gzigs su snang / /la la dag la 'jam pa'i dbyangs su snang / /la la dag la kyai rdo rjer snang / /la la dag la dus kyi 'khor lor snang / /la la dag la 'od gsal chos skur snang / /la la dag la 'ja' 'od 'khyil par snang ba sogs/ sbyor drug gi sgom chen rnams kyis myong bas grub pa yin no/ /'gyur med bde chen ngang las ma g.yos kyang / /zhing 'dir sna tshogs gzugs kyi skur sprul ste/ /gang la gang 'dul de la der ston pa'i/ /'jam dbyangs 'gro don rgyas mdzad de la 'dud/

/sku yi snang ba ston pa brgya byin dang / /gsung gi gsang ba lha yi rnga bo che/ /thugs kyi gsang ba yid bzhin nor bu ste/ /'jam dbyangs mchog gi sprul sku de la 'dud/ /ces so/ /'di ni rgyud bla mas/ ji ltar baiḍūr+ya sa gzhi gtsang ma las/ /lha dbang lus kyi gzugs brnyan snang ba ltar/ /de bzhin 'gro sems sa gzhi gtsang ma la/ /thub pa'i dbang po'i sku yi gzugs brnyan 'char/ /zhes dang / mdo sde rgyan las/ ji ltar chu ni dang ba la/ /zla ba'i gzugs brnyan snang ba ltar/ /de bzhin sems ni dag pa la/ /sangs rgyas gzugs ni snang ba yin/ /zhes gsungs pa ltar ro/ /yang / dam pa 'di nyid/ chos gsungs pa'i 'phro la/ dge 'dun gcig gdul bya la 'gro ba gzigs te/ 'o rang gi sems rgyud ma thul bar/ gzhan gyi yar 'dren la/ chos nyan pa sogs kyi bya ba la gal chung byas/ 'jig rten 'di yi zas gos blo la bzhag nas/ kha phyogs bzhir bltas nas rgyugs 'gro/ dgong mo zan lhag nag ril le ba de gal ter khur/ slon po re snying la bkab nas log yong bar gda' ste/ snying re rje/ dge bsnyen yin na/ spang bya lnga shes par byas nas spong dgos/ bsnyen gnas pa yin na/ spang bya brgyad shes par byas nas spong dgos/ dge tshul yin na spang bya bcu shes par byas nas spong dgos/ dge slong yin na/ khrims nyis brgya lnga bcu rtsa gsum shes nas spong dgos/ de dag shes pa la bla ma slob dpon mtshan nyid dang ldan pa de tshul bzhin du bsten nas/ bya ba phal cher rang nyams su mi gtang bar/ bla ma slob dpon la zhus nas byed dgos pa yin/ de bzhin mi byed par/ dge ba'i bshes gnyen gyi thugs rgyud ni ring du bsring / rang la legs nyes 'byed pa'i shes rab kyi mig ni med/ tshul khrims kyi gos dang ni bral/ ngo tsha khrel yod kyi ske rags ni lhod/ dad pa dang nges 'byung gi nor gyis ni dbul/ snyom las dang le lo'i gzhan dbang du ni song /

'dod pa dang gnod sems kyis nyin mtshan 'da' ba ni/ 'chi bar ni nges/ nam 'chi cha ni med/ shi nas ngan song gsum po gang rung du skye ba yin te/ 'dul ba lung las/ rang ma smin par gzhan smin par byed pa ni gnas ma yin te/ go skabs med ces dang / lus la ngur smrig gyon yang sems kyi skyon ma spangs/ /skra dang kha spu dregs kyang dge sbyong tshul ma zhugs/ /lag na lhung bzed thogs kyang yon tan snod ma gyur/ /de 'dra'i dge slong de ni dge sbyong ma yin khyim pa'ang min/ /zhes gsungs shing / spyan chab bsil bar mdzad do/ /gzhan yang dam pa rnams kyi snying rje skye ba'i yul ni/ phar phyin drug gi mi mthun phyogs dang ldan pa rnams yin te/ mdo sde rgyan las/ bkren la brtse dang ma rungs rnams la brtse/ /kun 'khrugs la brtse bag med rnams la brtse/ /yul gyi gzhan dbang can la snying rje dang / /log par mngon par zhen la snying rje'o/ /zhes gsungs pa ltar ro/ /tshad med bzhi'i ljon shing la/ /byang chub sems kyi lo 'dab rgyas/ /gzhan phan 'bru'i khur gyi lci/ /skal ldan gdul bya'i re ba skong / /zhes so/ /yang gzhung bshad mdzad pa'i skabs su chos nyan pa'i grwa pa rnams la 'di ltar gsungs te/ khyed slob gnyer ba kha cig da lta dang tshugs tsam ma byung rung / slob gnyer gang yong byas la/ phyis dang tshugs byed snyam pa gda' ste/ da lta gzhon nu nas dka' ba spyad la/ blo goms par byas te/ slob gnyer dang / dang tshugs thabs shes zung 'jug du byed dgos pa yin te/ pha dam pa'i zhal nas/ gzhon pa'i dus su dka' thub rem las gyis/ /rgas nas 'byung bas mi 'chun ding ri ba/ /zhes gsungs pa ltar ro/ /yang la la dag da lta thos pa byas la/ nyams len gcig phyis nas byed snyam pa yod de/ de yang ma yin/ thos pa'i dus nyid nas nyams su len dgos te/ phyis sdod pa'i gdeng ni su la'ang med pa'i phyir te/ spyod 'jug las/

de ring kho na mi 'chi zhes/ /bde bar 'dug pa rigs ma yin/ /bdag ni med par 'gyur ba'i dus/ /de ni gdon mi za bar 'byung / /ces gsungs so/ /des na 'chi khar 'gyod pa med pa ma cig re ma lta bu gcig dgos te/ 'chi khar bzhad dga' yal le/ blo bde 'bol le/ bag dro hu re ba gcig dgos pa yin pas/ thams cad kyis thos pa'i don nyams su len pa la 'bad 'tshal gsungs/ yang kha cig gi bsam pa la/ da lta 'khor dang longs spyod ni yod/ kha drag dang rang dbang ni yod/ gang ltar byas kyang sla snyam pa 'dug ste/ 'chi ba'i tshe dam pa'i chos ma yin pa gang gis kyang phan pa med de/ rgyal sras chos rdzong pa'i zhal nas/ nor ldan lag stong sgren mor 'gro 'gyur zhing / /kha drag tsam la yud tsam sdod dbang med/ /'khor mang nang nas grogs med gcig pur 'gro/ /de dus chos min phan pa ci 'dug soms/ /zhes gsungs so/ /yang khyed slob dpon pa kha cig 'chad nyan mi mdzad pa 'dug ste/ 'chad nyan las grag pa'i gzhan don yang med/ de las grag pa'i khur yang med pa la/ gzhan gyis bskul dgos pa ni ngo tsha ste/ mdo sde rgyan las/ mgo la sems can khur chen khyer ba yis/ /sems dpa' mchog ni dal gyis 'gro mi mdzes/ /gzhan gyi bya ba nye bar gnas pa la/ /gzhan gyi bskul ba shin tu ngo yang tsha/ /zhes bshad do gsungs/ de lta bu las sogs pa gzhung 'chad pa'i skabs skabs su gsungs pa ni/ bla ma gzhan la lo zla bar chos nyan pa bas kyang / sems la phan pa/ 'tshang la 'phog pa gcig yong gi 'dug pa ni/ dri med gzhung las ji skad bshad pa bzhin/ /rang gi legs par nyams su blangs pa'i mthus/ /gzhan la mchog tu gyur pa'i nges shes skye/ /'jam dbyangs gzhan phan mthar phyin de la 'dud/ /ces so/ /yang phag lo la/ drung chen lha pas/ dpyid chos chen mo'i bdag rkyen mdzad nas/ spyod 'jug dang rgyud bla chos kyi gtso bor gsungs/ gzhan rnams zhar chos su gsungs/

lha rnams kyis me tog gi char phab/ de'i dus/ bla ma 'jam pa'i dbyangs kyi zhal nas/ khyed la la dag gi bsam pa la/ blta ba dang myong ba bzang po byung na/ spyod pa gang ltar byas kyang sla snyam pa 'dug ste/ de yang ma yin te/ lta ba mtho la/ spyod pa bag phye'i rdul bas kyang zhib pa gcig dgos so/ de yang lta ba ni mi mtho ru/ kun rdzob kyi chos rnams ni/ rmi lam lta bu/ sgyu ma/ smig rgyu/ sgra snyan/ mig yor/ chu zla lta bu 'khrul snang / sgro btags/ bsog bsob snying po med pa/ rnam shes 'khrul pa'i ngo bor cir yang snang la/ ye shes ma 'khrul ba'i ngor cung zad kyang snang ba med do/ don dam 'od gsal bde gshegs snying po ni/ dri ma med cing rang bzhin gyi 'od gsal ba/ nam mkha' ltar yangs pa/ kun la khyab pa/ 'gyur med bde chen mchog grub/ gzhom med g.yung drung chen po/ ye shes ma 'khrul ba la/ rnam pa kun dang ldan par snang la/ rnam shes 'khrul pa la gtan mi snang ba yin pas so/ /spyod pa zhib mo mi byed du/ dam chos 'dul ba la rab tu byung nas/ bslab pa'i gnas phra zhing phra ba rnams kyang khyad du ma bsad par nyams su ma blangs par/ nyes pa 'di tsam gcig las ma byung na dang zer nas/ skye ba gcod pa'i ltung byed lta bu gcig khyad du bsad na'ang / shi nas ngan song du skye ba yin te/ 'dul ba lung las/ ji snyed chos kyi rnam pas byang chub kyang / /thos pas rgyags pa tshul khrims mi bsrungs na/ /tshul khrims 'chal pa ngan 'gro der 'gro ste/ /de la thos pa mang pos skyob mi nus/ /zhes bshad pas so/ /de bas na/ kun mkhyen sa skya pas/ thub pa dgongs gsal du bshad pa ltar/ dge ba'i bshes gnyen bya ba/ spyod pa 'dul ba dang mthun pa/ bshad pa mngon pa dang mthun pa/ lta ba mdo sde dang mthun pa/ gsang sngags rgyud sde dang mthun pa/ gnyen po gzhu bzang po'i rgyud 'dra ba dang nge sgring nge ba yod pa/ sbyor ba tsan dan gyi le 'dra ba tsha ba/

bskur yang la/ brjid che ba/ 'dod pa chung zhing chog shes pa/ bso sla ba/ rgang sla ba/ chos bshad pa na 'byam klas nas 'gro ba/ nyams su len pa na/ tshigs bcad gcig la dril nas nyams su len shes pa gcig dgos pa yin no gsungs so/ /lta bas spyod pa khyad du mi gsod cing / /spyod pas lta ba khyad du mi gsod pa/ /lta spyod zung du 'brel ba'i rnal 'byor pa/ /'jam dbyangs dkon mchog bzang po'i zhabs la 'dud/ /ces so/ /bdag cag gi bla ma dam pa 'di la/ rang gi lta ba la chags pa dang gzhan gyi lta ba la zhe sdang ba mi mnga' ste/ 'jam dbyangs bla ma'i zhal nas/ lta grub kyi chags sdang 'di yang / rang re rab tu byung ba rnams kyi chags sgor 'dug pas/ 'bad pas spang dgos pa lags so/ /de yang rang gi lta ba la lhag par chags par mi bya ste/ chags zhen 'khor ba'i rgyu yin pas so/ /de ltar bram ze chen po sa ra ha'i zhal nas/ gang la zhen pa yod pa de thong zhig /rtogs par gyur na thams cad de yin no/ /zhes dang / mdzod las/ rtsod pa'i rtsa bar gyur pa dang / 'khor bar skye ba'i rgyur bshad do/ /de ltar du gang la'ang mngon zhen mi bya ste/ de bzhin gshegs pa la skyabs gnas su bden par zhen nas/ phyag 'tshal ba la sogs pa yang chags pa phra mor bshad pa dang / gzugs nas rnam mkhyen gyi bar gyi kun rdzob kyi chos rnams bden med du zhen pa dang / sbyin sogs phar phyin drug bden zhen gyi sgo nas sgrub pa dang / dus gsum tha dad du bden par lta ba sogs/ byang sems lam gyi mi mthun phyogs su bshad pas so/ /de ltar/ mngon rtogs rgyan las/ gzugs sogs phung po stong nyid dang / /dus gsum rtogs pa'i chos rnams dang / /sbyin sogs byang chub phyogs rnams la/ /spyod pa'i 'du shes mi mthun phyogs/ /zhes dang / sbyin la sogs la ngar 'dzin med/ /gzhan dag de la sbyor byed pa/ /de ni chags pa'i mtha' 'gog pas/ /rgya la sogs la chags pa phra/

/zhes bshad do/ /des na pha rol tshu rol dang / 'khor 'das gnyis kyang / mtshan 'dzin gyi 'du shes 'di yod med kyi khyad par yin te/ mdo sdud pa las/ 'du shes tshu rol yin zhes 'dren pas yongs su bsgrags/ /'du shes rnam par bshig nas spong ba pha rol 'gro/ /zhes dang / ji ltar 'dzin pa de ltar kun nas nyon mongs bstan/ /bdag dang bdag gir mi dmigs rnam par byang bar gsungs/ /zhes bshad do/ /gzhan gyi lta grub dang / gang zag la zhe sdang bar mi bya ste/ zhe sdang khong khro zhes bgyi ba/ /rtsa nyon drug gi nang nas kyang / nyon mongs rags shos yin pas/ rang gi sems rgyud ma rung bar byed pas so/ /de yang / spyod 'jug las/ zhe sdang lta bu'i sdig pa med/ /bzod pa lta bu'i dka' thub med/ /de bas bzod pa nan tan du/ /sna tshogs tshul gyis sgom par bya/ /zhes dang / gang dag khro ba bder gnas pa/ /de ni gang na'ang yod ma yin/ /zhes dang / dbu ma 'jug pa las/ mi sdug gzugs su byed cing dam pa min par dkri/ /tshul dang tshul min shes pa'i rnal 'byor 'phrog byed cing / /mi bzod pa yis myur du ngan 'gror bsgyur bar byed/ /bzod pas bshad zin dang 'gal yon tan rnam byed do/ /zhes dang / khong khros bskal pa brgyar bsags pa'i dge ba 'joms par byed de/ 'jam dpal rnam par rol pa'i mdo las/ khong khro ba zhes bya ba ni/ bskal pa brgyar bsags pa'i dge ba 'joms par byed pas na/ khong khro ba zhes bya'o/ /zhes dang / gang phyir rgyal sras rnams la khros pa yis/ /sbyin dang khrims dang dge ba bskal pa brgyar/ /bsags pa skad cig la 'joms de'i phyir/ /mi bzod las gzhan sdig pa yod ma yin/ /zhes dang / spyod 'jug las/ bskal pa stong du bsags pa yi/ /sbyin dang bde gshegs mchod la sogs/ /legs spyad gang yin de dag kyang / /khong khro gcig gis 'joms par byed/ /ces bshad do/ /bskal pa brgya dang stong gi dge rtsa 'joms pa'i khyad par ni/

khong khro skye ba'i yul dman mchog gi khyad par ro/ /yang / zhe sdang khong khro'i gong na sdig gzhan med/ /mnar med dmyal bar 'phen na'ang 'di kas 'phen/ /zhes so/ /de bas na/ bdag gi pha kun mkhyen chos rje lta bu/ phyogs su lhung ba med pa/ ris su chad pa med pa/ phyogs med ris med kyi rgyal khams pa/ ston pa bzhi ldan gyi dge slong de'i rjes su 'jug par bya ste/ dbu ma 'jug pa las/ rang gi lta ba chags dang de bzhin du/ /gzhan gyi lta ba 'khrul gang rtogs pa nyid/ /de phyir 'dod chags khong khro rnams bsal te/ /rnam dpyod pa ni myur du grol bar 'gyur/ /zhes bshad do gsungs so/ /mkhyen brtse'i 'phrin las dbang gi rgyal po de/ /chags sdang gti mug chu yis ma gos par/ /thos bsam bsgom pa'i rgyal mtshan rtser bzung ste/ /'jam dbyangs 'gro la 'dod dgu stsol la 'dud/ /ces so/ /bya lo g.yul thon rjes su/ dpal 'khor sde chen du phebs dus/ phyi rol snang ba dag la phar bltas pas/ /ljon shing lo 'dab rgyas pa sa la 'brul/ /dbyar sngon po'i ne sing zangs kyi mdog /ston lo thog rgyas pa'i rjes mi mngon/ /sos bkra ba'i me tog sad kyis khyer/ /de la 'khor ba'i bung ba'ang gzhan du dengs/ /chu sngon po shel gyi mdog ltar song / /de la 'khor ba'i bya yang yid mi chags/ /sgra med lus kyi chos ston rang rgyal bzhin/ /nang rang gi lus la tshul bltas pas/ /lang 'tsho rgas pa'i nyin byed nub la yol/ /lus kyi ri klung rgas pa'i grib mas non/ 'chi ba'i mun nag dag ni myur du 'byung / de la gros pas thar ram rat+na bha dras bsams/ /zhes dgongs te g.yeng ba spangs te/ dge sbyor la rtse gcig bzhugs par bzhed nas/ sgo yig 'di ltar mdzad de/ rtse gong 'og gi dpon sa/ dpon skya/ skya ser mi mang dang bcas pa rnams kyi dgongs rgyu la/ bdag dge slong rat+na bha dra zhes bgyi ba/ na so rgas/

'chi bas gtugs/ skye ba la 'tsher/ re zhig mtshams dam po gcig byed pa la lo 'dod dang / grags 'dod/ gzhan la bstun 'dod sogs ci yang med pas/ khyed su gang gis kyang dge sbyor la gtse bar 'gro ba mi mdzad 'tshal/ rtse gong 'og gi dpon sa sku ngo byon na mjal ba dang / sa rtsi gtong ba dang / thig tshags gtong mkhan gyi mi/ 'khyug re gtong rgyu yin/ gzhan g.yog byed mkhan gyi mi gnyis tsam ma gtogs ngo gsar pa grag zhan su yang re zhig mi 'phrad pas/ dgongs 'tshal/ 'di'i sku dpang dang / gnyer gtad la/ dpal ldan gur gyi mgon pos thog drangs/ chos skyong bsrung ma rnams bzhugs so/ /ces sgo la bsgrags nas/ bug sgo mdzad/ lo mtshams la bzhugs so/ /gsol ja yang sbyor re ma mdzad nas/ thugs dam spros med kyi ngang la rtse gcig tu bzhugs dus/ yi dam lha'i zhal gzigs tshul la sogs pa'i spang rtogs kyi yon tan nas dpag med gcig 'khrungs tshod 'dug ste/ gab pa'i tshul gyis gzhan la mi gsung bar gda'/ ched du gtad nas zhus pa'i dus su yang / dus zhabs snyan rgyud las/ de phyir bla ma dam pas gnang ba yi/ /lam zab rin chen 'di ni slob ma yi/ /chom rkun rtsa lag dag la gsang bya ste/ /'bad pas shin tu legs par sba bar bya/ /zhes dang / rje a ti sha'i zhal nas/ rang gi yon tan sba bar bya/ /gzhan gyi skyon rnams sba bar bya/ /rang gi skyon rnams bsgrag bya zhing / /gzhan gyi yon tan bsgrag par bya/ /zhes dang / jo bo'i zhal nas/ bod 'dir grub thob nyung ba'i rgyu mtshan 'dug ste/ rmi lam rno ba tsam gyi yon tan yang gsang mi thub par 'dug nged rgya gar na yon tan gsang thub pa la gtso bor byed pas/ grub thob mang ba'i rgyu mtshan yang de yin/ zhes gsungs pa rnams lung khungs su mdzad nas/ dam pa 'di yang yon tan gsang thub pa gtso bor mdzad pa yin no/ /de lta na yang phyi lus ngag gi tha snyad las/ nang gi bsam sbyor gyi yon tan dpog pa ni/

gsung rab kyi brda chad yin pas/ dam pa 'di yang / bsam pa'i yon tan byams snying rje byang chub kyi sems khyad par can dang yang ldan pa yin te/ sems can sdug bsngal gyis gzir ba gzigs pa'i tshe/ sku lus kyi ba spu ldang ba dang / spyan chab rang dbang med par bsil ba dang / zas gos la sogs pa phangs pa med pa gter bas sogs/ sbyor ba'i yon tan/ mnyam bzhag gi rtogs pa khyad par can dang ldan pa yin te/ rjes thob tu chos thams cad/ rmi lam lta bu/ sgyu ma lta bur snang ba'i spyod pa khyad par can dang ldan pa'o/ /'on kyang sku mtshams grol dus/ bdag gis sku drung du phyin pas/ da 'di nas shi 'phos nas/ 'dir skye'i nges pa tig ge ba gcig byung ngo / /skyes rabs las/ bzod bya thos pa btsal bar bya/ /de nas nags su gnas par bya/ /zhes dang / so thar gyi mdor/ mang du thos pa nags kyi nang dag tu/ /lang tsho yol ba rnams kyis gnas pa bde/ /zhes gsungs pa ltar/ rgas khar dben pa brten nas/ dge sbyor byas na rang la phan par gda' ste/ 'o skol gyi srung ma 'di rnams/ gcig por bsdad pa la cung mi dges/ sbyor drug re bshad na dges pa'i tshul ston gyi 'dug khyad par/ byi lo'i nag pa zla ba'i tshes bco lnga'i tho rangs kyang / sham bha la nas byon zer ba'i rigs ldan gyi rgyal po rnams dang / dus 'khor gyi srung ma drug cu rnams byon nas/ da lta 'di na zab lam 'dom pa la khyed chos kyi gaṇ+ḍi/ chos kyi dung / chos kyi rnga bo che yin pas shod cig gsungs/ sbyor drug gi bshad nyan la bskul ma mdzad kyi 'dug pas/ myur thabs su sbyor drug 'dzugs gsungs/ bka' lung bzhin du lhun grub bde chen du/ sbyor drug don gnyer ba'i sgom chen skya ser pho mo sum brgya tsam la/ 'khrid chen gnang / blo bzang 'di yi byin rlabs dang thugs rje la brten nas/ sgom chen la la dag la/ 'od gsal rtags bcu rdzogs par shar bar byung /

la la dag gis lus kyi rtsa gnas thams cad mthong ba byung / la la dag gis 'od gsal gyi ngang nas dbus gtsang khams gsum mthong ba byung / la la dag sgom tshang gi phyir/ gyang la thogs med du don pa byung / de'i stobs kyis/ kha cig ser sna'i mdud pa las grol nas/ bdog pa'i dngos po sbyin par gtong bar byed/ kha cig 'khor ba las yid 'byung nas/ rab tu byung ba'i bslab pa nod par byed pa sogs/ sems can la gnod 'tshe spong bar byed/ kha cig dka' spyad kyi sdug bsngal la bzod cing / gzhan gyi gnod pa la bzod par byed/ kha cig gnyid dang rmugs pa dang / le lo spangs nas/ dge ba'i phyogs la spro ba lhur len/ kha cig rnam g.yeng gi nyes dmigs mthong ste/ ri khrod 'grims nas/ mi rtog pa'i ting 'dzin sgom par byed/ kha cig bden gnyis kyi rnam dbye la ma rmongs pa'i sgo nas/ bde gshegs snying po rtag pa/ brtan pa ther zug gtsang ba dang bde ba dang / rtag pa dang / bdag dam pa'i pha rol tu phyin pa'i gnas tshul la mkhas par byed/ kha cig rgyan dang cha lugs spangs nas/ bla ma la dad pas 'bul bar byed/ zhal snga nas kyang / re shig gdul bya'i blo 'khrid pa'i phyir du/ bzhes pa'i tshul brtan nas/ 'khrid grol khar/ phar gnang sbyin dang bcas nas/ bud med kyi gnas sgor/ spyi khebs dang / skyes pa'i rna g.yu la sogs pa rnams gnang bar mdzad pa yin no/ /de'i tshe/ ngo sprod kyi dus su/ me tog sna lnga'i char babs pa/ thog la'ang mi thogs par/ zhag sbrel nas byung dus/ sgom chen dpa' bo rnams g.yas nas 'khrab cing gar byed/ dpa' mo rnams g.yon nas 'khrab cing gar byed/ lus kyi nyams 'khrul 'khor rigs mi gcig pa mang po rang shar du byed/ ngag nyams la/ saṃskri ta'i skad dang / hūm̐ dang phaṭa kyi sgras/ lung pa 'ur dir la 'gro ba dang / sems nyams la 'od gsal gyi rigs mi gcig pa du ma/ rang rang gi blo dang 'tshams par shar nas/

lus ngag yid gsum gyi sgrib pa sbyong bar byed de/ grub chen u rgyan pa'i zhal nas/ lus nyams kyis lus kyi sgrib pa sbyong / lus nyams kyi rgyal po 'phar g.yo yin/ ngag nyams kyis ngag gi sgrib pa sbyong / ngag nyams kyi rgyal po smra brjod yin/ sems nyams kyis sems kyi sgrib pa sbyong / sems nyams kyi rgyal po 'od gsal yin/ zhes gsungs pa ltar ro/ /dbang gi ye shes 'bebs pa'i skabs su/ byin rlabs kyi tshan ka shin tu che bas/ ye shes ma phebs pa gtan mi 'ong ste/ ye shes phebs pa'i rgyu tshogs grangs tshang bas so/ /rgyu tshogs rnams gang yin snyam na/ dus 'khor dbang le'i 'grel chen du/ da ni dbab pa zhes bya ba la sogs pas/ lha dbab pa bskyed pa'i mtshan nyid gsungs pa/ 'dir lha dbab pa gang yin pa de ni nges par zhes pa mtha' cig tu 'gyur te/ sngags pa slob dpon rnams kyis sgom pa'i stobs dang / sngon du bsnyen pa'i dbye ba dang ni zhes pa/ cho ga sna tshogs pa dang rnam mang dam tshig ste/ byang chub kyi sems thig le la sogs pa bsrung ba dang / de bzhin du sngags kyi bzlas pa la sogs pa rnams kyis kyang phebs par 'gyur gyi/ rnam pa gzhan du mi 'gyur ro/ /zhes gsungs pa ltar/ slob dpon gyis lha'i rnal 'byor sgom pa dang / rdzogs rim zab mo nyams su blangs pa dang / bzlas bsnyen sbyin sreg byas pa/ thig le ma nyams par bsrung ba la sogs pa bsrung bya'i dam tshig rnams bsrung ba ni/ rdo rje slob ma la dbang dus kyi ye shes phebs pa'i rgyu tshogs so/ /dkyil 'khor kyi bsgrub mchod mdzad pa dang / dbang bskur dus/ sngar bas kyang gsum 'gyur gyis bkrag mdangs che bar gyur pa dang / gang du phebs pa'i yul phyogs de byin che zhing bag dro ba dang / bzhugs pa'i gzim khang kun yang snum phyil te 'gro ba/ sa phyogs de nad nyung zhing lo legs pa dang / zhal snga nas kyi na bza'/

gzhan gyis gon nas lo song nas kyang / tshul khrims kyi dri ngad phun sum tshogs pa dang ldan pa kun gyis mthun snang du grub pa 'ong ba 'di yang / ye shes phebs pa'i rgyu dang mtshungs so/ /rim pa gnyis kyi rnal 'byor mthar phyin zhing / /bzlas bsnyen sbyin sreg cho ga dag par mdzad/ /khams ni 'dzag med sku la rab bcings pas/ /ye shes phebs nges khyod la snying nas 'dud/ /gzhan yang / dam pa 'di nyid kyis sku gsung thugs kyi mdzad pa thams cad sems can gyi don la sbyor ba mdzad pa yin te/ rje btsun byams pas/ 'jig rten kun la nyin mtshan du/ /lan drug du ni so sor gzigs/ /thugs rje chen po dang ldan pas/ /phan dgongs khyod la phyag 'tshal lo/ /zhes gsungs pa ltar/ yul 'jig rten kun la/ dus nyin mtshan gcig gi bar la/ lan drug gi sgo nas gzigs tshul dang / gang zag su ni smin/ su ni ma smin so sor gzigs te/ thams cad la thugs rjes phan pa'i thabs 'ba' zhig mdzad pas/ de yang sku mthong ba dang / reg pa dang / dran pa thams cad kyang ngan song du mi ltung bar/ mtho ris dang / thar pa thams cad mkhyen pa thob par gyur cig pa'i smon lam 'debs pa dang / gnas skabs rnams su yang / rang rang gi mos pa dang skal bar 'tshams par/ gdul bya 'ga' zhig ni skyabs su 'gro ba dang / ma ṇi sogs la 'god/ 'ga' zhig ni bsnyen gnas yan lag brgyad ldan sogs la 'god/ 'ga' zhig ni dge tshul dge slong la sogs pa so sor thar pa'i sdom pa mtha' dag la 'god/ la la dag byang chub sems dpa'i sdom pa la sbyor/ 'ga' zhig gsang sngags kyi bslab pa la 'god/ 'ga' zhig sdom pa mtha' dag dang ldan par byed/ 'ga' zhig ni 'chi bdag dang log 'dren las bskyabs nas/ tshe dang rigs rgyud bzang po'i dngos grub la sbyor/ 'ga' zhig ni 'khor ba spyi dang bye brag gi nyes dmigs go nas/ mtho ris dang thar pa la mdun par byed/ 'ga' zhig ni mkhan slob dang /

dkon mchog gsum la mos par byed/ 'ga' zhig ni sems can la byams snying rje 'phel bar byed/ 'ga' zhig ni snang grags kyi chos rnams la dag snang dang zhing sbyong bar byed/ 'ga' zhig ni thos bsam gyi phyir du/ snying rus dang dka' spyad bzod pa la 'god/ 'ga' zhig ni tshe blos btang nas/ sgrub pa bya ba'i phyir du dben gnas brten pa la sbyor/ 'ga' zhig nyams rtogs kyis rgyan te 'khrid skyong ba la sbyor/ 'ga' zhig ni 'chad rtsod rtsom gsum gyi sgo nas sangs rgyas kyi bstan pa gsal bar mdzad pa la sbyor/ 'ga' zhig ni longs spyod g.yo ba snying po med pa la/ snying po len pa'i thabs/ sbyin pa gtong ba la sbyor/ la la brten gsum bzhengs pa dang / mchod pa 'bul ba sogs la 'god/ 'ga' zhig ni rje rang nyid la che ba'i yon tan brjod pa dang / gsol ba 'debs pa la 'jug 'ga' zhig ni/ dam pa 'di nyid kyi sku la na bza' 'bul ba dang / zhal du gsol ba gang 'phrod/ dges pa'i thabs ci yod snyam du sems pa la 'jug par mdzad do/ /de yang bla ma dang zab lam gyi byin rlabs yin pas/ zab lam 'di la brten nas/ grub thob rgyun ma chad pa byung zhing / mkha' 'gro'i kha rlangs thul le ba'i lam 'di 'dra ba nyams len byed pa dang / 'di 'dra ba'i brgyud pa'i bla ma la gsol ba 'debs pa'i skal pa yod pa 'di sngon tshogs bsags pa yin te/ mngon rtogs rgyan las/ sangs rgyas rnams la lhag par byas/ /de la dge ba'i rtsa ba bskrun/ /dge ba'i bshes kyi mgon bcas pa/ /'di mnyan pa yi snod yin no/ /zhes gsungs pa ltar ro/ /gzhan yang / dam pa 'di nyid/ snang ba bden med sgyu ma lta bur rtogs pas/ 'jig rten gyi chos brgyad dang bral te/ chos yang dag par sdud pa'i mdo las/ stong pa nyid smra ba ni mi gnas pa'i phyir/ 'jig rten gyi chos rnams kyis mi 'phrog ste/ rnyed pas dga' ba yang med la/ ma rnyed pas ma dga' ba yang med/

grags pas yid sos pa yang med la/ ma grags pas yid shi ba yang med/ smad pas zhum pa yang med la/ bstod pas dga' bar sems pa yang med/ bde bas chags par 'gyur ba yang med la/ sdug bsngal bas yid 'byung bar 'gyur ba yang med de/ gang de ltar 'jig rten gyi chos rnams kyis mi 'phrog pa de ni stong pa nyid shes pa ste/ de ltar mi 'phrog pas stong pa nyid smra bar khong du chud par bya'o/ /zhes gsungs pa dang / bshes spring las kyang / 'jig rten mkhyen pa rnyed dang ma rnyed dang / /bde dang mi bde snyan dang mi snyan dang / /bstod smad ces bya 'jig rten chos brgyad po/ /bdag gi yid yul min par 'go snyoms mdzod/ /ces dang / spyod 'jug las kyang / de ltar stong pa'i dngos rnams la/ /thob pa ci yod shor ci yod/ /gang gi rim gro byas pa'am/ /yongs su brnyas pa'ang ci zhig yod/ /bde ba'am sdug bsngal gang las yin/ /mi dga' ci yod dgar ci yod/ /ces gsungs pa ltar/ rnyed ma rnyed la sogs pa la dga' mi dga'i rnam pa mi 'byung ste/ rnyed bkur phun sum tshogs pa byung ba la lhag par mnyes par yang mi mngon la/ ngan ngon las ma byung na'ang mi mnyes par yang mi mngon no/ /snang grag chos kun sgyu mar rtogs pa'i phyir/ /bstod smad la sogs 'jig rten chos brgyad la/ /mtshan 'dzin spangs pa'i 'dzam gling rgyan gcig pu/ /'jam dbyangs chos rje'i zhabs la snying nas 'dud/ /ces so/ /dgu pa yon tan dgu sogs ldan tshul ni/ yang spyod 'jug las/ bsod nams kyis ni lus bde la/ /mkhas pa yis ni sems bde na/ /gzhan don 'khor bar gnas kyang ni/ /snying rje can dag ji ltar skyo/ /zhes gsungs pa ltar/ dam pa 'di nyid kyi bsod nams kyi tshogs dpag med las grub pa'i sku'i yon tan ni/ shing n+ya gro ta ltar chu zheng gab pa dang / yan lag dang nying lag thams cad tshad dang ldan zhing / gser gyi mdog ltar mdzes shing kun gyis lta na sdug pa yid du 'ong ba/

gzi brjid dang ldan pa/ zil che ba/ byang chub kyi sems brtan par byed pa nyid kyis/ bu chung gi sha ltar gzhon sha chags pa/ bkrag mdangs che ba/ 'od dang 'od zer 'phro ba/ ro stod seng ge 'dra ba/ dbu gdugs ltar rgyas pa/ dpral ba'i dbyes che ba/ 'gram pa seng ge'i 'gram pa 'dra ba/ thal gong rgyas pa/ dpung mgo zlum pa/ sku yi mdun mtho ba/ phyag dang zhabs kyi long bu mi mngon pa/ shing bal ltar 'jam pa/ rting pa yangs pa/ phyal 'phyang nge ba dang / lte ba zab pa la sogs pa'i mtshan dpe dang ldan pa/ sku'i dbyibs kha dog bkod pa la sogs pa gdul bya'i mos pa'i dbang gis so sor snang ba/ khyad par tshul khrims kyi dri ma pad+ma'i+i dri bsung can nyams dga' ba/ rdzi phyogs dang rdzi phyogs ma yin par yang rgyu ba'i dbang gis/ sku mdun nas 'bral bar mi phod pa/ ye shes kyi mkha' 'gro ma sprin bzhin 'du ba/ chos skyong srung ma rnams bran bzhin du khol ba yod do/ /gzhan yang gnyer ma med pa dang / rtsa mi mngon zhing mdud pa med pa dang / gsang ba'i gnas bltar mi mngon pa dang / phyi'i srin bu shig dang / nang gi srin bu mi 'byung ba sogs phyir mi ldog pa'i rtags dang / spyod lam mchong ba dang / rgyug pa dang / nyal ba dang / bsnyes pa sogs kyi skyon spangs nas/ zhi zhing dul ba la sogs pa'i sgo nas/ gzhan gyi yid 'phrog par byed pa ni/ mdo sdud pa las/ bzod pas gzugs bzang dam pa dge ba rgya chen thob par 'gyur te/ gser mdog sdug cing 'gro bas lta ba'i 'os su 'gyur/ zhes dang / so thar gyi mdo las/ 'jug ngogs bde ba'i chu klung bde/ /chos la goms pa'i skye bo bde/ /nga 'o nga rgyal zad pa bde/ /tshul khrims ldan pa mthong na bde/ /mang du thos pa mthong na bde/ /zhes dang / tshul khrims rnam dag gi mdo las/ de'i phyir ston pas tshul khrims rab bsngags bshad/ /tshul khrims ldan pa sangs rgyas 'byung dang 'phrad/ /tshul khrims ldan pa dga' ba kun gyi gnas/

/tshul khrims ldan pa gdung ba bsil ba'i chu/ /tshul khrims ldan pa dri dang byug pa yin/ /tshul khrims ldan pa 'jig rten kun gyis bstod/ /tshul khrims dag gis 'gro ba dam pa nos/ /ji ltar sbrul gdug klu chen nag po yang / /tshul khrims ldan la gnod med gzhan ci smos/ tshul khrims ldan pa'i dge slong 'od dang ldan/ /zhes gsungs pa ltar ro/ /bsod nams las grub mtshan dpe'i rgyan gyis mdzes/ /lta na sdug cing kun gyi yid 'phrog pa/ /dri zhim me tog la ni bung ba bzhin/ /'jam dbyangs 'bral mi phod la phyag 'tshal lo/ /zhes dang / gsung gi yon tan ni/ gsal ba/ dag pa/ dod pa/ snyan pa/ 'jam pa/ mnyen pa/ 'khril chags pa dang ldan pa yin gyis/ brdzun/ phra ma/ tshig rtsub/ ngag 'khyal te/ mi dge ba'i ngag gi las spangs zhing / tshongs/ so nam/ skyes pa bud med la sogs pa'i bre mo'i gtam lung ma bstan rnams kyang mi gsung ste/ spyod 'jug las/ bre mo'i gtam ni sna tshogs dang / /ngo mtshar ltad mo sna mang pos/ /kun la 'jug par gyur pas na/ /chags pa med par gnas par bya/ /zhes dang / gzhan gyi skyon brjod pa dang / yon tan sbas pa la sogs pa'i ngag gi nyes pa dang bral ste/ de nyid las/ gal te skyon 'dzin slu sems bsam/ /rgod dang ga zhar bcas pa'am/ /smra bar 'dod pa'i sems byung tshe/ /de tshe shing bzhin gnas par bya/ /zhes gsungs pa ltar ro/ /gal te grub mtha' la log pa zhugs pa dang / mi dge ba cher spyod pa dang / drung na yod pa'i chags phyi ba/ bag dang mi ldan pa rnams la/ cung zad bka' bkyon pa ltar gnang yang / thugs brtse bas ma phod pas/ bya stong dang gros 'debs mdzad pa ma gtogs/ khro ba'i bsam pa cung zad kyang mi mnga' ba/ zhun mar ltar yod pa yin no/ /des na/ dam pa 'di nyid kyi gsung ni/ thog mar dge ba/ bar du dge ba/ tha mar dge ba/ don bzang po/ tshig 'bru bzang po/ ma 'dres pa/ yongs su dag pa/ yong du byang ba/

bcom ldan 'das kyis legs par gsungs pa'i chos 'dul ba la nges par 'byung ba/ mi mthun pa med cing / mthun pa dang ldan pa/ rten pa yod pa/ rgyu ba gcad pa yin te/ 'di nyid kyi chab klog dang / bsngo ba mdzad pa'i yon tan gcig pu la'ang / mkhas rlom gzhan gyis yon tan ril pos/ char mi phod pa'i phyir ro/ /mi dge ba dang lung ma bstan gyi ngag /nam yang mi smra brtse bas tshangs dbyangs kyi/ /'gro la thar lam ston pa'i mkhyen pa can/ /'jam dbyangs ngag gi dbang phyug de la 'dud/ /ces so/ /thugs kyi yon tan ni/ thog mar dad pa'i yon tan la/ 'khor ba la nges par 'byung ba'i dad pa/ las 'bras la mi slu ba'i dad pa/ dkon mchog la yid ches pa'i dad pa gsum las/ dkon mchog la yid ches pa'i dad pa ni/ spyir chos 'brel yod pa'i bla ma rnams la dad cing / bye brag tu kun mkhyen 'jam pa'i dbyangs shes rab rgyal mtshan gyi rnam thar gzigs pa'i tshe/ spyan chab char bzhin du 'bab pa dang / grub chen kun dga' blo gros rgyal mtshan dpal bzang po'i rnam thar dngos grub kyi rgya mtsho zhes bya ba mdzad cing / gzhan la 'chad pa'i tshe spyan chab bsil zhing / rje 'gran gyi do med rnam gnyis kyi sku 'dra khyad par can/ rgyu gser zangs las grub pa/ mtshar du mngar ba/ khru tshad ma re bzhengs su gsol nas/ gsol ba rtse gcig tu 'debs par mdzad cing / dgongs pa rdzogs thabs kyi dus mchod/ de gnyis kyi bstan pa dar rgyas spel ba'i slad du/ gsung rab la 'chad nyan/ man ngag la nyams len sogs rtse gcig tu mdzad do/ /dkon mchog gsum gyi rten gsum gzigs pa'i tshe/ rgyu bzang ngan dbyibs mtshar mi mtshar ci 'dug kyang / ston pa'i 'du shes dngos kyis phyag dang mchod pa mdzad/ gzhan la yang 'o skol gyi skyabs gnas dngos yin pas/ 'o brgyal bar mi bzhag gang byung ma byed par gus pa'i tshul gyis phyag dang mchod pa gyis zhes gsungs so/

/khyad par du ston pa'i yon tan la shes nas dad pa thob pa dang / bdag cag rnams kyi don du dka' spyod dpag med mdzad nas/ bla med rdzogs pa'i byang chub mnyes par mdzad de/ gang la gang 'tshams kyi chos kyi 'khor lo bskor nas/ gdul bya mang po smin grol la bkod pa dang / 'gro ba kun gyi phan bde ma lus pa'i 'byung gnas mdzad pa'i bka' drin rjes su dran pa'i phyir du/ ston pa sangs rgyas kyi sku/ jo bo'i sku tshad las/ phyag mtho gang gis che ba/ rgyu rin po che gser zangs las grub pa/ de bzhin gshegs pa rnams kyi sku gdung ring bsrel dang / rje btsun bla ma gong ma skyes bu dam pa rnams kyi sku gdung ring bsrel dang / bde bar gshegs pa'i sku gsung thugs kyi rten byin rlabs can mang po'i rten rdzong gis phyur byur btams pa'i mtshar du mngar ba bzhengs te/ rje btsun dam pa nyid kyis thog drangs/ dge 'dun tshogs pa rgya mtsho lta bus/ rab gnas dang bkra shis kyi mnga' dbul la sogs pa rgyas par mdzad nas/ 'gro ba kun gyi mgon skyabs dang dpung gnyen dam par bzhugs so/ /'di yi ched du gser zangs phul ba/ mchod cha phud dang na bza' phul/ mchod rdzas dang snyan dar phul ba/ bka' ru ma phul ba la sogs pa'i sbyin bdag rnams dang / bu slob mang pos kyang / yul khyad par can la brten pa'i tshogs rgya chen po 'dums par mdzad do/ ston pa'i yon tan shes nas dad pa thob/ /sku drin rjes su dran dang rang gzhan gyis/ /tshogs gnyis rgya cher spel phyir 'di bzhengs pas/ /'gro ba kun gyi mgon skyabs dam par 'gyur/ /zhes so/ /bde bar gshegs pa'i sku'i rten ri mor bris pa dang / lugs su blug pa la sogs pa gzhan yang mang po bzhengs nas/ mchod rten dam par bzhugs so/ /gzhan yang byams snying rje byang chub kyi sems khyad par can mnga' ba'i rgyu mtshan gyis/ gdul bya gzhan la tshad med bzhi dang / byang chub kyi sems bskyed pa'i dmigs pa 'bogs pa'i tshe/

myong ba khyad par can rgyud la skyes pa 'ong ba ni/ byang chub sems gnyis legs par 'byongs pa'i mthus/ /chos kyi gsung gis gdul bya'i shes rgyud la/ /mchog tu gyur pa'i nges shes bskyed mdzad pa'i/ /chos rje rin po che la gsol ba 'debs/ /zhes pa ltar ro/ /lhag par nad pa la thugs brtse ba yin pas/ nad pa la sman dang / rim gro'i chos dang / lha rje dang nad g.yog pa la'ang / 'di bzhin gyi bka' lung nan che ba gnang zhing / phal cher la gzigs thog mdzad pa la/ zhal snga nas rang phebs/ thugs ma skabs pa'i dus/ phyag phyi ba rnams skor ba la gtong ngo / /bla ma gtsang pa la sogs pa'i dbul phongs rnams kyang / zas gos kyi tshim par mdzad do/ /lung dang mngon par rtogs pa'i yon tan la/ lung gi yon tan ni/ mdo rgyud bstan bcos kun gyi glegs bam gcig tu gyur pa lta bu yin pa ni gong du brjod zin la/ mngon par rtogs pa'i yon tan ni/ bar srid gzigs pa la sogs pa'i lha'i mig gi mngon shes dang / lus kyi bkod pa du ma ston pa la sogs pa'i rdzu 'phrul gyi mngon shes dang / don dam pa'i sgra phra rags ci rigs su thos pa la sogs pa'i lha'i rna ba'i mngon shes dang / gzhan gyi sgom byed tshul dang / rnam rtog 'gyu tshul la sogs pa ji lta ba bzhin mkhyen pa'i gzhan sems shes pa'i mngon shes dang / gang zag 'di zhes bya ba rten de nas shi 'phos nas/ 'dir skyes pa yin pa 'dug 'di nas shi 'phos nas 'di 'drar skye ba sogs/ rnal lam du byung ba ltar gsungs pas kyang / 'chi 'pho dang / skye ba rig pa'i mngon shes yod par grub bo/ /de ltar/ mdo sde rgyan las/ bsam gtan bzhi pa shin tu dag thob nas/ /mi rtog ye shes yongs su bzung ba dang / /ji ltar rnam gnas yid la byed pa las/ /mthu grub pa yi dam pa thob par 'gyur/ /zhes gsungs pa ltar ro/ /'chad rtsod rtsom gsum gyi yon tan la/ dang po gnyis brjod zin la/

dam pa 'di nyid kyis rtsom pa mdzad pa la/ 'dul ba'i gleng 'bum theg bsdus kyi ṭī ka phar phyin gyi sbyor ṭīka dbu ma'i stong thun/ grub chen gyi rnam thar chen mo/ gsang don rab gsal gsal byed/ slob dpon klu sgrub kyis mdzad pa'i smon lam 'khor ba 'khor tshe ma'i ṭī ka nyes gsum spong ba'i bstan bcos mtshungs med chos blo'i bstod pa/ sbyor drug rgyud pa'i gsol 'debs/ dben pa'i yon tan brjod pa'i bstan bcos la sogs mang du mdzad do/ /thos bsam sgom gsum gyi yon tan la/ dang po gnyis brjod zin la sgom pa'i yon tan ni/ sbas pa'i tshul du mdzad nas/ dngos su ni su la'ang mi gsung la/ 'on kyang rdzogs pa'i byang chub las phyir mi ldog pa'i rtags/ mnyam bzhag dang rjes thob kyi rtog pa khyad par can gnyis dang ldan pa'am/ thabs shes khyad par can gnyis dang ldan pa yin la/ de yang nang na mnyam bzhag gi shes rab khyad par can dang ldan pa yin te/ rjes thob kyi gnas skabs na/ gzugs sogs phyi nang gi dngos po gang la'ang zhen pa dang bral nas/ rmi lam dang sgyu ma lta bu'i nyams shar/ rang nyid de ltar du longs spyad cing / gzhan la'ang zhen pa 'di/ 'o skol rnams 'ching ba'i rgyu yin pas/ gang la'ang zhen pa chung bar mdzod/ ces ngag gi sgo nas 'dom pa'i lus ngag gi spyod pa khyad par can dang ldan pa'o/ /yang nang na thabs khyad par can byang chub kyi sems dang ldan te/ sems can 'dod chags la sogs pa'i nyon mongs drag pos gzir ba dang / bkres skom la sogs pa dang / tsha grang la sogs pa dang / nad dang mya ngan la sogs pa'i sdug bsngal drag pos gzir ba gzigs pa'i tshe na/ sku lus kyi ba spu ldang ba dang / spyan chab bsil ba dang / re sdug snying re rje zhes pa la sogs pa'i smre sngags gsung bas so/ /de ltar sa bcu pa'i mdo las/ du ba las ni mer shes dang / /chu skyar las ni chur shes ltar/ /byang chub sems dpa' blo ldan gyi/

/rigs ni mtshan ma dag las shes/ /zhes dang / yum gyi mdo las/ rnam pa de dag dang / rtags de dag dang / mtshan ma de dag dang ldan pa'i byang chub sems dpa' phyir mi ldog pa nyid du rigs par bya'o/ /zhes dang / mdo sdud pa las/ 'tsho ba'i phyir ni ya ngas longs spyod tshol mi byed/ /drag shul sbyor sngags mi byed bud med sbyor sngags min/ /'dod pa'i las can pho mor 'gyur zhes ston mi byed/ /rab tu dben pa'i shes rab pha rol phyin mchog brtson/ /'thab dang rtsod dang bral zhing byams pa'i sems dang ldan/ /kun mkhyen 'dod cing bstan la rtag tu gzhol sems ldan/ /mtha' 'khob skye bo kla klo'i yul dag rnam par spangs/ /rang gi sa la rtag tu dgos med ri rab 'dra/ /chos phyir srog kyang 'dor cing rnal 'byor rab tu brtson/ /mi ldog rtags ni 'di dag yin par shes par bya/ /zhes gsungs pas/ khyab pa grub bo/ /mkhas btsun bzang gsum gyi yon tan la/ dang po ni brjod zin la/ btsun pa'i yon tan khyad par can ni/ bcas pa dang rang bzhin gyi kha na ma tho ba'i nyes pa phra zhing phra ba rnams kyis ma gos par mdzad de/ dam chos 'dul ba'i gnang bkag la shin tu mkhas pa'i sgo nas/ pham lhag gi nyes pas gos pa lta smos ci dgos/ 'chang bral 'jog gsum la sogs pa'i spang ba dang / skye ba gcod pa la sogs pa'i ltung byed dang / rtsa ltung la sogs pa'i nyes byas kyis kyang ma gos par mdzad cing / dper na slob dpon las 'dzin rnams gral sgrig pa'i tshe na'ang / lo rgan rim gyis gral la bzhugs/ rgan pa 'di la'ang / 'dul ba lung nas lnga bshad de/ /mi gang rigs kyi rgan pa dang / /lo yis rgan dang nor gyis rgan/ /thos pas rgan dang bslab pas rgan/ /lnga las phyi ma gtso bo yin/ /zhes bshad pas/ bslab gral byed dgos pa ni/ rab tu byung ma thag tu grib tshod gzhal ba'i dgos pa yin pa/ glang po che dang ri bong dang bya gong ma sreg la sogs pa'i dpe'i sgo nas gsungs pas/

spyir btang du de ltar gral sgrig dgos so/ /'on kyang dmigs bsal du thos pas rgan pa gral mgor 'jog pa yang yod de/ ston pa'i drung du/ gnas brtan 'od srung chen po dang / 'phags pa 'jam dpal gral mgor 'di bzhugs ma 'cham pa'i tshe/ ston pa'i zhal na/ 'od srung chen po bslab pas rgan yang / 'phags pa 'jam dpal thos pas rgan pas/ da lan 'jam dpal gral mgor bzhugs zhes gsungs/ de la brten nas deng sang dpal ldan sa skya pa phyogs kyi dge bshes rnams la ston gral zhes bya ba 'dug pas/ de bzhin gyi gral bsgrig lugs byed dgos kyis/ 'grogs gral du ma song ba byed dgos gsung ste/ rang res nyan shes na/ gral bsgrig pa'i dus su'ang blo bskyed re 'ong / de nas zas kyi bya ba mdzad pa'i tshe/ 'o dus rung gi zas la dus su longs spyod pas chog pa 'di yang dkon mchog gi bka' drin yin pas/ dkon mchog gsum rjes su dran pa re thon gsungs/ de nas zas za lugs 'di la/ spyod 'jug las/ cha bzhir bgos nas cha gcig rang gis za/ cha gsum ni rim pa bzhin/ log par ltung ba'i dud 'gro dang / mgon med pa yi sprang po dang / brtul zhugs 'dzin pa'i rab byung sogs 'tsho bas phongs pa rnams la sbyin dgos te/ de nyid las/ log par ltung dang mgon med dang / /brtul zhugs gnas la bgo bya zhing / /ran pa tsam du bza' bya ste/ /chos gos gsum ma gtogs pa sbyin/ /zhes gsungs pa ltar ro/ /'dul ba nas/ 'bu ba dang / 'gyur ba dang / /zhes bya ba la sogs pa gsungs pa ltar/ 'du shes bcu yid la byas nas za bar bshad do/ /bshes spring las/ rang la nad pa'i 'du shes dang / zas la sman gyi 'du shes nye bar bzhag nas za bar bshad de/ de nyid las/ kha zas sman dang 'dra bar rigs nas ni/ /'dod chags zhe sdang med par brten bgyid de/ /rgyags phyir ma lags snyem pa'i phyir ma lags/ /'tshags phyir ma lags lus gnas 'ba' zhig phyir/

/zhes gsungs pa ltar/ bza' bar bya ba yin la/ za tshul ni/ so thar gyi mdo las/ zas la legs par bya ba drug /ces gsungs pa ltar/ cag cag mi byed/ cug cug mi bya/ kham 'phro la mi gcad/ mkhur ba mi spo/ rkan mi gtogs/ kha kham gyis bkang ste smra bar mi bya/ zhes/ dam pa rang nyid kyang de ltar mdzad cing / gzhan la'ang de ltar 'doms par mdzad pa sogs/ spyod lam rnam pa bzhi/ zhi zhing dul ba'i sgo nas kyang / gzhan gyi yid 'phrog par mdzad cing / blo bskyed yong ba gcig yod do/ /yang zab lam gyi 'khrid skyong ba'i dus shig bka' bcu pa yon tan dpal bzang gis/ zan gyi phud nas/ mtheb kyu mang po rang gcad/ ja la'ang phud thor thor mang po byed pa'i tshe/ zhal snga nas/ 'o rnal 'byor pa bya ba/ rang nyid lhar lam te bsgoms nas/ zas kyi bya ba byed pa yin mod/ rnam rtog gi spro bsdu mang po la dgos pa med/ khyad par du rang re pa/ spros med kyi dmigs rnam skyong dgos pa'i skabs su'ang / chos nyid spros dang bral ba la/ shes pa'ang spros dang bral bar bzhag dgos pa la/ chos can spros dang bcas pa la/ blo yang spros dang bcas pa zhig gis/ bzo lum dang rtog btags mang po byed kyin 'dug te/ grub thob rgyun ma chad par byon pa'i lam/ mkha' 'gro'i kha rlangs thul le ba'i chos 'di la de lta bu'i rnam rtog gi bzo byas na/ bar chad kyi dbang du song dogs 'dug go gsungs so/ /zhal ta de ltar gnang dus/ gral la phyogs gcig bzhugs pa kun yang / skrag chums pa byung ba la/ bla ma la shin tu mos pa re byung mod/ zhal ta gnang ba ltar/ khong pa phyis bar chad kyi dbang du song ba gcig byung ngo / /kha na ma tho'i nyes rnams kyis/ /nam yang gos pa mi mnga' zhing / /sgo gsum zhi zhing dul ba yis/ /gzhan la'ang de ltar 'doms la 'dud/ /ces so/ /bzang ba'i yon tan ni/ bdag gzhan rje bar nus pa'i kun rdzob byang chub kyi sems sbyong ba dang /

gtso bor chos nyid la mnyam par 'jog pa'i don dam byang chub gyi sems sbyong la legs par goms pa'i mthus/ gzhan gyis skur ba la sogs gsan pa'i tshe/ 'o skol blo sbyong pa rgad po yin pas/ rkyen ngan byang chub kyi lam du sgyur gsungs nas/ skur ba 'debs mkhan la lhag par yang snying rje che cher 'phel bar mdzad de/ ngag tu yang / gang dag bdag la kha zer ram/ /gzhan dang gnod pa byed pa'am/ /de bzhin 'phyar kha gtong kyang rung / /thams cad byang chub skal ldan shog /ces pa'i smon lam 'debs par mdzad do/ /gzhan dag gnod lan gnod pas 'jal/ /pho rgod po des rang gzhan phung / /khyod ni gnod len phan pas sgrub/ /don gnyis mthar phyin de la 'dud/ /ces so/ /sbyin sogs pha rol tu phyin pa drug la spyod tshul ni/ thog mar sbyin pa la spyod tshul mdo tsam brjod na/ dam pa 'di nyid kyis/ yo byad kyi dngos po thams cad zhing rnam pa gsum gyi phyogs su gtong bar mdzad cing / zhing gsum ni/ mdzod las/ phan 'dogs pa dang sdug bsngal dang / /yon tan rnams kyi zhing khyad 'phags/ /zhes pa ltar ro/ /zhing gi mchog dge 'dun yin par dgongs te/ chos sde gong 'og gnyis na yod pa'i dge 'dun tshogs pa rnams la/ nam gzas thog drangs sku chas tshang ma'i gnang sbyin mang ja dang bcas pa/ lo re la lan gnyis gsum re ma chag pa mdzad nas/ dge rtsa bla ma gong ma'i dgongs pa rdzogs thabs dang / tshe 'di yi pha mas thog drangs/ sems can thams cad la bde skyid kyi dpal 'byor 'byung ba'i phyir du/ tshogs kyi dbu mdzad la gnang sbyin bsngo rten chen po gnang nas bsngo ru 'jug go /gzhan sbyin pa la bskul ba'i tshe/ ser sna shin tu che ba'i gang zag de/ rang gi lag pa g.yas pas/ lag pa g.yon pa la sbyin du 'jug de la goms nas/ tshod ma phor gang tsam gzhan la sbyin du 'jug de la goms nas/ zan gong re tsam sbyin du 'jug de la goms nas yo byad kyi dngos po thams cad sbyin pa gtong ba yod/

de la goms nas/ phyis rim gyis rang gi sha yang sbyin par gtong ba la spro ba 'byung ste/ spyod 'jug las/ tshod ma la sogs sbyin pa la/ /'dren pas thog mar sbyor bar mdzad/ /de la goms nas phyis nas ni/ /rim gyis rang gi sha yang gtong / /zhes bshad pa ltar ro gsungs/ sbyin yul gyi khyad par ni/ dud 'gro brgya la byin pa bas/ mi gcig la byin pa phan yon che/ mi phal brgya la byin pa bas/ dge slong rnam dag gcig la byin pa phan yon che/ nyan thos kyi dge slong brgya la byin pa bas/ byang chub sems dpa'i dge slong gcig la byin pa phan yon che/ byang chub sems dpa' brgya la byin pa bas/ sangs rgyas gcig la phul ba phan yon che/ sangs rgyas brgya la phul ba bas/ rang la chos ston pa'i rtsa ba'i bla ma dam pa gcig la phul ba phan yon che bar bshad do/ /bla ma lnga bcu pa las kyang / mchod pa thams cad yongs spangs nas/ /bla ma mchod pa yang dag brtsam/ /zhes sogs gsungs pa ltar gyis shig gsungs so/ sbyin 'bras kyi dbang du bgyis na/ sbyin sogs bsod nams kyi tshogs kyis 'bras bu mthar thug ni/ gtso bor gzugs sku'i byed/ gnas skabs su/ longs spyod 'phel/ skye bo khungs su 'du/ 'khon zhi bar byed pa sogs yin te/ de ltar sngon thub pa'i dbang po la dad pas kun nas bslangs te/ sran ma spar gang gtor bas/ sran rdo lnga lhung bzed kyi nang du lhung ba'i sbyin 'bras la gling bzhi dang / sum cu rtsa gsum man chad la dbang 'gyur ba'i/ sngon gyi rgyal po grags pa mtha' yas kyi gtam rgyud sogs dang / mnga' ris kyi rgyal po lha bla ma byang chub 'od kyang / sngon dge slong gcig la 'bras phul gang byin pa'i sbyin 'bras la longs spyod pa yin zhes/ rje btsun sgrol ma gsungs so/ /des na nang gi blo 'dis bcag na/ sbyin pa'i dngos pos ma bcag rgyu gang yang med pa gcig yin gsungs te/ shin tu mid par gda'o/

/chos kyi sbyin pa ni/ rgya cher gtong bar mdzad do/ /pha rol tu phyin pa phyi ma rnams la'ang / rang nyid kyis spyod tshul dang / gzhan de rnams la sbyor tshul sogs ni/ yi ge mang bas 'jigs nas ma bris so/ /phrin las rnam pa bzhi'i sgo nas 'gro don mdzad tshul ni/ phal cher ni zhi rgyas gnyis kyi sgo nas 'gro don mdzad la/ rten la rab gnas mdzad pa'i bgegs skrad dang / nad pa gdon drag pos gzir ba'i bgegs skrad sogs drag po'i sgo nas mdzad pa'i tshe/ la la dag la rdo rje 'chang du snang / la la dag la phyag na rdo rjer snang / la la dag la kyai rdo rjer snang / la la dag la gur gyi mgon por snang / la la dag la dmar nag 'jigs gsum du snang / la la dag la 'od gsal du snang / la la dag la mtshon char snang / la la dag la me dpung du snang / bstan pa'i sbyin bdag chen mo/ bdag mo tshe brtan rgyal mo sku khams bsnyel dus/ bgegs skrod mdzad pa'i tshe/ bla ma dang gtor ma gnyis ka yang me dpung du 'bar bar gzigs pa'i phyir ro/ /bsdu ba'i dngos po bzhi'i sgo nas 'gro don mdzad tshul ni/ bdag gi bla ma khams gsum chos kyi rgyal po 'di yis snyan pa'i grags pas sa steng ma lus pa khyab pas/ dbus gtsang khams gsum nas 'dus pa'i gsung chos don gnyer ba'i tshogs dpag tu med pa/ pad+mas khebs pa'i mtsho la ngang pa'i tshogs rang dbang med par 'du ba ltar 'dus nas/ de dag rnams la chos dang zang zing sogs kyi sgo nas phan 'dogs mdzad pa ni bsam gyis mi khyab bo/ /de yang / sbyin pa'i g.yab mos legs bos nas/ /snyan par smra ba'i gtam byas te/ /don spyod pa yis bag pheb nas/ /don mthun gros chen nges par gdab/ /ces gsungs pa ltar/ khams yul sogs nas 'ongs pa'i gsung chos don gnyer ba/ 'tsho chas med pa rnams la/ rgyags dang chu rdor gyi gnang sbyin sogs/ mkho ba'i yo byad med pa rnams la/ gos gdan gyi gnang sbyin/

gang dag nad sna tshogs kyis gzir ba/ skyabs med pa/ mgon med pa/ 'tshog chas dang / sman mi bdog pa/ dpung gnyen med pa/ dbul ba sdug bsngal ba rnams la/ mgon skyabs dang dpung gnyen/ sman dang / 'tsho ba'i gnang sbyin/ khyad par chos kyi 'jug ston/ bar ston/ grol ston rnams bla brang nas nges pa can mdzad la/ sgom chen pa rnams la dmigs pa 'bogs dus/ sbyin bdag zur pa med na/ bla brang nas ja sogs mdzad pas khyab bo/ /gzhan yang dbul phongs kyis gzir ba'i slong mo pa dag la/ byin zhig bkur zhig ser sna ma byed par chen po byin zhig mang po bkur zhig gsung / sku drung du 'ongs pa'i sbyin bdag rnams ni/ mtshan dpes spras pa'i sku mthong bas dad pa skyes/ tshangs pa'i dbyangs ltar snyan pa'i gsung thos pas/ mya ngan dang yid mi bde ba sogs kyi sdug bsngal zhi/ tshul khrims kyi pad ma dri gsung nyams dga' bas/ nyon mongs pa'i tshad pa sel/ sha mar thud gsum bu ram sogs kyi gnang sbyin khur por longs pa gnang bas yid dga' bar mdzad do/ /'di ni sbyin pa'i g.yab mo brda mtshon tsam bkod pa'o/ /bsdu ba'i dngos po phyi ma gsum dang / 'phrin las nyer bdun gyi sgo nas sems can gyi don byed tshul yang / dam pa 'di nyid la mngon gyur du mnga' na'ang / yi ge la 'jigs pas ma bris so/ /pad ma'i dri bsung che ldan mtsho dag la/ /ngang pa dbang med rgyu ba su yis ldog /khyod kyi yon tan rgya mtsho'i dri bsung la/ /skal ldan gdul bya 'du ba su yis khegs/ /brtse bas zang zing sbyin pas 'khor bsdus nas/ /chos kyi sbyin pas smin grol lam la bkod/ /mkhar ltar khyod kyi phrin las rgyun mi 'chad/ /'jam dbyangs 'gro don mdzad la snying nas 'dud/ /ces so/ /yang glang lo'i ston ser kha/ bdag nyid chen po'i drung du/ rigs rus dpal 'byor phun tshogs dang ldan pa/ /dad sogs 'phags pa'i nor bdun rgyan gyis spras/ /bstan pa'i sbyin bdag bdag chen sogs 'phags pas/

/zab don chos 'khor bskor bar gsol btab nas/ /dpal 'khor sde chen du/ sde pa chen po nas/ bdag nyid chen po'i drung du/ sku chas 'bul ba la sogs pa'i bdag rkyen phun sum tshogs pa mdzad nas/ bdag chen gyis thog drangs/ skal ldan gyi gdul bya mang po la/ zab lam gyi khrid gsungs dus/ sgom chen pa la la dag la/ skyabs 'gro sems bskyed dus/ snying rje bcos ma ma yin pa skyes nas/ ngu ba'i sgra skad dir ri ri/ la la dag la/ rdo rje sems dpa'i sgom bzlas kyi dus/ sdig pa dag pa'i rtags shar ra ra/ byin rlabs kyi tshan shin tu che ba'i stobs kyis/ la la dag la dbang gong ma'i dus/ lus ngag yid gsum gyi nyams bun bun/ la la dag la sor bsam gyi dus/ 'od gsal rtags bcu gsal la/ la la dag gis srog rtsol gyi dus/ rang gi lus kyi rtsa gnas thams cad mthong ba dang / rlung lnga'i kha dog mthong ba la sogs pa byung / khyad par du/ bdag po'i drung nas/ thugs dam khyad par can 'khrungs te/ 'khor ba'i bde 'bras la rgyab kyis phyogs nas/ thar pa dang thams cad mkhyen pa'i go 'phang don du gnyer zhing / yid ches gsum ldan du gyur to/ /de nas thugs myong gi steng nas/ bdag chen chos kyi rgyal po bkra shis rab brtan dpal bzang po'i drung du/ rang re'i ri khrod dga' ldan na bzhugs pa'i sgrub pa ba rnams la'ang / zhal snga nas/ zab lam gyi khrid chen gcig gnang ba byung na shin tu khyad che bar 'dug pas/ gsol ba btab na legs pa'i rgyu mtshan phul bas/ de de bzhin no'i gnang ba mdzad cing / gsol ba btab pas/ zhal snga nas/ zhal gyis bzhes nas/ stag lo dgun chos grol rjes su/ ri khrod chen por byon nas/ ri khrod na bzhugs pa'i sgom chen pa bgres gzhon thams cad kyis/ rdo rje rnal 'byor gsan pas/ bsgrub pa bsam gtan pa rnams 'od mer du mdzad pa'i bdag rkyen rnams kyang sbyin bdag chen po nas mdzad nas/ rang gzhan gyi tshogs rgya chen po 'dum par gyur to/

/rgyud sde rgya mtsho'i pad tshal nas/ /zab lam rdo rje sbrang rtsi'i bcud/ /zab lam sbrang rtsi 'dod la ster/ /'jam dbyangs bung ba las gzhan su/ /zhes so/ /ngo sprod mdzad pa'i dus/ lha rnams kyis me tog gi char phab bo/ /ngo sprod grol khar/ bka' lung la/ khyed rnams kyis 'du 'tshogs dang phyogs lhung sogs ma mdzad par/ rang gcig por 'dug pa'i go cha bskyed nas/ sgrub pa'i rgyal mtshan legs par tshugs shig de bzhin ma mdzad na/ sbyin bdag gi dad rdzas 'ju bar dka' bas/ 'o skol rnams la bu lon du 'gyur ro zhes gsungs pas/ sgom chen pa rnams dred la mos pa byung zer ro/ /de nas snga gong du sgom chen pa lo gsum phyogs gsum song ba rnams/ phan tshun mthun bsdebs nas/ phyogs gcig tu sgrub mchod dang / bla ma'i dus mchod re tsam byed pa'i srol yod na'ang deng phyin chad/ gcig pur dge sbyor byed pa ma gtogs/ de lta bu'i tshogs 'du byed pa med pa/ bka' gnang ngo / /rnam g.yeng 'du 'dzi dag gi nyes dmigs mthong / /gcig pur dben pa'i gnas su bsgrub la brtson/ /'du 'tshogs de 'ang chags sdang skye ba'i rgyu/ /'jam dbyangs bsgrub pa'i rgyal mtshan gtsug la 'dud/ /yang / dam pa 'di nyid yul shin tu gnyan pa'i stobs kyis/ 'di la phan gnod byas pa'i 'bras bu mthong chos tshe 'di la myong ba mthong ste/ dam pa 'di la na bza' gsol chas phul ba/ zhabs tog dang bkur sti bgyis pa/ dad pa sgom pa dang / gsol ba nar ma gcig drangs pa yan chad kyang / tshe ring zhing nad nyung ba dang / longs spyod la 'phel zhing / chos 'phel ba mngon sum du mthong / yang bdag nyid chen po 'di/ dge bshes gzhon nu ma'i dus/ bsing bshongs su slob gnyer mdzad pa'i/ gnas pa rnams la me shing blangs pas/ 'bul mkhan cher ma byung bas/ grwa pa 'ga' zhig gis/ me shing la ma byin len cung zad byas pas/ khong rnams kyis 'thab mo byas/ dam pa 'di'i dbu la rdo phog pa/

rtsa thog tu 'khel nas khrag byung / gnas pa'i dpon po dpon btsun pas kyang / spyan 'don pa yin zer nas/ spyan gyi thad dkar thur ma 'dzugs pa'i dzar sdigs byas pas/ phyis khong rang gi mig gnyis bton zhing / dbu la rdo brdeg mkhan de yang / mgo la 'jor phog nas shi zhes zer/ 'di dag gi don mdzod las/ gang dag 'gog byams nyon mongs med/ /mthong dang dgra bcom 'bras langs pa/ /de la phan gnod byas pa yi/ /'bras bu 'phral du smin par 'gyur/ /zhes gsungs pa ltar ro/ /yang rta lo la/ shar phyogs la chos bar chen mo la phebs par bzhed nas/ sde pa chen po gnyis la rgyu mtshan phul bas/ sde pa gnyis kyis/ da sku na bgres pa dang / sku sha brdzis pa'i stobs kyi 'o rgyal dang / sku tshe'i bar chad du'ang song dogs yod pas/ cis kyang mi phebs par zhus dus/ zhal snga nas 'di ltar dgongs ste/ mdo sde rgyan las/ gzhan don brtson ldan snying rje'i bdag nyid 'di/ /gang tshe mnar med la yang dgar 'dzin pa/ /de lta bas na srid na gzhan rten can/ /sdug bsngal 'byung ba rnams kyis ga la 'jigs/ /slob dpon brtse bdag rtag tu brten pa'i bdag /pha rol sdug bsngal dag gis sems gdungs pa/ /gzhan gyi bya ba nye bar gnas pa la/ /gzhan gyis bskul ba shin tu ngo yang tsha/ /mgo la sems can khur chen khyer ba yi/ /sems can mchog ni dal gyis 'gro mi mdzes/ /bdag gzhan sna tshogs 'ching bas rab bcings pa/ /brtson pa brgya 'gyur du ni bya ba'i rigs/ /zhes dang / gzhan dang bdag du mnyam pa'i sems nyid dam/ bdag pas gzhan zhes sdug pa rnyed nas ni/ /de ltar bdag pas gzhan don mchog tu shes/ /rang gi don gang gzhan gyi don gang yin/ /ji ltar snying rje'i bdag nyid gzhan gyi don gyi phyir/ /bdag la sdug bsngal mi zad gdung ba rab byed pa/ /de ltar 'jig rten gdung ba'i las kyi dgra gzhan la/ /shin tu brtse ba med par rab tu 'jug ma yin/

zhes dang / skye bo rmongs pa rang gi bde don brtson/ /de ma thob par rtag tu sdug bsngal 'gyur/ /bstan pa rtag tu gzhan don brtson pa ni/ /gnyis ka'i don byas mya ngan 'da' bar 'gyur/ /zhes dang / ji ltar rgyal sras phan ba'i bsam pas 'dir/ /'grokun rnam par smin byed gnas pa ltar/ /de bzhin pha dang ma dang gnyen bshes rnams/ /bu dang gnyen pa rnams la legs mi gnas/ /ji ltar brtse bdag bde dang phan sbyor phyir/ /sems can gzhan la byams 'dod de ltar ni/ /skye bo bdag la'ang byams par mi 'dod na/ /rab sdug skye bo gzhan rten smos ci dgos/ /byang chub sems dpa'i lus dang longs spyod dag /gzhan la mi sbyin par ni yongs med de/ /phan 'dogs rnam pa gnyis kyis gzhan smin byed/ /mnyam par sbyin pa'i yon tan ngoms mi 'gyur/ /zhes dang / rgyal sras brtson 'grus mchog la brten pa de/ /sems can tshogs rab smin par byed pa na/ /pha rol sems dge gcig gi phyir yang ni/ /bskal pa bye ba stong du skyo mi 'gyur/ /zhes gsungs pa ltar/ gdul bya mang po zhig gi don byed pa'i dus la bab par gzigs pa dang / snying rje chen po'i gzhan dbang du gyur pa'i phyir/ rta lo'i dgun chos snga ma grol bar mdzad nas rtse chen chos sde ba'i sngags mtshan nyid kyi grwa tshang rnams dang / chos sde gong nas khang gsar ba'i grwa tshang dang bcas pa phyag phyir khrid de/ seng ge rtser phebs/ dus tshod shin tu grang ba'i skabs yin nang / dam pa 'di nyid nang du rlung sems la dbang thob pa'i rgyu mtshan gyis/ phyi ru 'byung ba byin gyis brlabs nas/ nam mkha' la sprin med cing / rlung 'tshub sogs kyang gtan med par byin gyis brlabs so/ /de nas zhal snga nas/ chos zhag bzhi bcu'i bar la/ seng ge rtser bzhugs nas/ sde pa yab yum gnyis la/ gzungs gras lnga/ 'khor chen/ tshe dpag med sogs kyi dbang bka' gnang / srad shab phyogs kyi dgon pa so so nas byon pa'i bla ma slob dpon/

grwa bu slob dang bcas pa rnams dang / skye bo mi nag pa'i tshogs du ma dang bcas pa rnams la/ sbyor drug snying po don gsum/ tshe khrid/ skyid sdug lam khyer/ zhen pa bzhi bral/ ma ṇi'i lung sogs du ma gnang nas/ smin grol la bkod do/ /de'i bar la chos bar ba rnams sde chen rtser bzhugs nas/ zhabs tog seng ge rtse nas sde pa chen pos mdzad cing / chos yang shin tu 'phel bar byung ngo / /de nas bsing bshongs su phebs nas/ chos thog gnyis kyi bar la/ ri khrod chen po jo nang pa'i gdan sa pa/ mkhyen rab dang thugs rje tshad med pa mnga' ba'i bdag nyid/ chos rje bsod nams rgyal mtshan pas thog drangs/ jo nang pa'i sgrub pa ba pho mo brgyad cu tsam dang / chos rje tshogs khang pa dpon slob sum cu tsam dang / gzhan yang bzang ldan/ bde chen/ bsam lding / dpal ldan sa skya/ 'dzims chos lung / bo dong e/ phu sum/ rgyas sogs nas byon pa'i gsung chos don gnyer ba/ stong phrag mang po la/ zab lam rdo rje'i rnal 'byor yan lag drug gi 'khrid gnang / lus nyams/ ngag nyams/ sems nyams la sogs pa nyams rtogs bzang po 'khrungs pa mang du byung / jo nang chos rje la u rgyan snyan drug gnang / bla ma rdo rje 'chang du dngos su gzigs pa byung gsungs/ chos bar ba rnams dang / shar sgo lnga gzhung gi skye bo mi nag pa'i tshogs stong phrag du ma la blo sbyong gsung dus/ sngon 'gro'i 'khor ba'i nyes dmigs 'chad pa'i skabs su/ zhal snga nas kyang spyan chab char bzhin bsil/ gzhan rnams ngu ba'i sgra 'ur ding pa mang du byung / bstan pa la dga' ba'i lha rnams kyis/ seng ge rtse dang / bsing bshongs rnams su gsung chos gnang ba'i dus/ sprin dang rlung 'tshub zhi bar byas nas/ me tog gi char kha ba 'bab pa bzhin byung nas/ bskor lam rnams nas lha'i me tog btus pas chog pa byung ngo / /gzhan yang snying po don gsum/ skyid sdug lam khyer/ zhen pa bzhi bral/
