rab byung bsnyen rdzogs/ ma ṇi'i lung / yi ge brgya pa'i lung la sogs/ gang la gang 'tshams kyi chos kyi 'khor lo bskor ba mdzad de/ de dag gi skabs su/ mang po zhig srog mi gcod pa la sogs pa dge ba bcu'i las kyi lam la bkod/ mang po zhig sangs rgyas rjes su dran pa sogs rjes dran drug la bkod/ mang po zhig byams pa tshad med la sogs pa tshad med bzhi la bkod/ mang po zhig lus dran pa nyer bzhag la sogs pa/ dran pa nyer bzhag bzhi la bkod/ mang po zhig sdig pa ma skyes pa mi skyed pa la sogs pa/ yang dag spong ba bzhi la bkod/ mang po zhig stong pa nyid kyi rnam par thar pa la sogs pa/ rnam par thar pa bzhi la bkod/ mang po zhig dad pa la sogs pa 'phags pa'i nor bdun la bkod/ mang po zhig bag yod pa dang / dran pa dang shes bzhin dang ldan pa la bkod/ mang po zhig byang chub tu sems bskyed pas/ bsam pa rnam dag la bkod/ mang po zhig bdag tu 'dzin pa dang / bdag gir 'dzin pa spong ba ste/ rtsa ba gsum la bkod/ mang po zhig lhag pa tshul khrims kyi bslab pa sogs bslab pa rin po che gsum la bkod/ mang po zhig 'dod pa chung zhing chog shes pa la sogs pa 'phags pa'i rigs la bkod/ mang po zhig khro yang slar mi khro ba la sogs pa dge sbyong gi chos bzhi la bkod/ mang po zhig sbyin pa la sogs pa'i pha rol du phyin pa drug la bkod/ mang po zhig thos pa dang / bsam pa dang / sgom pa rnam par dag pa la bkod de/ dben par rtse gcig tu sgrub du bcug mang po zhig lta ba rnam par dag pa la bkod de/ nges don gyi bstan pa gsal bar byed du bcug mang po zhig spyod pa rnam par dag pa la bkod de/ lus dang ngag dang yid kyi dge ba yang dag par len du bcug mang po zhig lus kyi bskor ba/ ngag gi ma ṇi bgrang ba/ sems kyis dad pa sgom pa la bcug mang po zhig dge ba'i bshes gnyen bsten tshul mkhas par byas nas/ lam gyi rtsa ba bshes gnyen bsten du bcug ste/

rigs can gsum gyi gang zag smin grol la bkod pa sogs 'gro don rgya chen po byung ngo / /nas brgya 'bul la sogs pa'i zang zing gi longs spyod ni dpag tu med pa byung / de rnams kyang dge 'dun chos bar ba rnams la gnang sbyin mdzad/ lung dang mngon par rtogs pa'i yon tan du ma'i rgyan gyis mdzes pa/ chos rje chos rin dpal ba'i zhal snga nas dang / jo nang rin po che dkon mchog rgyal mtshan pa'i drung nas dang / mkhan chen rin po che la sogs pa/ dge ba'i bshes gnyen chen po mang po phebs nas/ dge 'dun gyi tshogs pa la/ gdan gnon/ mang ja/ spyi 'bul dang / zhal snga nas kyi drung du 'bul ba la sogs pa bsam gyis mi khyab pa mdzad de/ dge rtsa sems can gyi don du bsngo bar zhu ba dang / phyi ma dag pa'i gnas su mjal ba'i smon lam zhus nas/ rang sar gyes nas byon no/ /snying rje'i gzhan dbang gyur pa dang / /gdul bya 'dul ba'i dus mkhyen nas/ /lus srog yal bar dor nas ni/ /gzhan don phun tshogs sgrub la 'dud/ /la la mngon mtho'i bde la bkod/ /kha cig skyes bu 'bring por byas/ /gzhan dag skyes bu chen po'i lam/ /nyams su len la spro bar mdzad/ /mchog gi dngos sgrub don gnyer rnams/ /zab lam dag la rab khrid nas/ /bcu gsum rdo rje 'dzin pa yi/ /khang bzang mchog tu skyel la 'dud/ /ces so/ /yang lan gcig sgrol ma lha khang pa/ snyung gzhi drag po gcig gis sku khams snyel dus/ zhal snga nas kyi nyams kyi snang ba la/ sems ma'i chal gyi dkyil nas/ nya chen po rang gcig bton nas/ zhal du gsol ba'i rnam pa byung ba'i/ sang nyin 'khor chen gyi bka' gnang bas/ snyung gzhi las grol lo/ /yang lan gcig chos rje dga' ldan pa grib shas kyi rnam pa la brten pa'i/ spyan gyi rgyal mo 'dal nas snyel ba'i tshe/ zhal snga nas/ 'khor chen gyi dbang bka' gnang ba'i mtshan mo/ chos rje rang gi rnal lam du/ spyan gnyis nas bse mo re 'thon nas song ba rmi/

sang nyin nas spyan gsal por gyur to/ /mdor na/ dam pa 'di yis/ nad pa rnams la/ dbang bka' gnang ba/ dmigs pa gnang ba/ byin brlabs gnang ba/ sngas srung la na bza' dang thugs dam gnang ba/ gsol ras gnang ba/ gsang chab gnang ba sogs kyis kyang / nad pa rnams nad rims dang / gdon bgegs dang gza' nad las grol ba sogs brjod kyis mi lang ba yin no/ /lug lo dpyid kha/ gnas gsar ba'i chos mdzad ma la sogs pa'i khrid pa gsar rnying sum brgya tsam la sbyor drug gnang / dben gsum gyi dmigs pa la yang zhag bcu gnyis tsam byas pas/ myong ba khyad par can rgyud la skyes pa mang du byung nas/ lus nyams ngag nyams sems nyams la sogs pas/ zhal snga nas gsung chos gsung res kyi 'ur ding ding la 'gro ba byung la/ gzhan dag skyon du lta ba'i nyams skyong ba rnams la/ gegs sel dang / bogs 'don dang / spogs chogs la sogs pa gnang nas/ de rnams yon tan khyad par can du bsgyur ba la/ deng sang dam pa 'di nyid las lhag pa med de/ kun mkhyen chen po'i zhal nas/ dus da lta gsang sngags kyi gdams ngag dang / gegs sel la mkhas rlom mang na yang / /nyams 'di 'dra byung na rang mtshan ston/ /mkhas mi mkhas de dus shes pa yin/ /dpa' mi dpa' g.yul ngo sprad na mngon/ /lar drang por smras na gzhan mi dga'/ /gzhan gang zer byas na slob ma bslu/ /dus da lta'i slob dpon bya bar dka'/ /de yang khyed la drang por smra/ /byang sham bha la rigs ldan bzhugs pa'i gnas/ /dpal ka pa la chos kyis pho brang na/ /nyams 'di 'dra mkhyen pa mang du bzhugs/ /bod kha ba can gyi rgyal khams nas/ /nyams 'di 'dra shes pa kho bo tsam/ /zhes gsungs pa ltar ro/ /de dus zhal snga nas/ nga 'o skol yang na so song yang yang khrid skyong ba dka' bar 'dug pas/ da lan ngo sprod rgyas pa gcig byed pas/ ngo sprod zhu mkhan gyi dge bshes 'dra 'dug na'ang / 'ong du 'jug dgos so gsung / ngo sprod kyi gsung chos nyi ma bcu'i bar du gnang /

bdag gi kyang ngo sprod kyi chos nyan la phyin dus/ nyams myong sngar skyes pa rnams dang / da skye 'gyur rnams/ gsang don rab gsal na yod pa rnams dang / rgyud 'grel chen mo nas kha skong dgos pa rnams dang / bde mchog bstod 'grel/ rdo rje snying po'i 'grel pa/ na ro 'grel chen gyi bshad pa dang sbyar ba'i bshad pa yid ches pa gsungs rjes su/ 'o skol gyi grub mtha' 'di la/ dge bshes rnams kyis 'di ltar shes par bya ste/ gzugs nas rnam mkhyen bar gyi chos/ /mtshan nyid gsum du phye ba dang / /bden pa gnyis su phye ba dang / /chos dang chos nyid gnyis su ni/ /phye nas 'chad pa rdzogs ldan lugs/ mthar thug don dam gcig tu grub/ mthar thug myang 'das gcig tu grub/ /bral 'bras 'gog pa thar pa gsum/ /mthar thug chos nyid gcig pu nyid/ /mthar thug theg pa gcig tu grub/ /mthar thug skyabs gnas gcig tu grub/ /mthar thug sku yang gcig tu grub/ /don dam ye shes gcig nyid yin/ /don dam sems kyang gcig nyid yin/ /don dam ye shes gcig nyid yin/ /don dam phrin las gcig nyid yin/ /rdo rje yi ni gnas bdun la/ /don dam rdo rje'i gnas bdun dang / /kun rdzob rdo rje'i gnas bdun gnyis/ /don dam rdo rje'i gnas bdun gcig /yul la'ang bden pa gnyis su byed/ /mngon par rtogs pa brgyad po la/ /bden pa gnyis su phye ba yi/ /don dam mngon rtogs brgyad po gcig /kun rdzob brgyad po tha dad do/ /de bzhin la'ang shes par bya/ /bden gnyis dbyer yod dbyer med dang / /'khor 'das dbyer yod dbyer med dang / /spang gnyen dbyer yod dbyer med dang / /gzhi 'bras dbyer yod dbyer med dang / /thabs shes dbyer yod dbyer med dang / /bde stong dbyer yod dbyer med dang / /dbyings rig dbyer yod dbyer med dang / /mnyam rjes dbyer yod dbyer med dang / /bskyed rdzogs dbyer yod dbye med dang /

/phyi nang dbyer yod dbyer med dang / /rgyu 'bras dbyer yod dbyer med dang / /blang dor dbyer yod dbyer med dang / /dge sdig dbyer yod dbyer med dang / /yab yum dbyer yod dbyer med dang / /spang rtogs dbyer yod dbyer med dang / /srid gsum dbyer yod dbyer med dang / /dus gsum dbyer yod dbyer med dang / /bslab gsum dbyer yod dbyer med dang / /sku gsum dbyer yod dbyer med dang / /theg gsum dbyer yod dbyer med dang / /skyabs gsum dbyer yod dbyer med dang / /rigs gsum dbyer yod dbyer med sogs/ /'gal 'du skyon med shes par bya/ /dang po rnams ni tha dad la/ /phyi ma chos nyid gcig pu nyid/ /ming gi sgo nas bstan pa yin/ /'di la dri bcas dri med dang / /zag bcas zag pa med chos dang / /skyon bcas skyon med rnam pa gnyis/ /sangs rgyas rgyud dang sangs rgyas gnyis/ /sbyang ba'i gzhi dang sbyang 'bras gnyis/ /dag dang ma dag rnam pa gnyis/ /sangs rgyas sems can chos nyid gnyis/ /theg pa che chung chos nyid gnyis/ /'gal ba lta bur bshad pa rnams/ /brten pa'i sgo nas tha dad bshad/ /rten gzhi'i chos la khyad par med/ /khyad par 'byed na a thang chad/ /chags pa med cing chags pa che/ /rten 'brel ma yin rten 'brel che/ /rnam pa kun ldan rnam pa med/ /gzugs med gzugs bzang dam pa ste/ /'gal 'dus skyon med shes par bya/ /kun gzhi la ni rnam shes dang / /ye shes rnam pa gnyis su yod/ /sangs rgyas sa na rnam shes dang / /phung po lnga med gnas gyur thob/ /bde ba dang ni nus pa dang / /byin rlabs dang ni rig pa dang / /sa lam dang ni yon tan la'ang / 'dus byas 'dus ma byas pa gnyis/ /chos nyid mnyam bzhag ye shes la'ang / /shes dang shes bya gcig pa'i sku/ /shes dang shes bya tha dad sku/ /sangs rgyas sa na gnyis ka yod/ /slob pa'i lam na'ang gnyis ka yod/ /rigs gcig dang ni rigs gsum dang /

/rigs lnga dang ni rigs brgya dang / /bla ma dang ni yi dam la'ang / /kun rdzob don dam gnyis su yod/ /de skad du yang klu sgrub kyis/ /sangs rgyas rnams kyis chos bstan pa/ /bden pa gnyis la yang dag bstan/ /'jig rten kun rdzob bden pa dang / /dam pa'i don gyi bden pa'o/ /zhes gsungs 'di la tshad ma yin/ /yul la don dam kun rdzob gnyis/ /kha tshon chod kyis phung gsum med/ /blo la rnam shes ye shes gnyis/ /kha tshon chod kyis phung gsum med/ /kun rdzob rnam shes snang yul nyid/ /don dam ye shes snang yul nyid/ /yin gyis rnam shes snang yul yin/ /chos phung brgyad khri gsungs pa dang / /gsang sngags rgyud sde bzhi po yang / /don dam mngon du 'gyur phyir gsungs/ /pha rol phyin pa'i nyams len dang / /rdo rje theg pa'i nyams len kyang / /don dam gnas su bgrod pa'i lam/ /gtsang ma'i gnas lnga rnam spangs pa'i/ /'og min nyams dga' 'ang 'di nyid yin/ /chos dbyings pho brang lhun grub dang / /rang bzhin gnas kyang 'di nyid de/ /gzhan du 'tshol ba a thang chad/ /dus gsum sangs rgyas thams cad kyang / /'di la brten nas sangs rgyas pas/ /'di nyid dus gsum sangs rgyas yum/ /rdo rje btsun mo'i bha ga'ang 'di/ /e waṃ dang ni sna tshogs yum/ /mtshan gyi rnam grangs bsam las 'das/ /grub chen brgyad cu rtsa bzhi yang / /'di nyid rtogs nas grol ba yin/ /rigs ldan sum cu rtsa bzhi yang / /'di nyid rtogs nas grol ba yin/ /bdag gi yongs 'dzin gong ma rnams/ /'di nyid sgom pas grol ba yin/ /chos zab pa dang mi zab pa/ /'di nyid brjod byar byed mi byed/ /lam zab pa dang mi zab pa/ /'di la mnyam par 'jog mi 'jog /bla ma yang ni bzang mi bzang / /'di yi gnas tshul ston mi ston/ /gdul bya'ang skal ba ldan mi ldan/ /'di la mos dang ma mos yin/ /pho grung mo grung yod na yang / /'di nyid sgom na grung po yin/

/nor bsog mkhas pa grung po min/ /pho rgod mo rgod yod na'ang / /rnam rtog dgra 'joms rgod po yin/ /pha rol dgra 'joms rgod po min/ /dbang po rno dang mi rno yang / /'di la mos dang mi mos yin/ /dbang po rno rtul da lan shes/ /drang po yin min da lan shes/ /rgod po yin min da lan shes/ /spyang po yin min da lan shes/ /dgos 'dod thams cad 'byung ba yi/ /yid bzhin nor bu da lan rnyed/ /chom rkun lag tu ma shor bar/ /dben pa'i gnas su yang yang ltos/ /zhes gsungs so/ /zhal snga nas/ da lan 'dir 'tshogs pa rnams kyi dkyil na/ slob dpon pa yang 'ga' zung 'dug pas/ sems can gyi bde skyid/ sangs rgyas kyi bstan pa la rag las pa yin la/ bstan pa la/ lung dang rtogs pa'i bstan pa gnyis las/ rtogs pa'i dam chos rgyud la 'byung ba'ang / lung gi chos la thos bsam bsgom gsum byed pa la rag las/ de 'chad nyan byed pa la rag las/ 'chad nyan tshul bzhin byed mkhan de/ bstan 'dzin gyi skyes bu yin zhing / de'i bdag rkyen byed pa de/ bstan pa'i sbyin bdag yin pas/ slob dpon pa rnams kyis 'chad nyan la 'bad dgos pa yin gyis/ dben pa rer bsdad nas/ ma ṇi re tsam bgrangs ba dang / gtor ma re tsam gtong ba de yin bsam pa rang mi bdog grwa pa slob gnyer ba rnams kyis kyang / slob gnyer gyi 'phro skyong dgos pa yin/ thams cad mkhyen pa thob pa la shes bya phyogs re tsam shes pas mi chog pa yin gsungs so/ /mdo sde rgyan las/ de bzhin du ni tshogs bsags pa'i/ /rgyal sras bzod nas dag pa po/ /legs par shes zhing sems dge ba/ /sgom pa la ni rab tu sbyor/ /zhes dang / mdzod las/ tshul gnas thos dang bsam gtan pas/ /sgom pa la ni rab tu sbyor/ /zhes dang / so sor thar pa'i mdo las/ /mang du thos pa nags kyi nang dag du/ /lang 'tsho yol ba rnams kyis gnas pa bde/ /zhes dang / spyod 'jug las/ nags na ri dwags bya dag dang /

/shing ni mi snyan brjod mi byed/ /'grogs na bde ba de dag dang / /nam zhig lhan cig bdag gnas 'gyur/ zhes dang / zhi gnas rab tu ldan pa'i lhag mthong gis/ /nyon mongs rnam par 'joms par shes bya ste/ /thog mar zhi gnas btsal bya de yang ni/ /'jig rten chags pa med la mngon dgas 'grub/ /zhes dang / sems ni rnam par g.yengs pa'i mi/ /nyon mongs che ba'i phrag na gnas/ /lus dang sems ni dben pa yis/ /rnam par rtog pa mi 'byung ngo / /zhes dang / bslab btus las/ bzod bya thos pa btsal bar bya/ /de nas nags su gnas par bya/ /zhes dang / skyes rabs las/ thos pa'i rjes 'jug bsgrub pa snying por byed/ /skye ba'i rdzong las tshegs chung thar par 'gyur/ /zhes dang / chos la gnas pa'i mdor/ thos pa dang bsam pa la ma brten par sgom pa'i sbyor ba 'ba' zhig gis chos la gnas pa ma yin la/ sgom pa la ma brten par thos pa dang bsam pa'i sbyor ba 'ba' zhig gis kyang chos la gnas pa ma yin te/ gnyis ka la brten te gnyis ka la gnas na chos la gnas pa zhes bya'o/ /zhes dang / de dang mthun par/ mdo sde rgyan las/ de ltas rnal 'byor can gyis sgom pa gang yin de ni don med min/ /de ltas bde bar gshegs kyi bstan pa gang yin de ni don med min/ /gal te thos pa tsam gyis don mthong 'gyur na bsgom pa don med 'gyur/ /gal te ma thos par yang sgom 'jug 'gyur na bstan pa don med 'gyur/ /zhes thos bsam sgom gsum zung 'brel du dgos par gsungs pa dang / zla ba sgron ma'i mdo las/ gang zhig byang chub rab tu 'dod byed cing / /'du byas ngan las yid 'byung sems can gyi/ /don du dgon par phyogs te gom bdun bor/ /'di ni de bas bsod nams khyad par 'phags/ /zhes dang / yang de nyid las/ gang dag dga' dang mi dga' cung zad med/ /de dag mi yi 'jig rten rtag rab bde/ /gang dag gnas dang ri sul la dga' ba/ /dge sbyong nyid kyi rab bde myong bar 'gyur/

/gang dag bdag gir byed pa ci yang med/ /gang dag yongs 'dzin rnam pa kun du med/ /bse ru lta bu 'jig rten 'dir gnas pa/ /de dag nam mkha' la ni rlung ltar 'gro/ /gang dag 'jig rten la ni yid mi gnas/ /de dag mi yi 'jig rten rab tu bde/ /gang dag mi dag la ni chags med pa/ /de dag 'di na rtag tu sems rlung 'dra/ /gang dag mi sdug de phrad sdug bsngal te/ /de dag sdug de dang bral sdug bsngal yin/ /mtha' de gnyis ka rab tu spangs nas su/ /mi gang chos la dga' ba de dag bde/ /zhes dang / yang de nyid las/ nyes pa'i tshogs rnams thams cad spangs nas su/ /rnal 'byor can ni rtag tu byed pa nyung / /rnal 'byor can brtson nam yang rtsod pa med/ /rtag tu zhi zhing dga' la dben par rgyu/ /lus dang ngag dang yid kyang rab gdams 'gyur/ /dgon par gnas pa 'di la yon tan mang / /de ni thar pa'i rjes su mthun pa yin/ /de ni rnam grol zhi ba myur rtogs byed/ /nags na gnas zhing rnam grol bsten byed na/ /dgon gnas de la yon tan 'di kun 'byung / /zhes dang / yang de nyid las/ grong dang grong khyer dag la dga' spongs la/ /rtag tu dben zhing nags khrod bsten par gyis/ /bse ru lta bur rtag tu gnyis med byos/ /ring por mi thogs ting 'dzin mchog thob 'gyur/ /zhes gsungs pa ltar/ dben pa'i phan yon dang / /lhag bsam bskul ba'i mdo las/ yun ring dus na smra la dga' bas na/ /de ni bdag nyid dga' ba mi thob bo/ /tshig gang dga' ba mtha' yas thob 'gyur ba/ /tshig gcig tsam zhig bsam kyang mchog yin no/ /bu ram shing shun snying po ci yang med/ /mngar bar bya ba'i ro ni nang na 'dug /shun pa thob pa'i mis ni bu ram ro/ /zhim po rnyed par nus pa ma yin no/ /ji ltar shun pa de ni smra ba ste/ ji lta bur ni 'di la don sems yin/ /de lta bas na smra la dga' spongs la/ /rtag tu bag yod gyis la don soms shig

/ces/ smra ba la dga' ba spongs la/ dben pa'i gnas su chos kyi don bsam dgos par bstan pa dang / dus 'khor rtsa rgyud las/ gang na sa skyong chos ldan zhing / /gang zhig kho nar skye dgu rnams/ /bder gnas sa 'dzin rtsod med pa/ /der ni rnal 'byor rtsam par bya/ /zhes dang / 'phags pa dkon mchog sprin las/ gnas gang na bsod snyoms bslang ba'i spyod yul dang ha cang yang mi ring / ha cang yang mi nye ba dang / gnas gang dag na chu dwangs shing rnyog ma med pa/ gtsang zhing dri ma med pa tshegs chung ba yod pa dang / gnas gang na shing phun sum tshogs pa/ me tog phun sum tshogs pa/ 'bras bu phun sum tshogs pa/ lo ma phun sum tshogs pa/ gcan gzan khro bo med pa/ phug dang ldan pa/ sman ljongs dang ldan pa/ thag thug med pa/ 'gro na bde ba zhi ba gnyis su med pa'i gnas de 'dra ba dag na gnas so zhes gsungs/ de dang mthun par/ mdo sde rgyan las/ blo ldan gang du sgrub pa'i yul/ /legs par rnyed dang gnas bzang dang / /sa bzang ba dang grogs bzang dang / /rnal 'byor bde ba'i yon tan ldan/ /zhes gsungs pa ltar/ gnas kyi khyad par dang / yang rgyan las/ rtog ge bsten zhing ma nges la/ /ma khyab kun rdzob skyo ba can/ /byis pa la ni bsten par 'dod/ /de phyir de ni spyod yul min/ /zhes gsungs par ltar/ chos nyid zab mo rtog ge'i yul ma yin pa dang / rgyud bla ma las/ so so rang gis rtog bya'i phyir/ /gzhan gyi rkyen gyis rtogs min pa/ /zhes dang / yang de nyid las/ thog ma dbus mtha' med cing rnam dbyer med/ /gnyis med gsum bral dri med rnam rtog med/ /chos dbyings rang bzhin gang yin de rtogs pa/ /mnyam par bzhag pa'i rnal 'byor pa yis mthong / /zhes dang / smra bsam brjod med shes rab pha rol phyin/ /ma skyes mi 'gag nam mkha'i ngo bo nyid/ /so so rang rig ye shes spyod yul ba/ /dus gsum rgyal ba'i yum la phyag 'tshal lo/

/zhes gsungs pa ltar/ chos nyid zab mo de/ mnyam bzhag so sor rig pa'i ye shes kyi spyod yul yin la/ de yang dben par mnyam par bzhag pa las byung bas/ dben par mnyam par bzhag pa'i phan yon ni/ sdong po bkod pa las/ yang dag sangs rgyas bstan pa 'di/ /thos pa tsam gyis mi 'grub bo/ /dper na la la chu klung gis/ /stobs med nan gyis khyer ba dag /skom nas shi bar gyur pa bzhin/ /zhes dang / dper na mtsho chen mnyan pa bzhin/ /skye bo thams cad sgrol byed kyang / /bdag nyid de nang mchi 'gyur ba/ /ma sgom chos kyang de bzhin no/ /zhes bsam gyis mi khyab pa bshad 'dug pas/ thos pa byas nas mthar sgom byed dgos pas/ rang re rnam pas kyang mthar bsgom pa'i chos la nan tan mdzad 'tshal gsungs so/ /zhal snga nas rang yang / bya skyungs la sogs pa'i dben gnas brten nas/ sku mtshams bcad de/ thugs dam la brtson par mdzad do/ /yang zhal snga nas/ 'jig rten 'di na/ la la dag rigs kyis nga rgyal/ la la dag nor gyis nga rgyal/ la la dag 'khor 'dab kyis nga rgyal/ la la dag thos pas nga rgyal byed par gda' ste/ rang gi nang gi sems 'di la brtan pa thob dgos pa yin la/ de yang rang gi sems nyid 'od gsal la thim gyi bar du/ 'dus byas kyi chos gang gis kyang rtag mi thub/ rigs mtho yang rtag mi thub ste/ 'khor los bsgyur rgyal nyid du gyur nas kyang / /las kyi dbang gis slar yang sa steng lhung / /zhes gsungs/ nor gyis kyang rtag mi thub ste/ bsag dang bsrung dang brlag pa'i sdug bsngal can/ /nor ni phung grol mtha' yas shes par bya/ /zhes dang / bsags pa'i mtha' ni 'dzad pa yin/ /zhes gsungs/ gnyen bshes kyis kyang rtag mi thub ste/ 'byor ba'i tshe na kun kyang gnyen/ /rgud pa'i tshe na kun kyang dgra/ /zhes dang / 'dus pa'i mtha' ni 'bral ba yin/ /zhes gsungs/ /mdor na rtag thub pa'i 'dus byas ci yang med/ lo phyi ma bas/ skye ba phyi ma snga ba'am/

zla ba phyi ma bas/ skye ba phyi ma snga ba'am/ zhag phyi ma bas/ skye ba phyi ma snga ba srid pa yin te/ tshe 'di'i snang ba nub nas/ phyi rol mun pa'i dmag rum 'thibs nas/ cha med kyi yul du rgyus med lag stong gcer bur 'gro ba'i dus su/ dam pa'i chos ma yin pa gang gis kyang mi phan/ de la yang tshig shes lo/ don go lo/ sngags bgrang lo/ bskyed rim bsgol lo sogs kyis kyang phan pa bka' bas/ zla grogs skyabs gnas skyel ma thams cad rang sems 'od gsal 'di kho na yin pas/ thams cad kyis kyang 'di'i gnas tshul mngon sum du mthong nas/ brtan pa thob pa la 'bad pa thon/ de yang bla ma dam pa'i drung du gdams ngag zhus te/ dben gnas khyad par can gong du bshad pa de lta bu bste+en dgos/ sgom rnam dag re ma byung na/ gnas lugs kyi don mngon sum du mi mthong bas/ mthar dben pa bsten nas sgom pa la brtson dgos pa yin no/ /gsum/ rnam g.yeng 'du 'dzi dag gi nyes dmigs dang / /nags khrod dben pa bsten pa'i yon tan dag /gzigs nas bdag gi rjes 'jug dam pa rnams/ /'jam dbyangs dben pa bsten zhes 'doms la 'dud/ /'dus byas bslu ba'i chos la yid 'byung nas/ /nam yang bslu ba med pa brtan gyi skyabs/ /rang bzhin 'od gsal 'gyur med bde ba che/ /rlung sems dbu mar chud nas rdzogs par gsal/ /zhes so/ /bcu pa zab mo'i bstan pa nyin mo ltar gsal bar mdzad tshul ni/ dam pa 'di nyid kyi zhal nas/ zab don nyams su len pa'i dus 'dir/ gzhi lam 'bras gsum gyi rnam gzhag shes dgos pa yin pas/ de la gzhi'i rnam gzhag dang / lam gyi rnam bzhag dang / 'bras bu'i rnam gzhag dang gsum/ de yang dri ma sbyang bar bya ba'i gzhi ni/ mthar thug gi sangs rgyas chos kyi sku de bzhin gshegs pa'i snying po rang bzhin 'od gsal chos kyi dbyings rang byung ye shes/ dang po'i sangs rgyas ngo bo nyid sku/ don dam bden pa/ sku bzhi'i ye shes chos dbyings ye shes/

lhan cig skyes pa'i ye shes/ bde ba chen po/ cha med kun 'gro khyab pa po/ /rang bzhin gnas rigs sogs kyi mtshan gyi rnam grangs du ma dang ldan pa'i gzhan stong zab mo de yin la/ de nyid chos thams cad kyi gnas dang gzhi dang rten yang yin/ kun rdzob kyi chos thams cad kyis stong pa'i gzhi dang / dben pa'i gzhi dang / dri ma thams cad dag pa'i gzhir yang gsungs la/ chos sku'i yon tan gaṅgā'i klung gi bye ma snyed las 'das pa rnams rang bzhin dbyer med du ldan par yang gsungs so/ /de nyid chos thams cad kyi gnas yin te/ chos mngon pa'i mdo las/ thog ma med pa'i dus kyi dbyings/ /chos rnams kun gyi gnas yin te/ /de yod pas na 'gro kun dang / /mya ngan 'das pa thob par 'gyur/ /zhes dang / rgyud bla ma las/ las dang nyon mongs tshul bzhin min/ /yid la byed la rab tu gnas/ /tshul bzhin ma yin yid byed ni/ /sems kyi dag pa la rab gnas/ /zhes sogs gsungs so/ /de nyid chos thams cad kyi gzhi yang yin te/ rgyan stug po bkod pa'i mdo las/ sa rnams sna tshogs kun gzhi ste/ /bde gshegs snying po dge ba'ang de/ /snying po de la kun gzhi'i sgras/ /de bzhin gshegs rnams ston par mdzad/ /ces dang / blo sbyong don bdun mar yang / sems ni kun gzhi'i ngang la bzhag /ces sogs gsungs pas so/ /de nyid chos thams cad kyi rten yang yin te/ mdo las/ dus gsum du rnam par bzhugs pa'i sangs rgyas thams cad kyang shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa zab mo la brten nas mngon par rdzogs par sangs rgyas so/ /zhes dang / mngon rtogs rgyan las/ sgrub pa yi ni rten gyur pa/ /chos kyi dbyings kyi rang bzhin dang / /zhes dang / 'jug pa'i rten la rigs zhes bya/ /zhes dang / rten pa'i chos kyi bye brag gis/ /de yi dbye ba yongs su brjod/ /ces sogs gsungs pa'o/ /chos nyid chos thams cad kyi sa bon dang rgyu yang yin te/

bram ze chen po sa ra ha pa'i zhal nas/ sems nyid gcig pu kun gyi sa bon te/ /gang la srid dang mya ngan 'das 'phro ba/ /'dod pa'i 'bras bu gter bar byed pa yi/ /rin chen nor 'dra'i sems la phyag 'tshal lo/ /zhes bshad pa yang / chos nyid kyi sems la dgongs so/ /de bzhin gshegs pa'i snying po'i mdor yang / rigs kyi bu dag 'di ni chos rnams kyi chos nyid de/ de bzhin gshegs pa rnams byung yang rung / ma byung yang rung / sems can 'di dag ni rtag tu de bzhin gshegs pa'i snying po can yin no/ /zhes bde gshegs snying po de/ 'khor 'das kyi chos thams cad kyi gzhi dang gnas dang / rten dang / sa bon dang / rgyu byed pa yin zhing / de yang ma dag pa'i gnas skabs su dri ma rten pa'i gzhi/ dag la ma dag gi gnas skabs su dri ma sbyong ba'i gzhi dang / shin tu rnam dag gi gnas skabs su dri ma dag pa'i gzhi dang / sangs rgyas kyi yon tan thams cad kyi rten gzhir bzhugs pas nam mkha' ltar kun khyab tu/ dus nam yang bzhugs pa yin no/ /chos nyid de sangs rgyas kyang yin te/ kyai rdo rje'i rgyud las/ sems can thams cad sangs rgyas nyid/ /'on kyang glo bur dri mas sgribs/ /de nyid bsal na sangs rgyas nyid/ /ces pa dang / 'jig rten khams ni gang du yang / /sangs rgyas gzhan du rnyed mi 'gyur/ /sems ni rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas nyid/ /sangs rgyas gzhan du brten du med/ zhes dang / lus la ye shes chen po gnas/ /rtog pa thams cad yang dag spangs/ /dngos po kun la khyab pa po/ /lus la gnas kyang lus skyes min/ /zhes sems can thams cad kyi lus la bzhugs pa'i rang 'byung ye shes bde gshegs snying po de nyid nam mkha' ltar dngos po kun la khyab par bzhugs kyang / dngos po gang las kyang ma skyes par gsungs pa dang / dpal sam bu ṭir yang / rang gi lus la sangs rgyas bzhugs/ /gzhan du gang na'ang sangs rgyas med/ /mi shes mun pas sgrib pa rnams/

/lus las gzhan du sangs rgyas 'dod/ /rtog pa thams cad rnam spangs pa'i/ /ye shes chen po lus la gnas/ /dngos po kun la khyab pa ste/ /lus la gnas kyang lus mi skye/ /zhes sogs dang / gsang 'dus kyi bshad rgyud rdo rje phreng bar yang / rdo rje slob dpon lus 'di la/ /rgyal ba'i sku ni rim bzhin gnas/ /dang po sku yi rdo rje ni/ /gzugs phung la ni yang dag gnas/ /rjes su chags pa'i rdo rje ni/ /tshor ba yi ni phung por bzhugs/ /bcom ldan gsung gi rdo rje ni/ /'du shes kyi ni phung por bzhugs/ /mchod pa kun gyi rdo rje ni/ /'du byed kyi ni phung por bzhugs/ /bcom ldan thugs kyi rdo rje ni/ /rnam shes phung por yang dag bzhugs/ /zhes sogs lus la gnas pa'i don dam pa'i sangs rgyas rigs lnga/ yum bzhi sras chen brgyad/ khro bo khro mo la sogs pa rnams don dam pa'i dkon mchog gsum ka yin pas/ don dam pa'i dkon mchog gsum dbyer med du shes dgos so/ /'di dag la dgongs nas/ lhag pa'i bsam pa bstan pa'i le'ur/ kun dga' bo de bzhin gshegs pa ni bstan du med pa ste/ de ni mig gis blta bar mi nus so/ /kun dga' bo/ chos ni brjod du med pa ste/ de ni rna bas nyan par mi nus so/ /kun dga' bo/ dge 'dun ni 'dus ma byas pa ste/ de ni lus dang ngag dang sems kyi bsnyen bkur bya bar mi nus so/ /zhes dang / rdo rje phreng ba'i rgyud du yang / dri med sems ni sangs rgyas te/ /chos ni ngag du yang dag gsungs/ /sku ni dge 'dun zhes bya ste/ /byang chub sems dpa'i tshogs kyi gnas/ /zhes so/ /don dam pa'i dkon mchog gsum ni chos kyi dbyings nyid yin pas/ dkon mchog gsum la bden gnyis kyi rnam dbye shes dgos so gsungs so/ /de nyid dge ba yin te/ lang kar gshegs pa las/ de bzhin gshegs pa'i snying po dge /rtog ge can gyi spyod yul min/

/zhes dang / sems ni rang bzhin 'od gsal te/ /de bzhin gshegs pa'i snying po dge /zhes sogs gsungs zhing / dbus mthar/ dge gnyis thob par bya ba'i phyir/ zhes 'dus ma byas kyi dge ba bshad pa dang / kun las btus las/ don dam pa'i dge ba gang zhe na/ de bzhin nyid do gsungs pa dang / chos dbyings bstod par/ dge legs sems las sangs rgyas 'byung / /rang sems de la phyag 'tshal lo/ /zhes pa dang / myang 'das chen mor/ rigs kyi bu ngas mdo sde 'di las/ sangs rgyas kyi rang bzhin ni dngos po drug dang ldan te/ rtag pa dang / yang dag pa dang / bden pa dang / dge ba dang / rnam par dag pa dang / mthong ba'o/ /zhes pa la sogs pa bshad pas/ 'o na sdom gsum rab dbyer/ chos dbyings dge ba yin pa bkag pa ma yin nam zhe na/ 'bras bu bde ba bskyed pa yi/ /dge ba dngos ni ma yin no/ /zhes dang / des na dge sdig las las grol/ /zhes 'bras bu bde ba bskyed pa'i dge ba'i las ma yin par bshad pas so gsungs so/ /yang bde gshegs snying po ni/ nam mkha' ltar brtan g.yo kun la khyab par bzhugs te/ gsang ba bsam gyis mi khyab pa'i mdo las/ zhi ba'i blo gros 'di lta ste/ dper na/ nam mkha' ni gzugs su snang ba thams cad du zhugs pa'o/ /zhi ba'i blo gros de bzhin du/ de bzhin gshegs pa'i sku yang sems can du snang ba thams cad du bzhugs pa'o/ /zhi ba'i blo gros 'di lta ste/ dper na/ nam mkha'i nang du ni gzugs su snang ba thams cad du 'dus so/ /zhi ba'i blo gros de bzhin du/ de bzhin gshegs pa'i sku yi nang du yang sems can du snang ba thams cad 'dus so/ /zhes gsungs la/ mdo sde rgyan du yang / ji ltar nam mkha' gzugs gyur kun du song / /de bzhin 'di yang rtag tu kun song 'dod/ /ji ltar nam mkha' gzugs gyur kun du song / /de bzhin 'di yang sems can tshogs kun song / /zhes dang / rgyud bla ma las/ ji ltar rtog med bdag nyid can/

/nam mkha' kun tu rjes song ltar/ /sems kyi rang bzhin dri med dbyings/ /de bzhin kun tu 'gro ba nyid/ /ces gsungs so/ /sems can gyi chos nyid ni/ chos sku'i yon tan tshad med pa gaṅgā'i klung gi bye ma las 'das pa rnams chos nyid kyi tshul du yin ldan du grub ste/ mngon rtogs rgyan du/ ngo bo nyid sku zag med kyi yon tan sde tshan nyer gcig dang ldan par bshad pa dang don gcig pa dang / rgyud bla rtsa 'grel las/ de la stong pa nyid kyi tshul du brjod pa'i de bzhin gshegs pa'i snying po gang yin zhe na/ 'di la bsal bya ci yang med/ ces sogs nas/ rnam dbyer bcas pa'i mtshan nyid can/ /glo bur dag gi khams stong gis/ /rnam dbyer med pa'i mtshan nyid can/ /bla med chos kyi stong ma yin/ /'dis ci bstan zhe na/ gang gi phyir rang bzhin yongs su dag pa'i de bzhin gshegs pa'i khams 'di la bsal bar bya ba kun nas nyon mongs pa'i rgyu mtshan ni 'ga' yang med de/ glo bur ba'i dri ma dang bral ba ni 'di yi rang bzhin yin pa'i phyir ro/ /'di la rnam par byang ba'i rgyu mtshan bzhag par bya ba cung zad kyang yod pa ma yin te/ rnam par dbye ba med pa'i chos dag pa'i chos nyid ni rang bzhin yin pa'i phyir ro/ /des na de bzhin gshegs pa'i snying po ni/ rnam par dbye ba yod pa/ bral shes pa/ nyon mongs pa'i sbubs thams cad kyis ni stong pa yin la/ rnam par dbye ba med pa/ bral mi shes pa/ bsam gyis mi khyab pa'i sangs rgyas kyi chos gaṅgā'i klung gi bye ma las 'das pas ni mi stong ngo / /zhes dang / sangs rgyas phal po cher/ stong gsum dar yug chen po'i mdo bshad pa'i don/ stong gsum gyi stong chen po'i 'jig rten gyi khams kyi ri mo rdzogs par bris pa'i dar yug chen po/ /rdul phra rab gcig gi nang tu bcug go /de bzhin du rdul phra rab thams cad kyi nang du rdzogs par bcug pa de/

lha'i mig dang ldan pa zhig gis mthong nas/ rdo rje'i rtse mos rdul kha phye ste/ dar yug chen po de bstan nas 'gro ba kun gyi nyer mtshor gyur pa dper byas nas/ de bzhin gshegs pa'i snying po yon tan tshad med pa dang ldan pa de/ sems can thams cad la yod par gzigs nas/ de dri ma'i sbubs las grol ba'i phyir du/ sangs rgyas 'jig rten du byon nas 'gro ba rnams la chos ston to zhes bshad pa la/ kha cig de 'dra'i dpe ma grub/ de lta na don de yang ma grub pas/ de ltar bstan pa drang don yin snyam na/ sangs rgyas rnams kyi nus mthu dang byin rlabs dang / rdzu 'phrul bsam gyis mi khyab pa dang / sems can rnams kyi las dang smon lam yang bsam gyis mi khyab pas dpe grub bo/ /gzhan yang sgyu ma mkhan gyi/ sngags dang sman dang rdzas kyi nus pa la brten nas rde'u shing bu la sogs pa la snang tshul sna tshogs 'ong ba'i dpes kyang grub bo/ /dbu ma 'jug pa las/ dag pa 'di ni bzhed pa 'jug pa yi/ /rdul gcig yul la mkha' gtugs 'jig rten gyi/ /'jig rten mtha' yas phyogs khyab rdul ston mod/ /rdul rags mi 'gyur 'jig rten phra mi 'gyur/ /zhes dang / de'i 'grel par/ sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das rnams ni bzhed pa'i sgo nas/ nam mkha'i mthas gtugs pa'i 'jig rten/ rdul phra rab gcig gi yul la ston par byed de/ 'jig rten phra bar yang mi 'gyur zhing / rdul rags par yang mi 'gyur la/ bzhed pa nyid kyis rang gi ngo bo ji ltar gnas pa yang dag par ston to/ /'jig rten mtha' yas phyogs khyab rdul yang ston te/ sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das rnams ni bzhed pa tsam gyis mtha' yas phyogs te/ 'jig rten ma lus pa'i rten rdul rab gcig gis khyab par yang ston par mdzad do/ /ces sogs gsungs pas/ de lta na nam mkha'i mthas gtugs pa'i 'jig rten thams cad rdul phran gcig gi nang du 'jug pa dang /

rdul phran gcig gis 'jig rten gyi khams thams cad la khyab par ston nus na/ stong gsum gyi ri mo bris pa'i ras yug rdul phran gcig gi nang du 'jug nus pa lta ci smos/ blo chung khyed lta bu la de 'dra'i nus pa yod par 'dod pa ma lags/ zhes gsungs so/ /gzhan yang 'grel chen dri med 'od du/ 'dir phug 'phru lnga pa'i tshad gang du 'dod chags dang bral ba'am/ byang chub sems dpa' gnas pa'i phug der/ bsod nams dang ye shes brten pa de'i mthu dang / rdzu 'phrul gyi stobs kyis/ 'khor los bsgyur ba sde dang bcas pa 'ongs shing rab tu 'jug ste/ de sus kyang ma skyed cing phug der bzhugs pa'i 'khor los bsgyur ba'i sde yang dogs pa nyid ma yin no/ /don dam par na 'jig rten gyi khams kyi tshad kyang de bzhin du rig par bya'o/ /zhes sogs gsungs pas dpe grub bo/ /don yang grub ste/ sems can gyi rgyud kyi bde gshegs snying po de/ bral mi shes pa/ rnam par dbye ba med pa/ bsam gyis mi khyab pa'i sangs rgyas kyi yon tan rnams dang ldan par gsungs pas so/ /gal te sems can gyi rgyud la mtshan dpes spras pa'i sangs rgyas yod pa de drang don dgongs pa can yin te/ dgongs gzhi sems can gyi rgyud la stong nyid yod pa la dgongs/ dgos pa skyon lnga spang phyir gsungs/ dngos la gnod byed ni/ de lta na mu stegs kyi bdag rtag pa yod par 'gyur snyam na/ sems can gyi rgyud la bde gshegs snying po yod pa drang don dang / de ston pa'i mdo drang don yin na/ sems can gyi rgyud la stong nyid dang chos nyid yod pa'ang drang don dang / de yod par ston pa'i mdo drang don gyi mdor 'gyur dgos pas mi legs so/ /'o na dpal ldan zla grags dang / chos rje sa paṇa gyis drang don du bstan pa ma yin nam zhe na/ de ni bde gshegs snying po 'dus byas kyi mtshan dpes spras pa drang don du bstan pa yin te/

bde gshegs snying po rtag pa la/ 'dus byas kyi yon tan chos nyid kyi tshul du dbyer med du ldan na/ rtag pa dang 'dus byas kyi gzhi mthun khas len dgos/ de ltar na bdag rtag pa dang / 'jig rten gyi byed pa po'i gzhi mthun yod par 'gyur la/ de ltar na mu stegs byed kyi bdag rtag pa yod par 'gyur zhes pa'i don yin no/ /gal te rgyud bla mar las/ sprin dang rmi lam sgyu bzhin de dang der/ zhes dogs pa bkod nas/ de'i lan la/ sems zhum sems can dman la brnyas pa dang / zhes sems can gyi rgyud la bde gshegs snying po yod par bstan pa'i dgos pa bstan pas drang don no/ /snyam du mi bsam ste/ sher phyin gyi mdo las/ sher phyin gyi dgos pa bstan pas drang don du 'gyur dgos pa las/ de ltar du khyed rang rnams kyang mi 'dod pas so/ /yang sher phyin gyi mdo las/ chos thams cad bden med du bshad pas bde gshegs snying po bden med yin snyam du mi bsam ste/ de bden pa yin pa dang / mi slu ba yin pa dang / gshis lugs yin pa dang / de kho na nyid yin pa dang / chos nyid yin pa sogs su tshad mas legs par grub pas so/ /gal te chos nyid bden par grub na/ chos nyid bden 'dzin gyi blo spang du mi rung ba dang / rtag pa'i mthar lhung du 'gyur snyam du mi rtog ste/ 'di la mnyam bzhag la zlo ba dang / rjes thob shan 'byed pa'i gnas skabs gnyis las/ mnyam bzhag gi gnas skabs su/ chos nyid bden par bzung na/ rtag pa'i mthar lhung du 'gyur na'ang / de ltar 'dzin par mi 'dod la/ rjes thob shan 'byed pa'i skabs su/ bden pa la bden/ rtag pa la rtag gtsang ba la gtsang / bde ba la bde zhes sogs/ yin pa la yin/ ma yin pa la ma yin/ yod pa la yod/ med pa la med byas pas mthar lhung du 'gro na/ tha snyad thams cad rgyun chad par mi 'gyur ram/ legs par soms shig gsungs te/ shin tu mad par mchis so/ /gal te sems can gyi rgyud kyi chos nyid sangs rgyas yin na/

spangs rtogs mthar thug tu thal ba dang / tshogs gnyis bsags par thal ba dang / sgrib gnyis spangs par thal ba dang / sems can rnams lam la 'bad mi dgos par grol bar thal lo snyam na/ 'di la rnam par phye de lan gdab par bya ste/ spang ba la/ rang bzhin rnam dag gi spang ba dang / glo bur dri bral gyi spang ba gnyis las/ gdod ma nas dri mas dag pa yin pas rang bzhin rnam dag gi spang bya yin/ glo bur gyi dri ma gnyen pos zad pa ni ma yin te/ mdo las/ dri ma gnyen pos zad pas zad pa min/ dri ma gdod nas zad pas zad pa yin/ /zhes so/ /rtogs pa la yang / rang 'byung lhan cig skyes pa'i ye shes ni yin/ gzhan byung lam sgom pas skyes pa'i ye shes ni ma yin no/ /de bzhin du kun rdzob kyi tshogs gnyis bsags pa ni ma yin/ don dam gyi tshogs gnyis bsags pa ni yin te/ tshogs gnyis tshogs ni bsags pa po/ /zhes gsungs pas so/ /de bzhin du gdod ma nas sgrib gnyis spangs pa ni yin/ gnyen po'i stobs kyis sgrib gnyis spangs pa ni ma yin no/ /sems can gyi rgyud la sangs rgyas yod kyang lam la 'bad dgos te/ yod kyang de'i gnas tshul mngon sum du mthong phyir du 'bad dgos pas so/ /dper na mi dbul po'i khyim gyi 'og na rin po che'i gter yod kyang / phongs pa'i sdug bsngal ma grol bas/ gter de 'don pa'i phyir du sa rko ba sogs la 'bad dgos pa bzhin/ de skad du rgyud bla las/ ji ltar mi dbul khyim nang sa 'og na/ /mi zad pa yi gter ni yod gyur te/ /mi des de mi shes zhing gter des yang / /de la nga 'dir yod ces mi smra ltar/ /de bzhin yid kyi nang chud rin chen gter/ /dri med bzhag dang bsal med chos nyid kyang / /ma rtogs pas na dbul ba'i sdug bsngal ni/ /rnam mang rgyun du skye dgu 'dis myong ngo / /zhes sogs/ dpe dgu'i sgo nas don gcig legs par bshad pa yin no gsung ngo /

/gal te sems can bden par med tsam gyi med dgag sems can gyi chos nyid dang / bde gshegs snying po/ don dam bden pa sogs su 'dod pa ni rnam par 'khyams te/ de la de dang de'i yon tan gang yang med pas so/ /gal te gzhi dus su yon tan gang yang med kyang / 'bras dus su ngo bo nyid skur gyur pa'i tshe stobs sogs yon tan tshad med pa mnga' ba yin snyam na/ de yang ma yin te/ ngo bo nyid sku ni gdod ma nas stobs sogs bral ba'i yon tan dbyer med du ldan pa yin gyis/ yon tan sngar med gsar du sgrub dgos pa ma yin te/ 'di la bsal bya ci yang med/ /bzhag par bya ba cung zad med/ /ces dang / ji ltar sngar de phyis de bzhin/ /'gyur ba med pa'i chos nyid do/ /zhes bshad do/ /yang bde gshegs snying po'i ngo bo ni/ rgyud bla ma las/ rin chen nam mkha' chu dag bzhin/ /rtag tu rang bzhin nyon mongs med/ /ces bshad pa ltar/ dri ma rang bzhin gyis dag pa'i chos dbyings gang zhig bsam pa'i don sgrub pa'i mthu dang ldan pa'i sogs kyi chos gsum ldan du dmigs pa de yin no/ /chos gsum ni/ rin po ches mtshon pa'i mthu dang / nam mkha' mtshon pa'i mi 'gyur ba/ chu yis mtshon pa'i snying rje'i brlan dang gsum mo/ /mtshan gyi rnam grangs ni/ mdo phyogs nas/ dang po'i sku/ ngo bo nyid sku/ 'gog bden mthar thug chos sku/ chos dbyings ye shes/ kun gzhi'i ye shes/ bde gshegs snying po/ rang bzhin gnas rigs/ sems kyi khams/ myang 'das/ thar pa/ bral ba/ de bzhin gshegs pa/ don dam bden pa/ chos nyid/ chos kyi dbyings/ stong pa nyid/ de bzhin nyid/ mtshan ma med pa'i dbyings/ bsam gyis mi khyab pa'i dbyings/ rang bzhin 'od gsal/ yang dag pa'i mtha'/ zhes sogs rnam pa du ma zhig gsungs la/ rgyud sde rnams su/ don dam pa'i lha dang / sngags dang / phyag rgya dang / rdo rje dang / bha ga dang / sangs rgyas thams cad kyi btsun mo dang /

yum dang / chos 'byung dang / rdo rje bdag med ma dang / rdo rje phag mo dang / don dam pa'i gzugs rdo rje ma la sogs pa'i lha mo rnams dang / don dam pa'i 'phags pa 'jam dpal la sogs pa'i sras brgyad dang / don dam pa'i rta mgrin la sogs pa'i khro bo rnams dang / don dam pa'i rigs gcig rigs gsum/ rigs bzhi/ rigs lnga/ rig drug rigs brgyad dang / dang po'i sangs rgyas/ sangs rgyas kun pas sngar sangs rgyas pa/ dang po'i mgon po/ dang po'i rdo rje/ rang byung ye shes/ lhan cig skyes pa'i ye shes/ ye shes chen po/ ye shes snang ba lham me ba/ don dam pa'i sa bcu gnyis/ dga' ba bzhi/ dga' ba bcu drug rang bzhin gyi gnas/ rang bzhin gyi dkyil 'khor/ chos dbyings pho brang lhun grub/ gtsang ma'i gnas lnga rnam spangs pa'i/ 'og min gyi gnas nyams dga' ba la sogs pa rnams su gsungs la/ 'di rnams mtshan gyi rnam grangs yin pas/ phal cher yin khyab mnyam yin no gsung ngo / /stong pa nyid la'ang / kun rdzob kyi stong pa nyid dang / don dam pa'i stong pa nyid/ phung po rnam gcad kyang stong pa nyid dang / rnam kun mchog ldan gyi stong pa nyid/ rang gi ngo bo stong pa nyid dang / gzhan gyi ngo bo stong pa nyid/ dngos po med pa stong pa nyid dang / dngos po med pa'i ngo bo stong pa nyid/ med pa'i stong pa nyid dang / yod pa'i stong pa nyid/ brtags pa'i stong pa nyid dang / yongs su grub pa'i stong pa nyid rnams las/ gnyis tshan drug gi dang po rnams rang stong yin pas/ stong nyid mtshan nyid pa ma yin la/ phyi ma rnams gzhan stong zab mo yin pas/ mtshan nyid pa'o/ /stong tshul yang kun rdzob rnams rang gi ngo bo bden pas stong bas na/ rang stong ngo / /don dam rnams gzhan kun rdzob gyis stong bas na gzhan stong ngo / /gal te dbu ma rtsa sher/ rten cing 'brel 'byung ma yin pa'i/ chos 'ga' yod pa ma yin pas/ chos kyi dbyings las ma gtogs pa'i/

chos 'ga' yod pa ma yin no/ /zhes gzhi grub na rten 'brel dang / chos dbyings yin pas khyab par gsungs pa ma yin nam zhe na/ lung de'i don ni/ rten 'brel ma gtogs pa'i 'dus byas kyi chos 'ga' yang yod pa min/ chos kyi dbyings las ma gtogs pa'i/ chos kyi gshis lugs 'ga' yang yod pa ma yin zhes pa'i don yin no gsung ngo / /gal te rang stong las ma gtogs pa'i gzhan stong med pas/ rang stong nyid dang de bzhin nyid la sogs pa dang ming gi rnam grangs yin no snyam na/ de ni shin tu mi rigs pa chen po lags te/ log sred can gyi sems can de yang rang stong yin pa'i phyir/ de bzhin nyid du 'gyur la/ de ltar na sangs rgyas su 'gyur ste/ khyab pa ni/ thugs rje chen po bstan pa'i mdor/ de bzhin nyid kyi don gang yin pa de de bzhin gshegs pa'i don to/ /zhes dang / rje btsun byams pas/ de bzhin nyid ni sangs rgyas 'dod/ /ces dang / 'phags pa brgyad stong pa las/ de bzhin nyid la ni 'gro ba'am 'ong ba med de/ de bzhin nyid gang yin pa de ni de bzhin gshegs pa'o/ /zhes sogs gsungs pas grub bo/ /gzhan yang gzhan dang gzhan du 'gyur ba'i dngos po rnams kyang / rang rang ngo bos stong pa'i phyir de bzhin nyid du 'gyur la/ de ltar na gzhan dang gzhan du mi 'gyur bar thal te/ rje btsun gyis/ gzhan min zhes gsung ngo / /'phags pa thogs med kyi zhal nas/ ci'i phyir de bzhin nyid la de bzhin nyid ces bya zhe na/ gzhan du mi 'gyur ba nyid kyi phyir/ zhes dang / gzhan yang mi dge ba rnams kyang / rang stong yin pa'i phyir de bzhin nyid du 'gyur la/ 'dod na don dam pa'i dge bar thal te/ don dam pa'i dge ba gang zhe na/ de bzhin nyid do zhes gsungs pas so/ /gal te rang stong dang yang dag mtha' rnam grangs yin na/ phyin ci log rnams kyang rang stong yin pa'i phyir yang dag mthar 'gyur la/ 'dod na/ phyin ci ma log par 'gyur te/

rje btsun byams pas/ phyin ci log ma yin zhes yang dag pa'i mtha' de phyin ci ma log par bshad pas so/ /de bzhin du rang stong dang / mtshan ma med pa'i dbyings rnam grangs su 'dod na/ mtshan ma la 'gags pa'i dngos po rnams kyang rang stong yin pa'i phyir mtshan ma med pa'i dbyings su 'gyur la/ 'dod na/ mtshan ma 'gags pa yin par 'gyur te/ rje btsun byams pa'i zhal nas/ de 'gags zhes mtshan ma med pa'i dbyings kyi don mtshan ma 'gags pa'i gzhi la gsungs pa'i phyir dang / 'phags pa thogs med kyis/ ci'i phyir mtshan ma med pa zhes bya zhe na/ mtshan ma nye bar zhi ba'i phyir ro/ /zhes gsungs pa'i phyir/ de bzhin du rang stong dang don dam bden pa rnam grangs su 'dod na/ sgrib pa gnyis kyang rang stong yin pa'i phyir/ don dam bden par 'gyur la/ 'dod na/ gnyen pos spang du mi rung ba dang / 'phags pa'i mnyam bzhag ye shes kyi spyod yul du 'gyur te/ rje btsun gyis/ 'phags pa'i spyod yul/ zhes dang / 'phags pa thogs med kyis/ ci'i phyir don dam pa zhes bya zhe na/ 'phags pa'i ye shes dam pa'i spyod yul yin pa'i phyir ro/ /zhes gsungs so/ /gal te rang stong dang chos dbyings rnam grangs yin na/ las dang nyon mongs pa yang rang stong yin pa'i phyir/ chos dbyings yin par 'gyur la/ 'dod na 'phags pa'i chos kyi rgyu yin par 'gyur te/ rje btsun byams pas/ 'phags pa'i chos kyi rgyu yi phyir/ /zhes dang / slob dpon seng ge bzang pos/ chos kyi dbyings rgyu'i ngo bor rnam par 'jog pa'i sgo nas rigs nyid du tha snyad 'dogs so/ /zhes gsungs so/ gal te rang stong dang bde gshegs snying po rnam grangs yin na/ zag bcas kyi dngos po rnams kyang rang stong yin pa'i phyir/ bde gshegs snying por 'gyur la/ 'dod na zag med kyi shes par 'gyur te/ rje btsun gyis/ zag pa med pa'i shes pa sbrang ma'i rtsi dang 'dra/ zhes dang /

de bzhin kun mkhyen dag pa'i gser 'dra dri med yid ni mkhyen gyur nas/ zhes gsungs so/ /gal te rang stong dang rang bzhin gnas rigs rnam grangs yin na/ mi dge ba'i chos rnams kyang rang stong yin pa'i phyir/ rang bzhin gnas rigs su 'gyur la/ 'dod na ngo bo nyid sku thob byed kyi rgyur 'gyur te/ rje btsun gyis/ rigs 'di gnyis las sangs rgyas kyi/ /sku gsum thob par 'dod pa yin/ /dang pos sku ni dang po dang / /gnyis pa yis ni phyi ma gnyis/ /zhes gsungs so/ /gal te rang stong dang rang bzhin 'od gsal rnam grangs yin na/ glo bur ba'i dri ma rnams kyang rang stong yin pa'i phyir rang bzhin 'od gsal du 'gyur la/ 'dod na 'gyur med dang / gaṅgā'i klung gi bye ma'i grangs las 'das pa'i yon tan dbyer med du ldan par 'gyur te/ rgyud bla las/ 'od gsal byas min dbyer med pa/ /'jug can gaṅgā'i klung gis ni/ /rdul las 'das pa'i sangs rgyas kyi/ /chos rnams kun dang ldan pa nyid/ /ces gsungs pas so/ /gal te gzhan stong zab mo dang / /rdo rje btsun mo'i bha ga dang don dam byang chub kyi sems sogs ming gi rnam grangs yin par gsungs la/ rang stong las ma gtogs pa'i gzhan stong med na/ glo bur gyi dri ma rnams kyang rang stong yin pa'i phyir/ rdo rje btsun mo'i bha gar 'gyur la/ 'dod na de dbang phyug la sogs pa'i yon tan tshang ba'i sangs rgyas rin chen za ma tog yin par 'gyur te/ phyag rgya chen po thig le'i rgyud du/ ji ltar til son til mar dang / /ji ltar shing la gnas pa'i me/ /de bzhin chos rnams thams cad la/ /yang dag gnas kyang mi mthong ba/ /chos kyi dbyings ni bha gar bshad/ /bha ga rin chen za ma tog /de phyir dbang phyug sogs yon tan/ /ldan pa de phyir bha gar bshad/ /chos ni bha ga zhes byar grags/ /dbyings ni sems su shes par smra/ /zhes gsungs so/ /de bzhin du stong pa nyid kyi rdo rje dang /

don dam pa'i lha dang sngags dang phyag rgya dang dkyil 'khor dang byin rlabs dang / nus pa dang / bde ba dang / dga' ba dang / byang chub dang / yon tan dang / 'phrin las dang / don dam pa'i sku dang gsung dang thugs dang / don dam pa'i sku gsum dang / dkon mchog gsum dang / sher phyin dang / ye shes chen po la sogs pa rnams dang / rang stong ming gi rnam grangs yin na/ ha cang thal ba'i skyon du ma gnas pas/ bdag legs su 'dod pa dag gis de lta bu'i 'dod tshul de ring du dor bar gyis shig gsungs so/ /de bas na dri ma sbyang bar bya ba'i gzhi ni rang gzhan kun gyi rgyud la yod pa'i chos nyid de bzhin nyid 'di yin no/ /mkha' ltar kun la khyab pa yi/ /chos nyid de bzhin nyid 'di ni/ /'khor 'das kun gyi gzhi dang ni/ /gnas dang rten dang sa bon du/ /gsung phyir ming gi rnam grangs ni/ /mdor rgyud rnams las yang dag bshad/ /mi 'gyur yon tan dbyer med dang / /mi slu bden dang don dam dang / /nges don yang dag nyid du yod/ /rtag chad mtha' las rnam par grol/ /rang stong las gzhan zab mo yi/ /stong pa nyid ni gzhan med na/ /ha cang thal ba'i skyon gyi phyir/ /gzhi la bzhugs pa'i chos nyid 'di/ /dri ma sbyong ba'i gzhir ston pa'i/ /'jam dbyangs chos rjes gus phyag 'tshal/ /zhes so/ /sbyang bya'i dri ma ni/ gsung rab rnams las/ phyag rgyas nyon mongs brgyad cu rtsa dgu dang / /rnam rtog brgya rtsa brgyad la sogs pa rnams/ /bsdus na nyon sgrib dang shes sgrib gnyis su 'dus so/ /rgyud sde zab mo rnams su/ tha mal gyi snang zhen dang / rang nyid lhar zhen pa'i rnam rtog 'gog phyir du/ bskyed rdzogs gnyis bshad do/ /gang ltar yang / zag bcas nyer len gyi phung khams skye mched dang / rten 'brel yan lag bcu gnyis la sogs pa 'di rnams sbyang bya'i dri ma yin no gsung ngo / /gang dang ldan na 'khor ba dang / /dman pa'i gnas su ltung ba yi/

/las dang nyon mongs tshul bzhin min/ /bag chags bcas pa sbyang bya zhes/ /legs 'doms khyed la gus phyag 'tshal/ /gnyis pa dri ma sbyong byed kyi lam ni/ ston pas chos phung brgyad khri bzhi stong gsungs pa dang / de'i dgongs 'grel gyi bstan bcos de rnams kyis brjod bya'i lam dang bcas pa rnams/ bde gshegs snying po'i gnas tshul mngon sum du mthong ba la gegs byed kyi dri ma sbyong byed kyi thabs su gcig ste/ ting nge 'dzin rgyal po las/ 'jig rten khams ni stong phrag tu/ /nga yi chos ni gang gsungs pa/ /yi ge tha dad don gcig ste/ /dngos po gcig ni bsam byas na/ /de dag thams cad sgom 'gyur te/ ces sogs dang / bzhi stong gsungs pa thams cad kyang / /chos nyid 'di la gzhol zhing 'bab/ /ces gsungs pa dang / theg pa gsum gyi nges 'byung la/ theg pa gcig gi 'bras bur gnas/ /zhes dang / kyai rdo rje'i rgyud du'ang / dang por gso sbyong sbyin par bya/ /de rjes bslab pa'i gnas bcu sbyin/ /de la bye brag smra ba bstan/ /mdo sde pa yang de bzhin te/ /rnal 'byor spyod pa de las phyis/ /de'i rjes su dbu ma bstan/ /sngags kyi rim pa kun shes nas/ /de rjes kyai rdo rje bstan/ /ces gsungs pa ltar ro/ /de ltar na lam la thun mong gi lam dang / thun mong ma yin pa'i lam gnyis/ dang po la yang / nyan rang dang thun mongs pa'i lam/ phar phyin theg pa dang thun mong pa'i lam gnyis/ dang po la/ dal 'byor rnyed dka' bsam pa/ 'chi ba mi rtag pa bsam pa/ las rgyu 'bras bsam pa/ 'khor ba'i nyes dmigs bsam pa rnams sngon 'gror byas nas/ dngos gzhi la/ bden bzhi'i gnas tshul rtogs pa'i gang zag gi bdag med rtogs pa'i shes rab sgom par byed do/ /de la dbye na/ tshogs lam la sogs pa lnga'o/ /gzhi tshul khrims rnam dag gi steng du/ 'dod chung chog shes byas nas/ lam 'di tsam zhig nyams su blangs pa la brten nas/

khams gsum gyi nyon mongs pa spangs pa'i dgra bcom pa'i go 'phang thob gsung ngo / /phar phyin theg pa dang thun mong gi lam ni/ sngon 'gro gong dang 'dra ba'i steng du/ byams snying rje byang chub kyi sems bsgom pa/ zhi lhag zung 'brel gyi ting nge 'dzin sgom pa/ spyod pa pha rol tu phyin pa drug nyams su len no/ /rigs pa'i gnas lnga dag la mkhas pa'i steng du/ lam 'di tsam zhig nyams su blangs pas rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas kyi go 'phang thob gsungs so/ /thun mong ma yin pa gsang sngags kyi lam ni/ de ltar na phar phyin theg pa man chad kyi theg pa gsum bstan pas chog mod/ pha rol tu phyin pa'i dbu ma las gong du/ sngags kyi theg pa'i ci'i phyir bstan dgos ce na/ de'i gong du sngags kyi theg pa bstan dgos te/ gang zag des sngags rdzogs par nyams su ma blangs par/ rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas mi thob pa'i phyir/ de'i rgyu mtshan yang thabs shes rdzogs par nyams su ma blangs par sangs rgyas mi thob la/ phar phyin theg pa nas thabs shes rdzogs par ma bstan pa'i phyir te/ bde stong zung 'jug gi thabs bde chen dang / e waṃ zung 'jug gi thabs waṃ yig dang / he badz+ra zung 'jug gi thabs he dang / de bzhin du 'dus pa dang / sdom pa la sogs pa'i don rdzogs par ma bstan pa'i phyir/ de dag rdzogs par ma bstan par shes rab kyi don rdzogs par ma bstan dgos pas so/ /de'i rgyu mtshan yang / shes rab khyad par can la/ thabs de dag dang ma bral dgos pas so/ /'o na phar phyin theg par dbu ma ma bstan par 'gyur snyam na/ dbu ma tsam bstan kyang dbu ma rdzogs par ma bstan no/ /de bas na rnal 'byor chen po la zhugs nas/ /de bzhin gshegs pa'i snying po rdzogs par mngon sum du byed dgos pa yin pas de bstan no/ /de la yang phar phyin theg par bstan pa'i dbu ma man chad la sbyang pa mngon du btang nas/ rnal 'byor chen po la 'jug pa'i sngon du/

rgyud sde 'og ma gsum gyi lam rim la 'jug dgos te/ gang zag des mi 'gyur ba'i bde chen mngon du byed pa la/ zhu bde'i bde ba sngon du 'gro dgos/ de la 'dod pa'i 'dod chags kyi bde ba rigs bzhi phyag rgya las spel nas/ thabs shes khyad par can gyi lam du sgyur nas/ nyams su len pa sngon du 'gro dgos pas so/ /don de yang / sam bu ṭa'i rgyu las/ rgod pa dang ni lta ba dang / gnyis gnyis 'khyud dang lag 'changs te/ /srin bu'i tshul gyis rgyud bzhir gnas/ ces sogs 'byung bas so/ /de nas rnal 'byor chen po la 'jug pa la/ smin byed kyi dbang dang / grol byed kyi lam gnyis las/ dang por bla ma mtshan nyid dang ldan pa'i drung du/ smin byed kyi dbang sngon du 'gro dgos te/ dbang med par grol lam sgom pa'i snod du mi rung bas so/ /'o na khyed sbyor drug 'bogs pa'i gong du dus 'khor gyi dbang yongs rdzogs mi byed par/ dbang gong ma tsam re byas nas/ sbyor drug 'bogs pa mi 'thad snyam na/ skyon med de/ rkang mgyogs dang mig sman ril bu la sogs pa'i thun mong gi dngos grub don du gnyer ba rnams la/ byis pa 'jug pa'i dbang bdun la sogs pa dgos kyis/ mchog gi dngos grub don du gnyer ba la/ dbang gong ma nyid bskur nas/ sbyor drug phog pas chog ste/ 'phags pa spyan ras gzigs pad+ma dkar pos/ 'grel chen dri med du/ 'dir dbang bskur ba'i gang zag ni rnam pa gnyis te/ gcig ni thun mong gi dngos grub don du gnyer ba dang / gzhan ni mchog gi dngos grub don du gnyer ba'o/ /dang po rjes su bzung ba'i phyir/ rkang mgyogs dang mig sman ril bu la sogs pa sgrub pa'i don du dkyil 'khor gyi 'khor lo sgom pa'i phyir/ byis pa 'jug pa'i dbang bdun la sogs pas bsdu bar bya'o/ /gnyis pa mchog gi dngos grub don du gnyer ba'i gang zag rjes su bzung ba'i phyir/

dbang gong ma nyid kyis bsdu bar bya'o/ /'di la yang bum pa la sogs pa'i dbang bzhi yod par shes par bya'o/ /zhes gsungs pa'o/ /grol byed kyi lam la yang / bskyed rim dang / rdzogs rim gnyis yod de/ 'grel chen dri med 'od du/ rdo rje can bdag bstan pa ni/ /rim pa gnyis la yang dag brten/ /gcig ni bskyed pa'i rim pa ste/ gzhan ni rdzogs pa'i rim pa'o/ /zhes dang / 'phags pa klu sgrub kyis/ bskyed pa'i rim pa legs gnas shing / /rdzogs pa'i rim pa 'dod rnams la/ /thabs ni rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas kyis/ /skas kyi rdang bu lta bur gsungs/ zhes gsungs/ de gnyis kar yang / de bzhin gshegs pa'i snying po rdzogs par rtogs pa'i ched du sgom pa yin te/ bde stong mthar phyin par ma gyur bar la/ de bzhin gshegs pa'i snying po rtogs pa mthar phyin par mi 'gyur la/ de gnyis ka yang bde stong rtogs pa mthar phyin par bya ba'i ched du sgom pa yin pas so/ /'o na bde gshegs snying po la/ bde ba dang dga' bar bshad pa yod dam zhe na/ yod de/ brtag gnyis su/ gzhan gyi brjod min lhan cig skyes/ /gang du yang ni mi rnyed pa/ /bla mas dus thabs bstan pa dang / /bdag gi bsod nams las shes bya/ /zhes dang / 'grel chen dri med 'od du/ gzhon nu ma'i me long la pra phab pa bzhin/ rang gi sems kyi mngon sum du mthong ba'i yid ches pa'i don can rnam pa thams cad pa/ nam mkha' las byung ba kun tu bzang po thams cad pa/ sems can thams cad kyi bdag nyid du gnas pa/ lhan cig skyes pa'i dga' ba/ gtan tshigs dang dpe spangs pa/ zhes sogs kyis/ lhan cig skyes pa'i bde ba dang / dga' bar gsungs so/ /'o na de bzhin gshegs pa'i snying po de/ blo gang gis mngon sum du mthong ba yin snyam na/ rnam shes dang ye shes gnyis las ye shes kyis mngon sum du mthong gis/ rnam shes kyis ma yin/ ye shes la yang mnyam rjes kyi ye shes gnyis las/

mnyam bzhag ye shes kyis mngon sum du mthong / de la yang chos can la mnyam par bzhag pa'i ye shes dang / chos nyid la mnyam par bzhag pa'i ye shes gnyis las/ phyi ma 'dis mthong ba yin te/ rgyud bla las/ bsam med rtag brtan zhi ba g.yung drung nyid/ /gnyis med gsum bral dri med rnam rtog med/ /chos dbyings rang bzhin gang yin rtag gnas pa/ /mnyam par bzhag pa'i rnal 'byor pa yis mthong / /zhes gsungs pa dang / don dam blo'i spyod yul min/ /zhes blo rnam shes kyi spyod yul min par bshad do/ /de bas na/ rtog sgom dang / dpyad sgom dang bsal sgom sogs kyis/ mngon sum du mthong ba mi srid pas/ bdag bde legs su 'dod pa dag gis rnam par mi rtog pa'i ting nge 'dzin sgom pa la 'bad dgos gsung ngo / /dri ma sbyong byed theg pa gsum gyi lam/ /khyad par bskyed rdzogs zab mo'i ting nge 'dzin/ /thabs shes rdzogs pa'i mi rtog ting 'dzin gyis/ mngon sum mthong zhes ston pa de la 'dud/ 'bras bu'i rnam gzhag la/ sku gcig du bshad pa yod de/ gcig pu sra mkhregs rdo rje'i sku/ /zhes don dam par chos sku gcig tu grub pas so/ /sku gnyis su bshad pa yang yod de/ rang don gzhan don don dam sku dang ni/ /de la brten pa kun rdzob sku gnyis te/ /zhes/ rang don don dam pa'i sku dang / gzhan don kun rdzob pa'i sku gnyis so/ /sku gsum du bshad pa yang yod de/ sku gsum dag gi sangs rgyas kyi/ /sku bsdus par ni shes par bya/ /zhes chos sku longs sku sprul sku gsum mo/ /sku bzhir bshad pa yang yod de/ ngo bo nyid longs rdzogs bcas dang / /zhes gong gi gsum gyi steng du/ ngo bo nyid sku dang bzhi'o/ /sku lngar bshad pa yang yod de/ sangs rgyas sku lnga'i bdag nyid can/ /zhes gong gi bzhi'i steng du/ lhan cig skyes pa'i sku dang lnga'o/ /mdor bsdus na bskyed 'bras chos sku dang /

bral 'bras chos sku gnyis so/ /de bas na sku gsum la yang bden gnyis kyi rnam dbye shes na/ thub pa'i bka' la ma rmongs par 'gyur ro gsung ngo / /sbyang gzhi'i chos nyid sprin bcas nam mkha' 'dra/ /sbyang bya'i dri ma glo bur sprin dang mtshungs/ /sbyong byed lam ni de 'thor rlung bzhin te/ /sbyangs 'bras chos sku sprin sangs nam mkha' bzhin/ /gzhi lam 'bras gsum gshis lugs de bzhin nyid/ /don la khyad med mdo rgyud rnams su bshad/ /ma nor ji bzhin skal ldan 'gro ba la/ /ston mdzad smra ba zla med khyod la 'dud/ /de bzhin du phrin las la yang / bden gnyis su phye nas shes 'tshal te/ rgyud bla ma las/ brgya byin lnga sprin tshangs pa dang / /nyi ma nor bu rin chen bzhin/ /de bzhin gshegs pa sgra brnyan bzhin/ /nam mkha' dang ni sa bzhin no/ /zhes nyi mas 'od zer 'gyed pa rtsol ba med pa ltar/ sangs rgyas kyi phrin las kyang / gdul bya'i smon lam gyi dbang gis/ rtsol med du 'byung bar shes par byed dgos so gsungs so/ /chos ston pa'i bla ma la/ phyi nang gzhan gsum gyi bla ma gsum mo/ /phyi'i bla ma ni/ phyi nas chos ston pa'i bla ma mig shes la snang ba 'di yin/ nang gi bla ma ni/ rang gi spyi gtsug dang / snying khar sgom pa'i rtog pa la snang ba 'di yin/ gzhan gyi bla ma ni/ 'od gsal bla ma'i rnam par byon nas/ rang la gnas lugs kyi don ston pa'i mnyam bzhag ye shes la snang ba 'di yin no/ /yang na kun rdzob gyi bla ma dang / don dam gyi bla ma gnyis las/ kun rdzob gyi bla ma ni/ phyi nas sems ngo sprod pa'i bla ma 'di yin/ don dam gyi bla ma ni/ chos nyid bla ma'i rnam par byon nas/ sems ngo sprod pa'i bla ma de yin pas/ dad ldan gyi slob ma skal ba dang ldan pa yid gzhung pa rnams la/ bden pa gnyis ka'i bla mas/ zab mo'i don ston pa yin pa la/ mos gus drag po'i sgo nas gsol ba thob cig

'bral med du yong gsung ngo / /bcu gcig pa brgyad cu'i dus su 'da' tshul ston pa ni/ rgyud bla ma las/ ji bzhin yang dag mthong ba'i phyir/ /skye sogs rnams la 'das gyur yang / /snying rje'i bdag nyid skye ba dang / /rga dang na dang 'chi ba ston/ /zhes gsungs pa ltar/ bdag nyid chen po 'dis/ 'od gsal chos sku mngon sum du mdzad pa'i phyir/ las nyon gyi skye rga na 'chi'i sdug bsngal las grol yang / snying rje'i dbang gis/ bdag sogs rtag 'dzin can rnams chos la bskul ba'i phyir du/ mya ngan las 'da' ba'i tshul ston pa ni/ shing mo lug lo hor zla drug nas/ phyag cung zad mnyel ba'i tshul bstan pa'i skabs su/ phyag phyir yod pa rnams kyis/ maṇ+ḍal phul nas/ sprul pa'i sku brtan par bzhugs pa'i gsol ba btab cing / sku rim sogs ji ltar bgyid lags zhus pas/ bdag nyid chen po'i zhal nas/ paṇa chen shākya shrī la/ dam bca' chen po bzhi 'dug ste/ nyin re la/ chos spyod bcu kha tshar re ma chag par mdzad pa dang / rang don du bre gang las lhag pa zhag gsum las lhag pa mi 'chang ba dang / gnod lan du phan 'dogs pa dang / na tsha bde sdug ci byung yang / chos nyid zab mo sgom pa ma gtogs/ sman bcos rim gro ci yang mi mdzad pa ni/ skyes bu dam pa'i rnam thar du 'dug go /chos rje sa paṇa gyis/ chags zhen gyi gnyen por/ spong thag byed pa/ nad kyi gnyen por sman gtong ba/ gdon bgegs kyi gnyen por dmigs pa yid la byed pa gsum gsungs pa rnams ni/ gang zag phal pa rnams la dgongs pa yin/ gang ltar yang / 'o skol gyi snga mo'i dus kyi blo rtse'i gtod mtshams la/ zas bsod snyoms pa/ gos phyag dar khrod pa/ gnas shing drung pa sogs sbyangs pa'i yon tan bcu gnyis la rten pa gcig byed snyam pa bdog ste/ dus phyis/ sde pa chen po rnams kyi gzhan dbang du song nas/ gong du bshad pa rnams byed pa'i rang dbang ma thob pas/

yo byad kyi dngos po'ang mang po tshags byed dgos pa byung / 'on kyang chags zhen ni cher med pas/ ma zhen par longs spyod pa la/ khang bu rtsegs pa lnga brgya pa dang / kha zas ro brgya pa/ gos gser srang stong ri ba rnams longs spyod pas chog pa'i dmigs bsal/ dam chos 'dul ba nas gsungs 'dug deng sang dge slong rgan po 'das pa'i rjes na/ yo byad kyi dngos po mang po yod pa/ phyis kyi mig ltos la gnod pa dang / longs spyod g.yo ba snying po med pas/ snying po blangs pa'i phyir du sbyin gtong cung zad bgyis pas chog yul gyi mchog kyang dge 'dun yin pas/ dge 'dun gyi bsnyen bkur gyi grabs gyis gsungs nas/ dpal ldan sa skya/ ri khrod jo nang / zha lu/ snar thang / gnas snying / chos sde gong 'og rnams su dge 'dun tshogs pa la bsnyen bkur/ mang ja/ 'gyed rgyab dang bcas pa sogs mdzad/ lha sa'i jo bo/ ngur mig gi sgrol ma/ zhwa lu'i thugs rje chen po/ khro phu'i byams chen sogs rten khyad par can rnams la gser chab gsol ba/ dkar me 'bul ba sogs kyang mdzad do/ /de nas hor zla bcu pa'i dus/ rtse gong 'og gi sde pa chen po rnams kyis thog drangs/ sbyin bdag chen po rnams dang / grags bu slob rnams kyis kyang sku rim bsgrubs nas/ 'jig rten khams 'dir yun ring du bzhugs par gsol ba rtse gcig tu btab kyang / sangs rgyas kyi bstan pa nyams dma' ba'i phyir ram/ snyigs ma'i dus kyi sems can rnams kyi bsod nams la ma ran pa'i phyir ram/ sprul pa'i sku de nyid kyis 'dul ba'i gdul bya rnams kyi 'phrin las re zhig grub pa'i phyir ram/ sku rten de la brten nas 'jig rten gyi khams 'dir bzhugs pa'i smon lam gyi 'phen pa rdzogs pa'i phyir ram/ thub mchog dam pa brgyad cu'i dus su gshegs pa dang / rang gi rtsa ba'i bla ma grub chen blo yang brgyad cu'i dus su gshegs pa sogs la dgongs nas/

rang nyid kyang brgyad cu'i dus su gshegs par bzhed nas/ bla brang gi stod kyi rdzas rnams dang / glo bur du byung ba'i phyag rdzas rnams so sor phye ba'i tho yig dang / bla brang na yod pa'i sku 'khor rnams la gnang sbyin/ sde pa chen po'i 'bul skal/ dge 'dun gyi bsnyen bkur gyi chas rnams so sor phye ba'i tho yig gsal por mdzad de/ rjes kyi zhal bkod pa rnams la'ang mdzad bde ba snang nas/ hor zla bcu gcig pa'i tshes gcig nas gsol ba yang ma mdzad/ snyung zug gi rnam pa ni cung zad kyang med do/ /de dus/ de ring grwa tshang 'di zhes bya bas/ sku rim gyi mang ja sgrub kyi gda'/ de ring sbyin bdag 'di zhes bya bas/ sku rim gyi rnam rgyal sgrub par gda' lags zhes zhus dus/ 'o skol la phan par dka' na'ang / chos zab mos sbrel ba'i dpon slob yin pas/ khong rang rnams kyi tshogs rdzogs te mchi/ rjes su yi rang zhes gsungs/ tshe lnga drug gi dus/ gzim dpon gyis de ltar zhus pas/ zhal snga nas/ da lus kyi stobs ni zhan/ ngag smra brjod la ni dga' ba med/ sems la 'jig rten 'di yi snang ba phal cher nub nas/ 'od gsal gyi snang ba rab 'byams su 'dug pas/ phyi nas gzhan gyi lan khyer 'ong ba sogs ma byed cig lo 'dod ljon shing chags nas 'dug /ba glang brtul zhugs nyams nas 'dug /khyi phag spyod pa nub nas 'dug /mi gtsang rkyal pa ral nas 'dug /dkon mchog gsum la blo gtad bcas/ /bslab gsum rgyan la byi dor byas/ /gzhan phan rgya chen sems bskyed nas/ /bskyed rdzogs lam la rab zhugs te/ 'od gsal chos sku'i pho brang 'gro/ /nyams nga bag tsha ci yang med/ /bdag gi rjes 'jug dam pa rnams/ /nga bzhin 'dod na gdams bzhin mdzod/ /tshe 'di'i 'grog lam de tsam gyis/ /phyi ma dag pa'i gnas su mjal/ /chos kyi lhag ma zhing der spyod/ /nyams dga' skyong na zhing der skyong / /glu gar rtse na zhing der rtse/

/rgyan cha 'dogs na zhing der 'dogs/ /mi yi rgyan gyi dper mi phod/ /ces gsungs so/ /kun rdzob gzugs sku'i bkod pa rnams/ 'od kyi gong bu gcig tu gyur nas/ don dam 'od gsal chos sku'i pho brang du bsdus te/ sngon chad ma tshor ba'i lha'i dri bzang gis khyab pa dang / rol mo'i sgra grags pa dang / me tog sna lnga'i char dang / 'ja' 'od kyi gur phub pa la sogs pa'i ngo mtshar ba'i ltas khyad par can dang bcas nas/ lug lo hor zla bcu gcig pa/ dam chos 'dul ba'i lugs kyis/ spre'u'i lo zla ba dang po'i tshes bcu bzhi la/ bde bar gshegs pa'i tshul bstan no/ /de nas tshes bcu bdun gyi nyin/ sku gdung mchod rten gyi nang du bzhugs su gsol ba'i dus/ mi 'jigs pa bzhi brnyes pa'i rtags su/ shar phyogs kyi nam mkha' la/ 'ja' dkar seng ge mkha' la 'phyo ba lta bu'i mjug ma'i rtse dang / g.yu ral gyi rtse la/ 'ja' kha dog sna lnga 'phro ba/ rdzu 'phrul gyi rkang pa brnyes pa'i rtags su/ lho phyogs kyi mkha' la/ 'ja' dkar rta mchog mkha' la 'phyo ba lta bu'i ze ba dang rnga ma'i rtse la/ 'ja' kha dog sna lnga 'phro ba/ bden gnyis kyi gnas lugs rtogs pa'i rtags su/ nub phyogs nas 'ja' dkar rma bya mkha' la 'phur ba lta bu'i/ gshog sgro'i rtse la 'ja' kha dog sna lnga 'phro ba/ stobs bcu brnyes pa'i rtags su/ byang phyogs nas 'ja' dkar glang chen mkha' la 'phyo ba lta bu'i mche ba'i rtse gnyis la/ 'ja' sna lang 'phro ba/ srog chags de rnams kyi kha nas/ 'ja' dkar gdugs dang / rgyal mtshan dang / ba dan dang / bla re dang / yol ba dang / rnga yab dang / bkra shis rtags brgyad la sogs pa'i rnam pa rnams kyis/ nub kyi phyogs la bsu ba'i rnam pa mdzad do/ /de dus jo nang pa'i sgom chen nyams rtogs bzang ba kha cig gi mthong snang la/ shar phyogs nas 'od dkar po rdza ma tsam gcig byung nas/ jo nang gi sku 'bum mthong grol chen mo la bskor ba lan gsum byas nas/

kun mkhyen chen po'i sku lder gyi drung na/ zhag gsum gyi bar bzhugs nas/ slar yang nub kyi phyogs la thegs song bas/ nyang stod du 'jam dbyangs chos rje sku gshegs pa yin nam zer/ dus de'i tshe na/ dgon pa bsam lding gi lha khang na/ zhal snga nas kyi phyag nas bzhugs pa'i rje btsun ma sgrol ma'i sku gcig bzhugs pa de/ spyan chab rlon tsha re 'dug pa/ dkon gnyer gyis mthong nas/ nan ltar ma bzang ba'i ltas 'di bzhin 'dug pas/ nyang stong du 'jam dbyangs chos rje gshegs sam/ bde chen du chos rje dkon mchog rgyal mtshan pa gshegs mas zhes zer te/ chos rje dkon rgyal ba/ zla ba rjes ma'i tshes bcu bzhi la sku gshegs pa lags so/ /'od gsal chos sku mngon du mdzad pa'i mthus/ /skye rga na 'chi'i sdug bsngal las grol yang / /brtse bas bdag sogs chos la bskul ba'i phyir/ /'jam dbyangs mya ngan 'da' tshul bstan la 'dud/ /lha'i dri bzang me tog sna lnga'i char/ /rol mo'i sgra dang gdugs dang rgyal mtshan sogs/ /'ja' 'od rnams kyis nub kyi phyogs la bsus/ /'jam dbyangs bde ba can du gshegs la 'dud/ /ces so/ /'jam dbyangs smra ba'i nyi ma gzhan du gshegs/ /bdag sogs gdul bya'i pad+mo'i kha ni zum/ /log lta 'byung po'i bya rnams ca co sgrog /zab mo'i bstan pa gang gis gsal bar byed/ /'jam dbyangs smra ba'i zla ba gzhan du gshegs/ /bdag sogs ku mu da rnams kha ni zum/ /gling 'dir mi shes mun nag sprin rum 'thibs/ /da ni mi shes sprin nag gang gis sel/ /'jam dbyangs smra ba'i seng ge gzhan du gshegs/ /log smra'i wa tshogs gang gis skrag par byed/ /'jam dbyangs lung rig rgya mtsho de ring bskams/ /bdag cag chu phran rnams ni gang du 'dus/ /'jam dbyangs ri dbang lhun po de ring 'gyel/ /chos sde gling bzhi'i dbus 'di su yis 'dzin/ /bdag gi yid bzhin nor bu rkun pos phrogs/ /bdag gi blo'i dbul ba gang gis sel/

/bshes gnyen dpag bsam sdong po de ring 'gyel/ /gdul bya'i bya tshogs rnams ni gang du 'dud/ /bdag gi chos kyi dung chen de ring chag /da ni chos kyi dung chen su yis 'bud/ /bdag gi chos kyi rnga chen de ring rdib/ /da ni chos kyi rnga chen su yis brdung / /bdag gi chos kyi dar chen de ring ral/ /da ni chos kyi dar chen su yis 'phyar/ /de ring chos kyi gaṇ+ṭi me yis tshig /da ni chos kyi gaṇ+ṭi su yis sgrog /ngur smrig rgyal mtshan chen po de ring 'gyel/ /da ni tshul khrims rgyal mtshan su yis slong / /bla ma 'gro ba'i mi gcig gzhan du gshegs/ /bdag cag long ba'i tshogs kun gang du bgrod/ /bla ma ded dpon dbang po gzhan du gshegs/ /'khor ba'i rgya mtshor byings rnams gang gis sgrol/ /bla ma sman pa'i rgyal po gzhan du gshegs/ /dug gsum nad kyis gzir rnams su yis gso/ /bla ma rgya mtsho'i gos can gzhan du gshegs/ /phan bde'i lo thog rnams ni gang la brten/ /bla ma dag byed dbang po gzhan du gshegs/ /da ni nyon mongs dri ma gang gis 'khrud/ /bla ma sreg byed dbang po gzhan du gshegs/ /da ni rnam rtog bud shing su yis sreg /bla ma rlung chen rgyal po gzhan du gshegs/ /byams dang snying rje'i chu 'dzin gang gis sdud/ /nges don lung rig rdo rje gzhan du gshegs/ /sna tshogs lta ba'i brag ri gang gis 'joms/ /'di 'dra'i gnas tshul ngan pa gzigs pa'i tshe/ /yi dam lha mo spyan chab bsil zhing bzhugs/ /bstan srung rnams kyang bstan pa btang snyoms mdzad/ /stong phrag dge 'dun rnams ni bzhin ras nag /mgon skyabs dpung gnyen su la re zhes bshum/ /nyi zla gza' skar rnams kyang 'od mi 'byin/ /bag phebs ri dwags rnams kyang thom thom rgyug /bya'i tshogs kyang gzhan du 'phur lding byed/ /bdag cag mya ngan me yis gdungs pa rnams/ /skad ni 'dzer zhing gdong ni mchi mas gang / /snying mi dga' zhing yid ni gzhan du 'phyo/

/bsil ba'i gnas gcig ga na yod ces rtog /bdag cag nyams dag nga ro 'o dod 'bod/ /'di 'dra phod par gda' ye bla ma rje/ /da dung gnas 'dir byon la gdan sa zung / /da dung gnas 'dir byon la chos 'khor bskor/ /bla ma 'od gsal 'gro 'ong ma mchis kyang / /skye 'gag snang ba rang gi sems snang yin/ /bla mas skye 'chi'i rtsed mo mdzad pa la/ /bden bzung byis pa bdag kyang a thang chad/ /bdag cag skye bar 'jam dbyangs bla ma yis/ /rjes bzung sdig pa'i grogs dang bral ba dang / /bla ma'i rnam thar phyogs med 'byongs pa dang / /skyabs gnas bla ma dran par byin gyis rlobs/ /zhes so/ /de nas rtse gong 'og gi sde pa chen po gnyis kyi thog drangs/ sbyin bdag rnams dang / chos sde gong 'og gi grwa tshang so so rnams dang / bla brang gong 'og gi phyag rdzas sogs kyi steng nas/ bdag rkyen sbyar nas/ thugs dam gsal 'debs la dmigs nas/ rgyud sde bzhi'i dkyil 'khor mang po'i sgrub mchod zhag mang po'i bar du mdzad pa dang / sde pa chen po gnyis kyis phyi rten/ nang rten khyad par can bzhengs te/ de dag gi drung du mchod pa'i tshogs bsam gyis mi khyab pa dang / zla ba'i mchod pa/ dus kyi mchod pa la sogs pa la dmigs pa'i gzhi rten btsugs nas/ ma chag par mdzad pa sogs yul khyad par can la dmigs pa'i tshogs rgya chen po 'dum par mdzad do/ /thub mchog dam pa brgyad cu'i dus su gshegs/ /klu sgrub snying po drug brgya lon nas gshegs/ /zla ba grags pa bzhi brgya lon nas gshegs/ /rig pa'i khu byug sum brgya lon pa sogs/ /rgya gar mkhas grub rnams kyang 'da' tshul bstan/ /bod kyi mkhas grub rnams kyang rim gyis gshegs/ /'chi med bdud rtsi'i mchog rnyed de dag kyang / /mi rtag chos la bskul phyir 'da' tshul ston/ /bdag cag 'ching ba kun ldan byis pa rnams/ /rtag tu sdod grabs byed pa ma 'khrul lam/

/nor ldan sgren mo lag stong dag du 'gro/ /kha drag can la skad cig sdod dbang med/ /'khor mang nang nas grogs med gcig pur 'gro/ /'khor dang longs spyod sgrub pa ma 'khrul lam/ /lang 'tsho'i nyin byed nub ri'i rtse la byol/ /lus kyi ri klung gnyer ma'i grib mas non/ /'chi ba'i mun nag chen po myur du 'byung / /bag med gnyid du log pa ma 'khrul lam/ /rgyab nas lo zla mang po'i dmag gis bdas/ /mdun na thar med 'chi ba'i g.yang la thug /gang du bltas kyang 'gro sa gzhan med pas/ /don med long gtam smra ba ma 'khrul lam/ /tshe 'di snum zad rlung nang mar me dang / /bsod sar khrid pa'i dud 'gro ji bzhin du/ /long med skad cig res kyang 'chi la nye/ /tshe 'di'i che thabs sgrub pa ma 'khrul lam/ /rnyed dka'i dal 'byor ston kha'i sprin ltar g.yo/ /dkar nag las 'bras mi slu phyi bzhin 'brang / /thar med 'khor ba'i rgya mtsho gting re zab/ /dkon mchog yon tan dran par byin gyis rlobs/ /nyes dmigs mang la bde ba'i mnog chung ba'i/ /phyi yi 'dod yon lnga la chags spangs nas/ /ting 'dzin bdud rtsi'i ro ldan zas kyi mchog /bde thabs nang nas rnyed par byin gyis rlobs/ /gang la zhen pa kun nas nyon mongs phyogs/ /zhen pa bral ba rnam par byang ba'i chos/ /mi rtog ting 'dzin nyams su len pa la/ /tshe dang sgrub pa snyoms par byin gyis rlobs/ /gnas skabs su yang dam chos sgrub pa'i grogs/ /tshe dang bsod nams gnas dang yo byad 'phel/ /'gal rkyen phyi nang nyer 'tshe zhi byed pa'i/ /chos skyong srung mas bu bzhin skyong du gsol/ /bdag kyang 'di nas shi 'phos gyur ma thag /bde ba can gyi zhing du rdzus skyes nas/ /bla ma'i sras kyi thu bor 'gyur ba dang / /thugs yid gcig tu 'dres par byin gyis rlobs/ /skye bar bla ma'i yon tan rjes su dran/ /nyin mtshan kun du khyod nyid 'ba' zhig sems/

rtse cig gdung ba drag pos gsol 'debs kyis/ tshad med thugs rjes rjes su bzung du gsol/ /zhes so/ /bcu gnyis pa dge ba bsngo ba gsum las/ bla ma mnyes pa'i phan yon/ /ma mnyes pa'i nyes dmigs/ mnyes par gdams te dge ba bsngo ba'o/ /dang po ni/ bdag nyid 'khor ba'i sdug bsngal las thar nas/ gzhan don rgya chen 'byung ba dang / bla ma'i rnam thar skyong ba sogs la/ sgo du ma nas bla ma mnyes par byed dgos te/ dus 'khor rtsa rgyud las/ bskal pa dus gsum thams cad du/ /dkon mchog gsum la mchod pa dang / /srog chags bye ba'i tshe bskyabs pas/ /tshe 'dir sangs rgyas mi thob ste/ /yon tan rgya mtsho'i bla ma la/ /dang ba'i yid kyis phyag byas na/ /mchog dang thun mong dngos grub ni/ /tshe 'di nyid la thob par 'gyur/ /zhes gsungs/ sgyu 'phrul drwa ba las/ rdo rje 'dzin pa de yang nyon/ /slob dpon la ni dus gsum du/ /gsong por smra ba thams cad rigs/ /lus ngag spyod pa rab bsdams te/ /ha cang nye min ring po min/ /rtag tu bral ba ma yin te/ /dus gsum du ni me tog dbul/ /blo ldan nang nub phyag byas te/ /zas la sogs pas dang por mchod/ /gal te dus 'dus ring gyur na/ /de la rtag tu mngon par phyogs/ /de spun grogs dang bla ma la/ /rtag tu de dang 'dra bar mchod/ /de yi rigs kyis rtag tu bzung / /lham dang stan yang spyi bor blangs/ /thugs khar pho brang bca' ba brtan/ /rtag tu de'am gzhan du min/ /de yi bka' las 'da' mi bya/ /zhes gsungs/ a ti bkod pa chen po zhes bya ba'i rgyud las/ gsang sngags sngags las byung ba yi/ /bla ma dran dang ldan pa nyid/ /snying gi dkyil lam lag pa'i mthil/ /spyi bo'i gtsug tu sus sgom pa/ /sangs rgyas stong gi yon tan yang / /gang zag de yis 'dzin par 'gyur/ /zhes gsungs/ kyai rdo rje las/ gzhan gyi brjod min lhan cig skyes/ /gang du yang ni mi rnyed de/

/bla ma'i dus thabs rten pa dang / /rang gi bsod nams las shes bya/ /zhes sogs gsungs so/ /gnyis pa ma mnyes pa'i nyes dmigs ni/ bla ma'i yon tan yongs bzung las/ /bla ma mnyes par mi byed gang / /bskal pa bye bar tshogs bsags shing / /shes rab gsum la blo sbyangs kyang / /he ru ka las ring 'gyur zhing / /don gyi de nyid rtogs mi 'gyur/ /lha mi'i mchod pa las ring 'gyur/ /bla ma brnyas shing rgyab phyogs na/ /shin tu 'jigs pa'i dmyal bsrungs kyis/ /mtshon cha du mas sdigs byed cing / /drag cing rtsub pa'i sgra sgrog pa'i/ /sog le 'bar bas bshog las sogs/ /sdug bsngal mi zad myong bar 'gyur/ /zhes dang / bla ma lnga bcu pa las/ de 'dra'i mgon la bsam byas nas/ /slob mar gyur nas brnyas na ni/ /sangs rgyas thams cad brnyas par 'gyur/ /des ni sdug bsngal rtag tu thob/ /slob dpon la ni smod pa de/ /yams dang 'tshe ba'i nad rnams dang / /gdon dang rims dang dug rnams kyis/ /rmongs chen de ni 'chi bar 'gyur/ /rgyal po me dang sbrul gdug dang / /chu dang mkha' 'gro rkun po dang / /gdon dang log 'dren dag gis ni/ /bsad nas sems can dmyal bar 'gro/ /zhes dang / dam tshig chen po'i rgyud las/ dam tshig dang ni mi ldan na/ /bsgrubs kyang 'grub par mi 'gyur te/ /rgyu med pa yi 'bras bu bzhin/ /tshe'i dus byas dmyal bar 'gro/ /zhes sogs gsungs so/ /gsum pa mnyes par gdams te dge ba byang chub tu bsngo ba ni/ sam bu ṭi las/ gang gis phyogs bcu'i sangs rgyas dang / /byang chub sems dpa'i bsod nams pas/ /slob dpon ba spu gcig mchod de/ /de phyir slob dpon mchod pa la/ /sangs rgyas byang chub sems dpa' mnyes/ /zhes dang / sdom pa 'byung ba'i rgyud las/ mchod pa kun gyi thog mar ni/ /bla ma'i mchod pa brtsam par bya/ /de mnyes pa las dngos grub ni/ /kun mkhyen nyid kyang thob par 'gyur/

/zhes dang / bla ma'i yon tan yongs bzung las/ /bdag la bla ma'i drin khyab pas/ /bla ma mnyes par cis mi bya/ /bla ma dkon mchog gsum yin pas/ /de la mchod pa cis mi bya/ /zhes dang / chu zla lta bu'i rdo rje slob dpon la/ /rmi lam lta bu'i slob ma gus ldan gyis/ /sgyu ma lta bu'i yon gyis bsnyen bkur nas/ /sgra snyan lta bu'i gsung gis chos bstan pas/ /'ja' tshon mig yor lta bu'i don rtogs nas/ /sna tshogs sprul pa lta bu'i phrin las kyis/ /dri za'i grong khyer lta bu'i sems can rnams/ /mig sgyu lta bu'i srid pa'i mtsho las sgrol/ /de phyir/ bla ma mnyes bya mi bdag kye/ /zhes dang / jo bo'i zhal nas/ brgya dang lnga bcu bla ma kho bos brten/ /bdag gis tshab tshob bla ma brten ma myong / /brten nas skad cig yal bar 'dor ma myong / /thams cad mgo bo'i thod bzhin spyi bor khur/ /zhes gsungs pa ltar bla ma dam pa mnyes pa'i thabs la 'bad dgos so/ /skyabs gnas kun 'dus khyod la gus phyag 'tshal/ /dngos 'byor yid sprul mchod sprin rgya mtsho 'bul/ /sgo gsum nyes pa'i tshogs rnams 'gyod pas bshags/ /skye 'phags dus gsum dge la rjes yi rang / /rigs can gsum la chos 'khor bskor du gsol/ /zhing 'dir mya ngan mi 'da' rtag bzhugs nas/ /rang gzhan tshogs gnyis dge ba ci bsags pa/ /pha mas bla med rdzogs byang thob phyir bsngo/ /bla ma sangs rgyas kun dngos rdo rje 'chang / /de phyir sangs rgyas byang sems rnams kyis kyang / /yon tan ma lus brjod par mi nus na/ /bdag lta blo gros zhan pas smos ci 'tshal/ /'on kyang bla ma'i rnam thar rgya mtsho las/ /chu thigs tsam zhig dad pa'i dbang gis brjod/ /nyes par zin gang de 'dir bdag gis nyes/ /yi dam srung ma mkha' 'gro rnams la bshags/ /brnyed bkur grags 'dod gzhan la 'gran sems dang / /mkhas pa'i nga rgyal dag gis 'di ma bgyis/ /sems ma chen mos bka' yi legs bskul nas/

/bla ma'i yon tan gnas tshul ji bzhin brjod/ /de las byung ba'i dge tshogs rlung chen gyis/ /mos gus drag po'i chu 'dzin rab 'khrigs te/ /byams dang snying rje'i char rgyun legs phab nas/ /dad pa'i ljon shing chen po rgyas par shog /ces/ mkhyen rab dang thugs rje tshad med pa mnga' ba'i bdag nyid/ khams gsum chos kyi rgyal po/ 'jam pa'i dbyangs dkon mchog bzang po zhes bya ba/ sa gsum na snyan pa'i ba dan g.yo ba gang de'i rnam par thar pa rgya mtsho lta bu las/ bla ma'i yon tan rags rim 'ga' zhig rang gis mngon sum du mthong ba dang / thos pa dang / myong ba dang / rtags la brten nas/ rang bzo dang / mkhas phyug spangs te/ chu thig tsam zhig dad pa'i lces blangs nas brjod pa/ dad pa'i ljon shing rgyas byed ces bya ba'i 'di ni/ rigs rus kyi yon tan du ma dang ldan zhing / dad pa dang nges 'byung dang / brtson 'grus dang / ting nge 'dzin dang / ngo tsha khrel yod sogs kyis nye bar mdzes pa/ khyad par du/ rjes dam pa 'di nyid la mi phyed pa'i dad pa brtan po dang ldan pa/ rdo rje'i rnal 'byor ma chen mo dpal ldan bde ba bzang mo'i drung gis bdag rkyen legs par sbyar nas/ thub pa'i bstan pa rin po che dar ba'i sa phyogs/ theg pa chen po'i chos kyi sgra dbyangs sgrog pa'i mkhas pa du ma'i 'byung gnas/ khyad par du/ dpal ldan shar dga' ba dbu brnyes pa'i yul/ bsil drod snyoms pa'i rlung gis gnyid dang smugs pa dang tshad pa'i nad zhi bar byed pa'i pho brang rtse chen zhes bya ba/ mtha' gangs ri dpal dang ldan pa'i phreng bas/ yol ba'i tshul gyis phyogs kun nas bskor ba/ lung pa'i sul dag nas chu phran rnams ni/ yon tan sgrog pa'i tshul gyis 'bab cing / grong dang grong khyer/ grong brdal dang / ljongs dag ni zhal zas kyi tshul du gnas pa/ bya dang ri dwags rnams ni bag phebs par rgyu ba'i dri zhim yid du 'ong ba'i nags tshal dag gis kun nas bskor ba/

g.yon phyogs nas nyang chu sngon mo yon chab kyi tshul gyis dal gyis 'bab pa/ mdun rgyab gnyis na baiḍūra'i ne'u sing sngon po dang / de'i dbus na nyi ma'i 'od kyis/ gnam sngon mo bzhu ba 'khyil ba dang 'dra ba'i mtsho dang rdzing bu/ dri zhim po'i pad+ma'i+i dra bas kun nas khebs pa/ chu bya sna tshogs skad snyan par sgrog pas brgyan pa'i dbus na/ brag ri seng ge mkha' la 'phyo ba lta bu'i lho phyogs na/ mtsho las skyes pa'i pad ma dkar po kha phye ba lta bu'i mo dben gyis brgyan pa/ ze 'bru 'god pa'i rtse'i sgrol ma lha khang du/ 'jam dbyangs bla ma de nyid kyis dngos su rjes su bzung zhing / gsung gi bdud rtsi'i bcud kyis shes rab kyi dbang po rgyas pa/ dpal dus kyi 'khor lo'i rnal 'byor pa/ blo gros rgya mtshos/ sa pho khyi lo'i hor zla lnga pa'i nyer gnyis la rdzogs par sbyar ba'i yi ge pa ni blo gros 'byung gnas kyis mdzad pa las/ dus phyis/ yos bu'i lo hor zla lnga pa'i nyer gnyis la/ dpal ldan bla ma'i rnam thar rang la phan phyir bsod nams rin chen gyis bris pa'o/ /phyogs dus kun tu bkra shis dang / bde legs kyi khyab par shog/ PAGE \* MERGEFORMAT 114 blo gros rgya mtsho/ dkon mchog bzang po'i rnam thar dad pa'i ljon shing rgyas byed/ PAGE \* MERGEFORMAT 113
